zh.q: 同一进程内的多个线程共享下列哪一项？
choices: 堆和全局变量（同一地址空间）
zh.explain: 线程共享进程的地址空间（代码段、堆、全局变量、打开的文件），但每个线程有自己的栈、程序计数器和寄存器。

en.q: Which of these do threads of the same process share?
choices: The heap and globals (one address space)
en.explain: Threads share the process address space (code, heap, globals, open files); each has its own stack, program counter and registers.

zh.q: 发生缺页（page fault）的直接原因是？
choices: 访问了空指针以外的合法地址
访问的虚拟页当前不在物理内存中
zh.explain: 页表项标记该页不在内存时，MMU 触发缺页异常，内核把页从磁盘（或零页）调入后重新执行指令。缓存未命中由硬件处理，不会陷入内核。

en.q: What directly causes a page fault?
choices: The referenced virtual page is not in physical memory
en.explain: When the page-table entry says the page is not resident, the MMU raises a fault and the kernel brings the page in, then retries the instruction. A cache miss is handled in hardware without a trap.

zh.q: 下列哪种调度算法可能让长作业一直得不到执行（饥饿）？
zh.explain: 只要不断有更短的作业到达，SJF 就一直先运行它们，长作业可能无限等待。轮转和 FCFS 都保证每个作业最终能运行。

en.q: Which scheduling policy can starve long jobs?
en.explain: If shorter jobs keep arriving, SJF keeps running them first and a long job can wait forever. Round robin and FCFS both guarantee every job eventually runs.

zh.q: 下列哪一项不是死锁的必要条件？
zh.explain: Coffman 四条件是互斥、占有并等待、不可抢占、循环等待。资源可抢占恰好破坏了“不可抢占”，是预防死锁的手段之一。

en.q: Which is NOT a necessary condition for deadlock?
en.explain: The four Coffman conditions are mutual exclusion, hold and wait, no preemption and circular wait. Preemptible resources break 'no preemption', so they prevent deadlock.

zh.q: 系统出现“抖动”（thrashing）时，最典型的现象是？
choices: 进程频繁换页，CPU 利用率反而很低
磁盘坏道导致读写失败
CPU 温度过高自动降频
zh.explain: 分给进程的物理页框太少，工作集放不下，大部分时间都花在换入换出上，CPU 大多在等 I/O。

en.q: What is the typical symptom of thrashing?
choices: Processes page constantly and CPU utilisation drops
Threads keep contending for a lock
Bad disk sectors cause I/O errors
The CPU throttles because it is too hot
en.explain: Processes get too few frames to hold their working sets, so most time goes to paging in and out and the CPU mostly waits on I/O.

zh.q: 程序连续调用 3 次 fork()（都不检查返回值），最后一共有多少个进程（含原进程）？
zh.explain: 每次 fork 都让当前所有进程翻倍：1 → 2 → 4 → 8。

en.q: A program calls fork() three times in a row without checking the return value. How many processes exist at the end, including the original?
en.explain: Each fork doubles every process that runs it: 1 → 2 → 4 → 8.

zh.q: 同一进程内的线程切换通常比进程切换开销小，主要原因是？
choices: 不需要切换地址空间（页表），TLB 不用刷新
线程切换不需要保存寄存器
zh.explain: 线程切换仍要保存和恢复寄存器、栈指针；省下的主要是换页表和随之而来的 TLB、缓存失效。内核线程的切换照样要进内核。

en.q: Why is switching between threads of one process usually cheaper than switching processes?
choices: No address-space (page table) switch, so the TLB stays warm
Thread switches never enter the kernel
Thread switches do not save registers
Threads have no stack of their own
en.explain: Registers and the stack pointer are still saved; the saving is the page-table switch and the TLB and cache misses it causes. Kernel threads still switch inside the kernel.

zh.q: 分页（paging）内存管理消除了哪一种碎片？
zh.explain: 任何空闲页框都能装任何页，所以不会出现“总空闲够但不连续”的外部碎片；但进程最后一页用不满，仍有内部碎片。

en.q: Which kind of fragmentation does paging eliminate?
en.explain: Any free frame can hold any page, so there is no 'enough free memory but not contiguous' external fragmentation; the last page of a process is partly unused, which is internal fragmentation.

zh.q: 有 3 个页框、初始为空，访问序列 1 2 3 4 1 2 5 1 2 3 4 5，用 LRU 置换一共发生多少次缺页？
zh.explain: 逐步模拟：前 7 次访问（1 2 3 4 1 2 5）全部缺页，接着 1、2 命中，3、4、5 又各缺一次，共 10 次。

en.q: With 3 initially empty frames and the reference string 1 2 3 4 1 2 5 1 2 3 4 5, how many page faults does LRU incur?
en.explain: Simulate it: the first seven references (1 2 3 4 1 2 5) all fault, 1 and 2 then hit, and 3, 4 and 5 fault again: 10 in total.

zh.q: Belady 异常（增加页框反而缺页更多）会出现在哪种置换算法中？
zh.explain: LRU 和 OPT 都是“栈算法”，k 个页框里的页总是 k+1 个页框里页的子集，所以不会出现异常；FIFO 不满足这一点。

en.q: Which page replacement policy can show Belady's anomaly (more frames, more faults)?
en.explain: LRU and OPT are stack algorithms: the pages held with k frames are always a subset of those held with k+1, so they cannot show the anomaly. FIFO is not.

zh.q: 下列哪个操作一定需要系统调用（进入内核态）？
zh.explain: 访问文件要经过内核管理的设备和文件系统，只能通过 read 等系统调用；其余几项都在用户态完成。

en.q: Which of these always needs a system call (a switch to kernel mode)?
en.explain: Files live behind kernel-managed devices and file systems, reachable only through calls such as read; the rest happen in user mode.

zh.q: “僵尸进程”指的是？
choices: 被挂起到磁盘上的进程
占用 CPU 却没有进展的进程
已经退出、但父进程还没调用 wait 回收的子进程
父进程先退出、被 init 收养的进程
zh.explain: 子进程退出后保留进程表项和退出码，直到父进程 wait。父进程先退出、被 init 收养的是孤儿进程。

en.q: What is a zombie process?
choices: A process swapped out to disk
A process that burns CPU without making progress
A child that exited but whose parent has not called wait on it
A process whose parent exited and that init adopted
en.explain: An exited child keeps its process-table entry and exit status until the parent waits on it. One adopted by init after its parent exits is an orphan.

zh.q: TLB 缓存的是什么？
choices: 虚拟页号到物理页框号的映射
zh.explain: TLB 是页表的硬件缓存，命中时不用访问内存中的页表就能完成地址转换。缓存数据的是 L1/L2/L3。

en.q: What does the TLB cache?
choices: Virtual page to physical frame translations
en.explain: The TLB is a hardware cache of the page table, so a hit translates an address without walking the page table in memory. Data goes in the L1/L2/L3 caches.

zh.q: 32 位虚拟地址、页大小 4 KB，页内偏移占多少位？
zh.explain: 4 KB = 2^12 字节，所以偏移 12 位，剩下 20 位是页号（2^20 个页）。

en.q: With 32-bit virtual addresses and 4 KB pages, how many bits is the page offset?
en.explain: 4 KB = 2^12 bytes, so the offset is 12 bits and the remaining 20 bits are the page number (2^20 pages).

zh.q: 时间片轮转（RR）调度中，如果时间片设得非常大，它会退化成？
zh.explain: 时间片比任何作业都长时，每个作业都能一次跑完，顺序就是到达顺序，即 FCFS。

en.q: In round-robin scheduling, what does a very large time quantum degenerate into?
en.explain: With a quantum longer than every job, each runs to completion in arrival order: FCFS.

zh.q: fork 使用写时复制（copy-on-write）的效果是？
choices: 父子进程先共享物理页，有一方写入时才复制那一页
fork 时立即复制整个地址空间
父进程的写入对子进程可见
zh.explain: 页先标成只读共享，写入触发异常后内核只复制被写的那一页，各自之后的修改互不可见。紧接着 exec 的场景几乎不用复制。

en.q: What does copy-on-write do for fork?
choices: Parent and child share pages until one writes, then only that page is copied
fork copies the whole address space at once
The parent's writes become visible to the child
The child can only read memory
en.explain: Pages are shared read-only; a write faults and the kernel copies just that page, so later writes stay private. A fork followed by exec copies almost nothing.

zh.q: DMA（直接内存访问）的主要好处是？
choices: 设备和内存之间传输数据时不需要 CPU 逐字节搬运
zh.explain: CPU 只需设置好传输，DMA 控制器完成搬运后发一个中断通知，CPU 期间可以做别的事。

en.q: What is the main benefit of DMA?
choices: Devices move data to and from memory without the CPU copying each byte
en.explain: The CPU sets up the transfer, the DMA controller moves the data and raises one interrupt when done, and the CPU is free meanwhile.

zh.q: 在“多对一”用户级线程模型里，一个线程发起阻塞式系统调用，会怎样？
choices: 内核为它新建一个内核线程
整个进程（所有线程）都被阻塞
系统调用自动变成非阻塞
zh.explain: 内核只看到一个可调度实体，它一阻塞，进程里其他用户线程也无法运行。一对一模型（如 Linux pthread）没有这个问题。

en.q: In the many-to-one user-level thread model, what happens when one thread makes a blocking system call?
choices: The kernel creates a kernel thread for it
The whole process, every thread, blocks
en.explain: The kernel sees one schedulable entity; when it blocks, no other user thread in the process can run. The one-to-one model (Linux pthreads) avoids this.

zh.q: 深度递归最常见的崩溃原因是？
zh.explain: 每层调用都在栈上压一个栈帧，栈的大小有限（常见 1–8 MB），超出即栈溢出。

en.q: What usually crashes a very deep recursion?
en.explain: Each call pushes a frame onto a fixed-size stack (often 1–8 MB); going past it overflows the stack.

zh.q: 父进程先于子进程退出后，子进程会怎样？
choices: 被 init（PID 1）或子收割者收养
zh.explain: 这种进程叫孤儿进程，会被重新挂到 init 或设置了 subreaper 的祖先下，由它负责 wait 回收。

en.q: What happens to a child process when its parent exits first?
choices: It is adopted by init (PID 1) or a subreaper
en.explain: It becomes an orphan and is re-parented to init or a subreaper ancestor, which will wait on it.

zh.q: ACID 中的 I 代表什么？
zh.explain: ACID 是原子性、一致性、隔离性、持久性。隔离性指并发事务彼此看不到对方未完成的中间状态（程度由隔离级别决定）。

en.q: What does the I in ACID stand for?
en.explain: ACID is atomicity, consistency, isolation and durability. Isolation means concurrent transactions do not see each other's unfinished work, to a degree set by the isolation level.

zh.q: 哪个隔离级别能防止脏读，但仍允许不可重复读？
zh.explain: 读已提交只读到已提交的数据，但同一事务两次读同一行之间，别的事务可以提交修改，所以两次结果可能不同。

en.q: Which isolation level prevents dirty reads but still allows non-repeatable reads?
en.explain: Read committed only sees committed data, but another transaction can commit a change between two reads of the same row, so they can differ.

zh.q: 按 SQL 标准，哪个隔离级别才能保证不出现幻读？
zh.explain: 标准里可重复读仍允许幻读（范围查询多出新插入的行），只有可串行化排除全部三种异常。个别引擎（如 InnoDB 的间隙锁）在可重复读下也能挡住大部分幻读，但那是实现细节。

en.q: Under the SQL standard, which isolation level is guaranteed to prevent phantom reads?
en.explain: The standard lets repeatable read show phantoms (new rows in a range query); only serializable rules out all three anomalies. Some engines, such as InnoDB with gap locks, block most phantoms at repeatable read, but that is an implementation detail.

zh.q: 第二范式（2NF）要消除的是？
choices: 非主属性之间的传递依赖
非主属性对复合主键的部分依赖
zh.explain: 1NF 要求原子值，2NF 去掉部分依赖，3NF 再去掉传递依赖。

en.q: What does second normal form (2NF) remove?
choices: Non-key attributes depending on only part of a composite key
en.explain: 1NF requires atomic values, 2NF removes partial dependencies and 3NF removes transitive ones.

zh.q: 表 Employee(emp_id, dept_id, dept_name)，主键 emp_id，dept_id 决定 dept_name。它违反了哪个范式？
zh.explain: emp_id → dept_id → dept_name 是传递依赖，违反 3NF；主键只有一列，不存在部分依赖，所以满足 2NF。应把部门拆成单独的表。

en.q: Employee(emp_id, dept_id, dept_name) has key emp_id, and dept_id determines dept_name. Which normal form does it violate?
en.explain: emp_id → dept_id → dept_name is a transitive dependency, which breaks 3NF; a single-column key cannot have partial dependencies, so 2NF holds. Split departments into their own table.

zh.q: 关于主键（PRIMARY KEY）和唯一约束（UNIQUE），哪些说法正确？（多选）
choices: UNIQUE 列一律不能为 NULL
一张表最多一个 UNIQUE 约束
zh.explain: 主键隐含 NOT NULL 且只能有一个；UNIQUE 约束可以有多个，大多数数据库允许 UNIQUE 列存多个 NULL。

en.q: Which statements about PRIMARY KEY and UNIQUE are true? (Select all that apply)
choices: A primary key column cannot be NULL
A table has at most one primary key
A UNIQUE column can never be NULL
A table has at most one UNIQUE constraint
en.explain: A primary key implies NOT NULL and there is only one; a table can have many UNIQUE constraints, and most databases allow several NULLs in a UNIQUE column.

zh.q: 数据库更常用 B+ 树而不是哈希做通用索引，主要因为？
choices: B+ 树支持范围查询和有序遍历
哈希索引不能建在整数列上
B+ 树的等值查找一定更快
zh.explain: B+ 树叶子节点有序并相互链接，适合 BETWEEN、ORDER BY、前缀匹配；哈希只适合等值查找，且等值查找通常哈希更快。

en.q: Why do databases usually prefer B+ trees over hash indexes for general-purpose indexing?
choices: B+ trees support range queries and ordered scans
B+ trees use no disk space
B+ trees are always faster for equality lookups
en.explain: B+ tree leaves are sorted and linked, which suits BETWEEN, ORDER BY and prefix matches; a hash only answers equality, where it is usually faster.

zh.q: 关于聚簇索引，哪项说法正确？
choices: 一张表可以有任意多个
它决定表中行的物理存储顺序，一张表最多一个
zh.explain: 数据按聚簇索引的键排序存放，行只能按一种顺序存，所以最多一个。InnoDB 中主键就是聚簇索引。

en.q: Which statement about a clustered index is true?
choices: A table can have any number of them
It stores only the primary key
It sets the physical order of rows, so a table has at most one
en.explain: Rows are stored in clustered-key order, and they can only be stored in one order. In InnoDB the primary key is the clustered index.

zh.q: A 表有 5 行。SELECT * FROM A LEFT JOIN B ON ... 至少返回多少行？
choices: 取决于 B 的行数
zh.explain: 左连接保留左表每一行：没有匹配的行也会出现一次（右边补 NULL），有多个匹配的行会出现多次，所以至少 5 行。

en.q: Table A has 5 rows. At least how many rows does SELECT * FROM A LEFT JOIN B ON ... return?
choices: Depends on the size of B
en.explain: A left join keeps every left row: unmatched rows appear once with NULLs on the right and rows with several matches appear several times, so at least 5.

zh.q: 列 x 的值为 1、NULL、2、NULL。COUNT(*) 和 COUNT(x) 分别是？
zh.explain: COUNT(*) 数行数；COUNT(x) 只数 x 不为 NULL 的行。

en.q: Column x holds 1, NULL, 2, NULL. What are COUNT(*) and COUNT(x)?
en.explain: COUNT(*) counts rows; COUNT(x) counts only rows where x is not NULL.

zh.q: 要筛出“订单数超过 10 的客户”，条件应该写在哪里？
choices: GROUP BY 之后的 HAVING COUNT(*) > 10
zh.explain: WHERE 在分组之前逐行过滤，不能用聚合函数；HAVING 在分组之后过滤组。

en.q: To keep only customers with more than 10 orders, where does the condition go?
en.explain: WHERE filters rows before grouping and cannot use aggregates; HAVING filters groups after GROUP BY.

zh.q: 标准 SQL 中，哪个子句可以引用 SELECT 列表里定义的别名？
zh.explain: 逻辑执行顺序是 FROM → WHERE → GROUP BY → HAVING → SELECT → ORDER BY，只有 ORDER BY 在 SELECT 之后。（MySQL 等方言额外放宽了 GROUP BY/HAVING。）

en.q: In standard SQL, which clause can refer to an alias defined in the SELECT list?
en.explain: The logical order is FROM → WHERE → GROUP BY → HAVING → SELECT → ORDER BY, and only ORDER BY comes after SELECT. (Some dialects such as MySQL also allow it in GROUP BY and HAVING.)

zh.q: SELECT * FROM t WHERE x = NULL 会返回什么？
choices: x 为 NULL 的所有行
zh.explain: 任何值和 NULL 用 = 比较的结果都是 UNKNOWN，WHERE 只保留 TRUE 的行。要写 x IS NULL。

en.q: What does SELECT * FROM t WHERE x = NULL return?
choices: Every row where x is NULL
en.explain: Comparing anything with NULL using = yields UNKNOWN, and WHERE keeps only TRUE rows. Write x IS NULL.

zh.q: 两阶段锁协议（2PL）保证了什么？
zh.explain: 先只加锁、后只解锁，能保证调度冲突可串行化，但仍可能死锁；严格 2PL（提交时才释放写锁）才避免级联回滚。

en.q: What does two-phase locking (2PL) guarantee?
en.explain: Acquiring all locks before releasing any guarantees conflict serializability but can still deadlock; strict 2PL, which holds write locks until commit, is what avoids cascading aborts.

zh.q: 预写日志（WAL）的核心规则是？
choices: 数据页必须先于日志写到磁盘
修改的日志记录必须先于对应数据页写到磁盘
zh.explain: 先落盘日志，崩溃后就能用日志重做已提交、撤销未提交的修改，保证原子性和持久性。

en.q: What is the core rule of write-ahead logging (WAL)?
choices: The log is written only at shutdown
Data pages are written before the log
A change is logged to disk before the data page it changes
en.explain: With the log on disk first, recovery can redo committed changes and undo uncommitted ones, which gives atomicity and durability.

zh.q: 外键（FOREIGN KEY）约束的作用是？
choices: 引用完整性：引用的值必须在被引用表的键中存在
该列自动建立聚簇索引
zh.explain: 外键列的非 NULL 值必须对应被引用表某行的主键或唯一键；外键本身可以重复，也可以为 NULL。

en.q: What does a FOREIGN KEY constraint enforce?
choices: Values in the column are unique
Referential integrity: referenced values must exist as a key in the other table
The column gets a clustered index
en.explain: Non-NULL values must match a primary or unique key in the referenced table; the foreign key itself may repeat and may be NULL.

zh.q: 关于给表加索引，哪项说法是错误的？
choices: 它会让 INSERT 和 UPDATE 变慢
它总能让任何查询变快
它能加速按该列的查找
zh.explain: 每次写入都要维护索引，还占空间；查询返回大部分行时，优化器往往宁可全表扫描，索引并不总有用。

en.q: Which statement about adding an index is FALSE?
choices: It slows down INSERT and UPDATE
It always makes every query faster
It can speed up lookups on that column
en.explain: Every write must maintain the index and it takes space; when a query returns most rows the optimiser often prefers a full scan, so an index does not always help.

zh.q: UNION 和 UNION ALL 的区别是？
choices: UNION ALL 去重，UNION 保留重复行
UNION 去重，UNION ALL 保留重复行
zh.explain: UNION 需要额外排序或哈希去重，所以不需要去重时 UNION ALL 更快。

en.q: How do UNION and UNION ALL differ?
choices: UNION ALL removes duplicates; UNION keeps them
UNION removes duplicates; UNION ALL keeps them
en.explain: UNION needs an extra sort or hash to remove duplicates, so UNION ALL is faster when duplicates do not matter.

zh.q: 在 (a, b) 上建了复合 B+ 树索引。哪些查询条件能高效利用它？（多选）
zh.explain: 复合索引按 a 排序、a 相同再按 b 排序，满足最左前缀才能定位；只给 b 或对列做运算都用不上有序性。

en.q: There is a composite B+ tree index on (a, b). Which predicates can use it efficiently? (Select all that apply)
en.explain: The index is sorted by a, then b within equal a, so it needs the leftmost prefix; b alone, or an expression over the columns, cannot use that order.

zh.q: 按 CAP 定理，发生网络分区时，分布式系统只能在哪两者之间取舍？
zh.explain: 分区是无法避免的事实；出现分区时，要么拒绝部分请求（保一致），要么允许各分区各自响应（保可用）。

en.q: By the CAP theorem, during a network partition a distributed system must choose between which two?
en.explain: Partitions happen regardless; during one, a system either refuses some requests (consistent) or lets each side answer on its own (available).

zh.q: 乐观并发控制通常怎样发现冲突？
choices: 不检测，后写的覆盖先写的
提交时检查版本号或时间戳是否被别人改过
zh.explain: 读时不加锁，更新时带上 WHERE version = 旧版本；影响 0 行说明有人先改了，需要重试。适合冲突少的场景。

en.q: How does optimistic concurrency control usually detect a conflict?
choices: It does not; the last write wins
By taking an exclusive lock before reading
At commit, by checking whether a version number or timestamp changed
en.explain: Reads take no locks; the update says WHERE version = the old version, and zero affected rows means someone got there first, so retry. It suits low-contention workloads.

zh.q: 防止 SQL 注入最可靠的做法是？
choices: 把单引号替换成两个单引号
参数化查询（预编译语句）
zh.explain: 参数化查询让用户输入只作为数据传给数据库，永远不会被解析成 SQL；手工转义容易遗漏编码和边界情况，前端校验可以绕过。

en.q: What is the most reliable defence against SQL injection?
choices: Validating input in the front end
en.explain: Parameters reach the database as data and are never parsed as SQL; hand escaping misses encodings and edge cases, and front-end checks are easy to bypass.

zh.q: 下列哪种应用最常直接使用 UDP？
zh.explain: 一次 DNS 查询通常一问一答、报文很小，用 UDP 省去握手；HTTP/1.1、SSH、SMTP 都需要可靠有序的字节流，用 TCP。

en.q: Which of these most commonly runs directly over UDP?
en.explain: A DNS lookup is one small request and reply, so UDP saves the handshake; HTTP/1.1, SSH and SMTP need a reliable ordered stream and use TCP.

zh.q: TCP 三次握手的报文顺序是？
zh.explain: 客户端发 SYN，服务器回 SYN-ACK，客户端再回 ACK，双方确认了彼此的初始序列号。

en.q: What is the order of segments in the TCP three-way handshake?
en.explain: The client sends SYN, the server answers SYN-ACK and the client acknowledges with ACK, so both sides have confirmed each other's initial sequence numbers.

zh.q: IP 协议属于 TCP/IP 模型的哪一层？
zh.explain: IP 负责跨网络的寻址和路由，属于网络层（OSI 第 3 层）；TCP/UDP 在它上面的传输层。

en.q: Which layer of the TCP/IP model does IP belong to?
en.explain: IP handles addressing and routing across networks, the network layer (OSI layer 3); TCP and UDP sit above it in the transport layer.

zh.q: 服务器暂时过载、希望客户端稍后重试，最合适的 HTTP 状态码是？
zh.explain: 503 Service Unavailable 表示暂时不可用，可以配合 Retry-After 头；500 是笼统的服务器错误，404 是资源不存在，301 是永久重定向。

en.q: A server is temporarily overloaded and wants the client to retry later. Which status code fits best?
en.explain: 503 Service Unavailable means temporarily unavailable and can carry Retry-After; 500 is a generic server error, 404 not found and 301 a permanent redirect.

zh.q: ARP 协议的作用是？
choices: 给主机分配 IP 地址
在路由器之间交换路由表
把域名解析成 IP 地址
在局域网内把 IP 地址解析成 MAC 地址
zh.explain: 要在以太网上把包交给同一网段的主机或网关，需要对方的 MAC 地址，ARP 广播询问得到。域名解析是 DNS，分配地址是 DHCP。

en.q: What does ARP do?
choices: Resolves a domain name to an IP address
Resolves an IP address to a MAC address on the local network
en.explain: To hand a frame to a host or gateway on the same segment you need its MAC address, which ARP asks for by broadcast. Names are DNS; address assignment is DHCP.

zh.q: 一个 /24 子网最多有多少个可分配给主机的地址？
zh.explain: 主机位 8 位，2^8 = 256 个地址，去掉网络地址和广播地址剩 254 个。

en.q: How many usable host addresses does a /24 subnet have?
en.explain: 8 host bits give 2^8 = 256 addresses; minus the network and broadcast addresses leaves 254.

zh.q: 一个 /26 子网最多有多少个可用主机地址？

en.q: How many usable host addresses does a /26 subnet have?

zh.q: TCP 连接关闭后进入 TIME_WAIT 状态的是哪一方？
zh.explain: 主动关闭方发出最后一个 ACK 后等待 2MSL，确保对方收到 ACK，并让旧连接的迟到报文消失。

en.q: Which side of a TCP connection enters TIME_WAIT after it closes?
choices: The side that closes first (active close)
en.explain: The active closer sends the final ACK and waits 2×MSL so the peer gets it and stray segments of the old connection die out.

zh.q: HTTPS 默认使用哪个端口？
zh.explain: HTTP 是 80，HTTPS 是 443，SSH 是 22，8080 只是常见的备用 HTTP 端口。

en.q: Which port does HTTPS use by default?
en.explain: HTTP is 80, HTTPS 443 and SSH 22; 8080 is just a common alternative HTTP port.

zh.q: 交换机和路由器分别主要工作在哪一层？
choices: 交换机第 3 层，路由器第 2 层
交换机第 2 层，路由器第 3 层
zh.explain: （二层）交换机按 MAC 地址转发帧，路由器按 IP 地址在网络之间转发包。三层交换机兼有路由功能。

en.q: At which layers do a switch and a router mainly work?
choices: Switch at layer 3, router at layer 2
Switch at layer 2, router at layer 3
en.explain: A (layer-2) switch forwards frames by MAC address; a router forwards packets between networks by IP address. Layer-3 switches also route.

zh.q: TCP 的流量控制（flow control）主要防止什么？
choices: 发送方发得太快、接收方缓冲区溢出
zh.explain: 接收方在 ACK 里通告接收窗口，发送方未确认的数据不超过它。防止网络拥塞的是拥塞控制（cwnd）。

en.q: What does TCP flow control prevent?
choices: A fast sender overflowing the receiver's buffer
en.explain: The receiver advertises a window in its ACKs and the sender keeps unacknowledged data within it. Network congestion is the job of congestion control (cwnd).

zh.q: TCP 慢启动阶段，拥塞窗口 cwnd 大致怎样增长？
choices: 每个 RTT 翻倍（指数增长）
每个 RTT 加 1（线性增长）
zh.explain: 每收到一个 ACK，cwnd 加 1 个 MSS，相当于每个 RTT 翻倍，直到达到 ssthresh 后转入线性增长的拥塞避免。

en.q: During TCP slow start, how does the congestion window grow?
choices: It grows by one segment per RTT (linear)
en.explain: Each ACK adds one MSS, which doubles cwnd per RTT until it reaches ssthresh; then congestion avoidance grows it linearly.

zh.q: TLS（HTTPS）提供了哪些保障？（多选）
choices: 隐藏你访问的服务器 IP
zh.explain: TLS 加密并校验每条记录，用证书验证服务器；但 IP 包头不加密，网络上仍能看到你连的是哪个 IP。

en.q: Which guarantees does TLS (HTTPS) provide? (Select all that apply)
choices: Hiding which server IP you contact
en.explain: TLS encrypts and authenticates each record and checks the server certificate; IP headers stay in the clear, so the network still sees which IP you contact.

zh.q: 按 HTTP 规范，下列哪些方法是幂等的？（多选）
zh.explain: 幂等指重复同一请求和只发一次效果相同。PUT 整体替换、DELETE 删除，重复做结果一样；POST 每次可能新建一个资源。

en.q: Which HTTP methods are idempotent by the spec? (Select all that apply)
en.explain: Idempotent means repeating a request has the same effect as sending it once. PUT replaces and DELETE removes, so repeats change nothing more; each POST may create a new resource.

zh.q: 下列哪些是私有（内网）IPv4 地址？（多选）

en.q: Which are private IPv4 addresses? (Select all that apply)

zh.q: 在 100 Mbps 的链路上发送 1 MB（10^6 字节）的数据，传输时延（不计传播时延）约为？

en.q: How long does it take to put 1 MB (10^6 bytes) onto a 100 Mbps link, ignoring propagation delay?
en.explain: 10^6 bytes = 8×10^6 bits; divided by 10^8 bits/s that is 0.08 s = 80 ms. Mind the factor of 8 between bytes and bits.

zh.q: HTTP/2 相比 HTTP/1.1 的主要改进是？
choices: 在一个 TCP 连接上多路复用多个请求
不再需要 TLS 证书
zh.explain: HTTP/2 用二进制分帧，多个流共用一个连接并压缩头部；但 TCP 层丢包仍会阻塞所有流，HTTP/3 才改用基于 UDP 的 QUIC。

en.q: What is the main improvement of HTTP/2 over HTTP/1.1?
choices: Multiplexing many requests over one TCP connection
en.explain: HTTP/2 uses binary frames so many streams share one connection, with header compression; a TCP loss still stalls every stream, which is why HTTP/3 moved to QUIC over UDP.

zh.q: ping 命令使用的是哪个协议？
zh.explain: ping 发送 ICMP Echo Request 并等待 Echo Reply，没有端口的概念。

en.q: Which protocol does ping use?
en.explain: ping sends ICMP Echo Requests and waits for Echo Replies; there are no ports involved.

zh.q: NAT（网络地址转换）主要解决什么问题？
choices: 让多台使用私有地址的主机共享一个公网 IP
zh.explain: NAT 改写出站包的源地址和端口，并记录映射以便把回包送回内网主机，缓解了 IPv4 地址不足。

en.q: What problem does NAT mainly solve?
choices: Letting many hosts with private addresses share one public IP
en.explain: NAT rewrites the source address and port of outgoing packets and keeps a mapping to route replies back, which eases IPv4 address exhaustion.

zh.q: WebSocket 连接是怎样建立的？
choices: 先发一个带 Upgrade 头的 HTTP 请求，之后在同一 TCP 连接上全双工通信
每条消息一个新的 HTTP 请求
zh.explain: 服务器返回 101 Switching Protocols 后，连接就不再按 HTTP 请求-响应工作，双方都能随时发消息。

en.q: How is a WebSocket connection established?
choices: An HTTP request with an Upgrade header, then full-duplex messages on the same TCP connection
One new HTTP request per message
en.explain: After the server answers 101 Switching Protocols, the connection stops being HTTP request-response and either side can send at any time.

zh.q: DHCP 的主要作用是？
choices: 自动为主机分配 IP 地址、网关和 DNS 等配置
把 IP 解析成 MAC
zh.explain: 主机启动时广播 DHCP Discover，服务器提供带租期的地址和网络配置。

en.q: What is DHCP mainly for?
choices: Giving hosts an IP address, gateway, DNS and other settings automatically
en.explain: A booting host broadcasts DHCP Discover and a server offers a leased address plus network settings.

zh.q: 两个线程各执行 1000 次 count++（count 初值 0，没有任何同步）。最终 count 的值？
zh.explain: count++ 是“读-加-写”三步，两个线程交错时一次更新会覆盖另一次，结果可能小于 2000；也可能恰好没交错而得到 2000，但不会超过 2000。

en.q: Two threads each run count++ 1000 times on a shared count starting at 0, with no synchronisation. What is the final value?
en.explain: count++ is read, add, write; interleaved, one update overwrites another, so the result can be below 2000. It can also come out at exactly 2000, but never above.

zh.q: 线程 A 持有锁 L1 等待 L2，线程 B 持有 L2 等待 L1。最简单可靠的修复是？
choices: 所有线程按同一个全局顺序加锁（先 L1 后 L2）
把锁换成 volatile 变量
zh.explain: 固定加锁顺序就不会形成循环等待，破坏了死锁的必要条件之一。sleep 只是降低概率。

en.q: Thread A holds lock L1 and waits for L2; thread B holds L2 and waits for L1. What is the simplest reliable fix?
choices: Make every thread take locks in one global order (L1, then L2)
Replace the locks with volatile variables
en.explain: A fixed lock order makes circular wait impossible, removing one of the necessary conditions. Sleeps only make it rarer.

zh.q: 初值为 3 的计数信号量保护一段代码，最多有几个线程能同时在里面？
zh.explain: 每个线程进入时 P（减 1），减到 0 后后来者阻塞，离开时 V（加 1），所以最多 3 个。

en.q: A counting semaphore initialised to 3 guards a section. At most how many threads can be inside at once?
en.explain: Each entering thread decrements it; at 0 the next one blocks, and each leaving thread increments it, so at most 3.

zh.q: 使用条件变量时，wait() 为什么要放在 while 循环里检查条件？
choices: 为了让 CPU 空转等待
wait 只能在循环里编译通过
可能有虚假唤醒，或者被唤醒时条件已被别的线程改变
zh.explain: POSIX 和 Java 都允许虚假唤醒；而且 notify 到重新拿到锁之间，别的线程可能已经把条件消费掉，所以醒来要重新检查。

en.q: Why should a condition-variable wait() sit inside a while loop that rechecks the condition?
choices: To spin the CPU while waiting
wait only compiles inside a loop
Wake-ups can be spurious, or another thread may have changed the condition first
en.explain: POSIX and Java both allow spurious wake-ups, and between the notify and reacquiring the lock another thread may have consumed the condition, so recheck on waking.

zh.q: “活锁”（livelock）指的是？
choices: 线程互相等待对方释放锁而全部阻塞
低优先级线程永远得不到 CPU
线程运行太快导致数据竞争
线程都在运行、不断响应对方而改变状态，但谁都没有进展
zh.explain: 和死锁的区别是线程没有阻塞，仍在忙着“谦让”。全部阻塞地互相等待是死锁，低优先级线程一直轮不到是饥饿。

en.q: What is a livelock?
choices: Threads all block waiting for each other's locks
A low-priority thread never gets the CPU
Threads run so fast they race on data
Threads keep running and reacting to each other, but none makes progress
en.explain: Unlike deadlock, nobody is blocked; they are busy stepping aside for each other. Everyone blocked waiting on each other is deadlock; a low-priority thread that never runs is starvation.

zh.q: Java 中把计数器声明为 volatile int count，再在多个线程里执行 count++，结果会怎样？
choices: 每个线程只看到自己的副本
仍然可能丢失更新，因为 ++ 不是原子操作
zh.explain: volatile 保证可见性和有序性，不保证“读-改-写”的原子性。用 AtomicInteger 或加锁。

en.q: In Java, count is declared volatile int and several threads run count++. What happens?
choices: Each thread only sees its own copy
Updates can still be lost, because ++ is not atomic
en.explain: volatile gives visibility and ordering, not atomic read-modify-write. Use AtomicInteger or a lock.

zh.q: 读写锁（read-write lock）允许的情形是？
choices: 任何时候只允许一个线程
多个读者同时持有，或一个写者独占
zh.explain: 读不改数据，可以并发；写需要独占，既排斥其他写者也排斥读者。读多写少时比普通互斥锁并发度更高。

en.q: What does a read-write lock allow?
choices: Only one thread at any time
Many readers together, or one writer alone
en.explain: Readers do not change data, so they can share; a writer needs exclusive access against readers and writers. It beats a plain mutex when reads dominate.

zh.q: 基于 CAS（compare-and-swap）的无锁栈可能遇到什么经典问题？
zh.explain: 值从 A 变成 B 又变回 A，CAS 只比较值会误以为没变。常用带版本号的指针（如 AtomicStampedReference）解决。

en.q: Which classic problem can a lock-free stack built on CAS run into?
en.explain: A value goes A → B → A and a value-only CAS thinks nothing changed. Tagged or versioned pointers (AtomicStampedReference, say) fix it.

zh.q: 自旋锁（spinlock）在什么情况下比阻塞式互斥锁更合适？
choices: 多核机器上、临界区非常短
zh.explain: 临界区很短时，忙等几十个周期比让线程睡眠再唤醒（两次上下文切换）便宜；单核上自旋只会浪费持锁线程需要的 CPU。

en.q: When is a spinlock a better fit than a blocking mutex?
choices: On a multicore machine with a very short critical section
When the lock is held for a long time
When the critical section does disk I/O
en.explain: For a very short section, spinning a few dozen cycles is cheaper than sleeping and waking (two context switches); on one core spinning only burns the CPU the lock holder needs.

zh.q: 在默认（带 GIL）的 CPython 中，想用多核加速 CPU 密集型计算，通常应该？
zh.explain: GIL 让同一时刻只有一个线程执行 Python 字节码，线程只适合 I/O 密集任务；每个进程有自己的解释器和 GIL，可以真正并行。（3.13 起另有实验性的无 GIL 构建。）

en.q: In default CPython (with the GIL), how do you usually use several cores for CPU-bound work?
en.explain: The GIL lets one thread run Python bytecode at a time, so threads only help I/O-bound work; each process has its own interpreter and GIL and truly runs in parallel. (3.13 adds an experimental free-threaded build.)

zh.q: 可重入锁（reentrant lock）的特点是？
choices: 已持有它的线程可以再次获取而不会把自己锁死
任何线程都可以释放它
zh.explain: 可重入锁记录持有者和重入次数，同一线程再获取只加计数，释放同样次数后才真正解锁。Java 的 synchronized 和 ReentrantLock 都是可重入的。

en.q: What makes a lock reentrant?
choices: The thread holding it can acquire it again without deadlocking itself
en.explain: It records the owner and a hold count; the owner re-acquiring just bumps the count, and it unlocks after as many releases. Java's synchronized and ReentrantLock are both reentrant.

zh.q: 一个线程对同一把不可重入的互斥锁连续调用两次 lock()，会发生什么？
choices: 第二次调用永远阻塞（自死锁）
zh.explain: 锁已被自己持有，第二次 lock 等待持有者释放，而持有者正是自己，所以永远等不到。（有的实现会检测并报错，但不能指望。）

en.q: A thread calls lock() twice in a row on the same non-reentrant mutex. What happens?
choices: The second call returns at once
en.explain: The lock is held by the caller, so the second lock waits for the holder, which is itself. Some implementations detect it and fail, but you cannot rely on that.

zh.q: 用信号量实现有界缓冲区的生产者-消费者，通常需要哪几个信号量？
choices: empty（初值 N）、full（初值 0）和一个互斥锁
zh.explain: 生产者先 P(empty) 再加锁放入、V(full)；消费者先 P(full) 再加锁取出、V(empty)。互斥锁保护缓冲区本身的下标。

en.q: A bounded-buffer producer-consumer built on semaphores usually needs which semaphores?
choices: empty and full, both starting at 0
empty (starts at N), full (starts at 0) and a mutex
en.explain: Producers P(empty), lock, insert, V(full); consumers P(full), lock, remove, V(empty). The mutex protects the buffer's indices.

zh.q: 哲学家就餐问题中，哪种做法可以避免死锁？
choices: 让其中一位哲学家先拿右手边、其他人先拿左手边的叉子
增加每个人吃饭的时间
每个人都先拿左手边的叉子
zh.explain: 所有人同时拿起左叉就形成循环等待；有一个人顺序相反，环就断了（等价于给资源规定全局顺序）。

en.q: In the dining philosophers problem, which change avoids deadlock?
choices: One philosopher picks up the right fork first; everyone else picks up the left first
Everyone picks up the left fork first
Wait for as long as it takes
en.explain: If everyone lifts the left fork together, the wait is circular; one philosopher going the other way breaks the cycle, the same as a global resource order.

zh.q: 程序 90% 的部分可以完美并行。按 Amdahl 定律，用 4 个核最多加速约多少倍？

en.q: A program is 90% perfectly parallelisable. By Amdahl's law, what is the best speed-up on 4 cores?
en.explain: Speed-up = 1 / (0.1 + 0.9/4) = 1 / 0.325 ≈ 3.08. With unlimited cores the ceiling is 1/0.1 = 10×.

zh.q: 单线程事件循环（如 Node.js、asyncio）提供的是？
choices: 自动避免所有竞态条件
多核并行执行 JavaScript/Python 代码
并发（交替推进多个任务），但不是并行
zh.explain: 任务在 await/回调处让出，单线程交替处理大量 I/O；计算本身仍在一个线程上。await 之间也可能交错，竞态依然存在。

en.q: What does a single-threaded event loop (Node.js, asyncio) provide?
choices: Parallel execution of JavaScript/Python on many cores
Concurrency (interleaving many tasks) but not parallelism
en.explain: Tasks yield at await or callbacks, so one thread juggles lots of I/O; computation still runs on one thread. Tasks interleave across awaits, so races still exist.

zh.q: 优先级反转是指？
choices: 调度器把优先级排反了
高优先级线程等待被低优先级线程持有的锁，而中优先级线程抢占了低优先级线程
低优先级线程永远不运行
zh.explain: 结果是高优先级线程实际被中优先级线程拖住。常用优先级继承：持锁的低优先级线程临时继承等待者的高优先级。

en.q: What is priority inversion?
choices: Two threads wait on each other
A high-priority thread waits on a lock held by a low-priority one, which a medium-priority thread keeps preempting
en.explain: The high-priority thread is effectively held up by the medium one. Priority inheritance fixes it: the lock holder temporarily inherits the waiter's priority.

zh.q: Java 中双重检查锁定（double-checked locking）的单例，实例字段为什么要声明为 volatile？
choices: 让构造函数只运行一次
防止指令重排让别的线程看到未初始化完的对象
zh.explain: “分配内存、构造、赋值引用”可能被重排成先赋值，另一个线程在第一次检查时就拿到未构造完的对象。volatile 禁止这种重排。

en.q: In Java double-checked locking for a singleton, why must the instance field be volatile?
choices: To make the constructor run once
To stop reordering from exposing a partly constructed object to other threads
en.explain: 'Allocate, construct, publish' can be reordered so the reference is published first, and another thread's first check returns a half-built object. volatile forbids that reordering.

zh.q: 屏障（barrier）同步的作用是？
choices: 让一组线程都到达某一点后才一起继续
保证只有一个线程进入临界区
阻止编译器重排内存访问
zh.explain: 常用于分阶段的并行计算：每个线程算完本阶段后在屏障等，全部到齐再进入下一阶段（如 Java 的 CyclicBarrier）。

en.q: What does a barrier do?
choices: Holds a group of threads until all reach a point, then releases them together
Lets only one thread into a critical section
Stops the compiler reordering memory accesses
en.explain: Used for phased parallel work: each thread finishes the phase, waits at the barrier, and all start the next phase together (Java's CyclicBarrier).

zh.q: 使用线程池而不是每个任务新建线程，主要好处有哪些？（多选）
choices: 任务一定按提交顺序完成
复用线程，省去反复创建销毁的开销
限制并发线程数，防止资源耗尽
zh.explain: 线程池解决的是开销和容量问题；任务之间共享数据照样要同步，多个工作线程执行时完成顺序也不确定。

en.q: What are the main benefits of a thread pool over a new thread per task? (Select all that apply)
choices: Tasks always finish in submission order
Reusing threads avoids repeated creation and teardown
Bounding the number of threads prevents resource exhaustion
en.explain: A pool addresses overhead and capacity; shared data still needs synchronisation, and with several workers completion order is not fixed.

zh.q: Java 中 Thread.sleep() 和 Object.wait() 的关键区别是？
choices: sleep 会释放锁，wait 不会
wait 会释放对象的监视器锁，sleep 不会
sleep 只能在 synchronized 块里调用
zh.explain: wait 必须在持有该对象锁时调用，调用后释放锁并等待 notify；sleep 只是暂停当前线程，持有的锁照样持有。

en.q: What is the key difference between Thread.sleep() and Object.wait() in Java?
choices: sleep releases the lock; wait does not
wait releases the monitor lock; sleep does not
sleep can only be called inside synchronized
en.explain: wait must be called while holding the object's lock and releases it until notified; sleep just pauses the thread and keeps any locks it holds.

zh.q: “数据竞争”（data race）的准确定义是？
choices: 两个线程并发访问同一内存位置，至少一个是写，且没有同步
两个线程同时读同一个变量
两个线程争用同一把锁
zh.explain: 只读共享没有问题；有写入又没有锁、原子操作等建立先后关系，才是数据竞争，在 C/C++ 里是未定义行为。

en.q: What exactly is a data race?
choices: Two threads access the same memory location concurrently, at least one writes, with no synchronisation
Two threads read the same variable at once
Two threads contend for one lock
en.explain: Shared reads are fine; a write with nothing (lock, atomic) ordering the accesses is a data race, which is undefined behaviour in C and C++.

zh.q: 方法重写（override）和方法重载（overload）分别对应哪种多态？
choices: 重写是编译时多态，重载是运行时多态
重写是运行时多态，重载是编译时多态
zh.explain: 重写的方法按对象的实际类型动态分派；重载按参数的静态类型在编译期选定。

en.q: Which kind of polymorphism do overriding and overloading give?
choices: Overriding is compile-time; overloading is run-time
Overriding is run-time; overloading is compile-time
en.explain: An overridden method is dispatched on the object's actual type at run time; an overload is chosen at compile time from the static argument types.

zh.q: Java 中关于抽象类和接口，哪些说法正确？（多选）
choices: 抽象类可以有构造函数和实例字段
接口可以有非 static 的实例字段
接口可以有 default 方法（Java 8 起）
一个类只能继承一个类，但可以实现多个接口
zh.explain: 接口里的字段隐式是 public static final 常量，不能有实例状态；抽象类可以有状态和构造函数。

en.q: Which statements about abstract classes and interfaces in Java are true? (Select all that apply)
choices: An abstract class can have constructors and instance fields
An interface can have non-static instance fields
Interfaces can have default methods (since Java 8)
A class extends one class but can implement many interfaces
en.explain: Fields in an interface are implicitly public static final constants, so no instance state; an abstract class can have state and constructors.

zh.q: 里氏替换原则（LSP）要求什么？
choices: 子类对象能替换父类对象使用而不破坏程序的正确性
zh.explain: 经典反例：正方形继承长方形，setWidth 同时改了高，依赖“宽高独立”的调用方就出错了。“每个类只有一个职责”是单一职责原则。

en.q: What does the Liskov substitution principle require?
choices: The base class must be abstract
A subclass object can stand in for its base class without breaking correctness
en.explain: The classic counter-example is Square extends Rectangle: setWidth also changes the height and breaks callers that assume they are independent. 'One responsibility per class' is the single-responsibility principle.

zh.q: SOLID 中的 O（开闭原则）是指？
choices: 对扩展开放，对修改关闭
类要么完全公开要么完全私有
zh.explain: 新增行为时通过新增类型（实现接口、组合策略）完成，而不是改动已经测试过的代码。

en.q: What does the O in SOLID (open/closed) mean?
choices: Open for extension, closed for modification
Classes are either fully public or fully private
en.explain: Add behaviour by adding types (implementing an interface, plugging in a strategy) rather than editing tested code.

zh.q: 依赖倒置原则（DIP）建议？
choices: 所有类都继承同一个基类
低层模块调用高层模块
高层模块和低层模块都依赖抽象
zh.explain: 例如业务逻辑依赖 Repository 接口，而不是直接依赖某个具体的 MySQL 实现，这样易于替换和测试。

en.q: What does the dependency inversion principle recommend?
choices: Every class extends one base class
High- and low-level modules both depend on abstractions
en.explain: Business logic depends on a Repository interface rather than a concrete MySQL class, so the implementation can be swapped and tested.

zh.q: “组合优于继承”的主要理由是？
choices: 继承在 Java 中已被弃用
组合耦合更松，能在运行时替换部件，避免脆弱的类层次
zh.explain: 子类依赖父类的实现细节，父类一改子类就可能坏（脆弱基类问题）；组合只依赖接口。

en.q: Why 'favour composition over inheritance'?
choices: Composition is looser, parts can be swapped at run time, and it avoids fragile hierarchies
en.explain: A subclass depends on its parent's implementation and breaks when it changes (the fragile base class problem); composition depends only on an interface.

zh.q: Java 中子类定义了与父类同签名的 static 方法，会发生什么？
choices: 隐藏父类方法，调用哪个由引用的静态类型决定
重写父类方法，按实际对象类型调用
zh.explain: static 方法属于类，不参与动态分派，所以只是“隐藏”。用 Parent p = new Child(); p.m() 调用的是 Parent.m。

en.q: In Java, a subclass declares a static method with the same signature as one in its parent. What happens?
choices: It hides the parent's method; the static type of the reference decides which runs
It overrides it; the actual object type decides
en.explain: Static methods belong to the class and are not dispatched dynamically, so this is hiding. With Parent p = new Child(), p.m() calls Parent.m.

zh.q: 实现单例模式时，最关键的一步是？
choices: 构造函数私有，通过静态方法返回唯一实例
zh.explain: 私有构造函数阻止外部 new，静态访问点负责创建并缓存唯一实例（多线程下还要注意初始化安全）。

en.q: What is the key step in implementing the Singleton pattern?
choices: Make the constructor private and return the one instance from a static method
en.explain: A private constructor stops outside code calling new, and a static accessor creates and caches the single instance (thread-safe initialisation matters too).

zh.q: 观察者模式（Observer）适合哪种场景？
choices: 一个对象状态变化时，需要通知多个依赖它的对象
为复杂子系统提供一个简单入口
在运行时选择不同的算法
确保一个类只有一个实例
zh.explain: 主题维护观察者列表，变化时逐个回调，事件监听就是典型例子。提供简单入口是外观模式，运行时选算法是策略模式，唯一实例是单例模式。

en.q: Which situation suits the Observer pattern?
choices: Several objects must be notified when one object changes
Giving a complex subsystem one simple entry point
Choosing an algorithm at run time
Ensuring a class has one instance
en.explain: The subject keeps a list of observers and calls each on change; event listeners are the classic example. A simple entry point is Facade, choosing an algorithm is Strategy and one instance is Singleton.

zh.q: Java 不支持类的多继承，主要是为了避免什么问题？
zh.explain: 两个父类都继承同一个祖先并各自重写同一方法时，子类该用哪个不明确。接口的 default 方法冲突时，Java 要求子类显式重写。

en.q: Java forbids multiple inheritance of classes mainly to avoid what?
en.explain: If two parents inherit one ancestor and both override a method, the child's choice is ambiguous. For clashing interface default methods Java makes the class override explicitly.

zh.q: 策略模式（Strategy）的作用是？
choices: 把一族可互换的算法封装起来，运行时选择
zh.explain: 例如排序比较器、支付方式、压缩算法都可以是策略；分步构建是建造者，动态加职责是装饰器，沿链传递是责任链。

en.q: What is the Strategy pattern for?
choices: Adding responsibilities to an object dynamically
Passing a request along a chain of handlers
Building a complex object step by step
Wrapping interchangeable algorithms so one can be picked at run time
en.explain: Comparators, payment methods and compression codecs are typical strategies; step-by-step building is Builder, adding responsibilities is Decorator and passing along handlers is Chain of Responsibility.

zh.q: Java 中重写 equals 时为什么必须同时重写 hashCode？
choices: hashCode 决定 equals 的结果
相等的对象必须有相同的哈希码，否则 HashMap/HashSet 会出错
zh.explain: HashMap 先按 hashCode 找桶再用 equals 比较；两个“相等”的对象哈希不同会落在不同的桶，查找和去重都会失败。反过来，哈希相同的对象不必相等。

en.q: In Java, why must you override hashCode when you override equals?
choices: Equal objects must share a hash code or HashMap and HashSet misbehave
en.explain: HashMap finds the bucket by hashCode, then compares with equals; equal objects with different hashes land in different buckets, so lookups and dedup fail. Equal hashes do not have to mean equal objects.

zh.q: 装饰器模式（Decorator）的特点是？
choices: 包装同一接口的对象，在不修改原类的情况下叠加功能
把两个不兼容的接口适配起来
把对象的创建交给子类
zh.explain: Java 的 BufferedInputStream(new FileInputStream(...)) 就是装饰器：每层都实现同一接口并委托给被包装对象。适配不兼容接口的是适配器模式。

en.q: What characterises the Decorator pattern?
choices: Wrapping an object of the same interface to add behaviour without changing its class
en.explain: Java's BufferedInputStream(new FileInputStream(...)) is a decorator: each layer implements the same interface and delegates to the wrapped one. Adapting incompatible interfaces is the Adapter pattern.

zh.q: Java 中 protected 成员可以被谁访问？
choices: 同一个包内的类，以及其他包中的子类
zh.explain: Java 的 protected 比 C++ 宽：同包可见，再加上子类（跨包时通过子类自身的引用访问）。

en.q: In Java, who can access a protected member?
choices: Classes in the same package, and subclasses in other packages
en.explain: Java's protected is wider than C++'s: visible within the package, plus to subclasses (across packages, through the subclass's own references).

zh.q: 封装（encapsulation）最主要的目的是？
choices: 隐藏内部状态，只通过方法暴露受控的操作
zh.explain: 外部只能经由方法修改状态，类可以维护自己的不变量，内部实现改了也不影响调用方。

en.q: What is the main purpose of encapsulation?
choices: Hide internal state and expose only controlled operations
en.explain: Outside code changes state only through methods, so the class keeps its invariants and can change its internals without breaking callers.

zh.q: 工厂方法模式（Factory Method）解决的问题是？
choices: 调用方不必知道要创建的具体类
zh.explain: 创建逻辑放在一个方法里（可由子类覆盖），调用方只依赖产品的接口，新增产品类型时调用方不用改。

en.q: What problem does the Factory Method pattern solve?
choices: Callers need not know the concrete class being created
Ensuring an object is created only once
en.explain: Creation lives in one method that subclasses can override; callers depend only on the product interface and need no change for a new product type.

en.explain: + first turns objects into primitives: an array becomes its elements joined by commas, so [] is "", and {} becomes "[object Object]". Once either side is a string, + concatenates, so [1, 2] + [3] is "1,2" + "3".
