en.q: What is the time of the first call fib(n) (treating integer addition as O(1))?

zh.q: 网格 g 是 m 行 n 列。时间和额外空间分别是？

en.q: The grid g has m rows and n columns. What are the time and extra space?
en.explain: Each cell is computed once in O(1): O(m·n). dp keeps one row, where dp[j] before the update is the cell above and dp[j-1] the freshly updated cell to the left: O(n) space.

zh.q: items 有 n 件物品，容量是 W。时间复杂度是？

en.q: items has n items and the capacity is W. What is the time complexity?
en.explain: Each item sweeps capacities from W down to wt, at most W + 1 steps: O(n·W) time and O(W) space. It scales with the value of W, which is why it is called pseudo-polynomial.

en.q: What is the time complexity of this code (n = len(a), tightest bound)?
en.explain: tails stays sorted and at most n long; each element does one O(log n) binary search and an O(1) replace or append: O(n log n). The double-loop DP is O(n²).

zh.q: m = len(a)，n = len(b)。时间和额外空间分别是？
choices: O(m + n) 时间，O(m + n) 空间
O(2^(m+n)) 时间，O(m + n) 空间
zh.explain: (m+1)×(n+1) 的表每格 O(1) 算一次。只要长度时可以只留两行，把空间降到 O(min(m, n))，但这段代码存了整张表。

en.q: m = len(a), n = len(b). What are the time and extra space?
choices: O(m + n) time, O(m + n) space
en.explain: Each cell of the (m+1)×(n+1) table takes O(1). Keeping two rows would cut space to O(min(m, n)) when only the length is needed, but this code stores the whole table.

zh.q: n = len(s)，把整数加法看作 O(1)。时间复杂度是？
zh.explain: 状态只有 n + 1 个后缀，记忆化保证每个只算一次。但状态是字符串本身：每次 t[1:]、t[2:] 都复制出一个长度 O(n) 的新串，作为缓存的键还要对它求哈希，也是 O(n)。所以是 O(n²)。改成传下标 i，就是 O(n)。

en.q: n = len(s); treat integer addition as O(1). What is the time complexity?
en.explain: There are only n + 1 suffix states and the cache solves each once. But the state is the string itself: every t[1:] and t[2:] copies O(n) characters, and hashing it as a cache key is O(n) too. That makes O(n²). Passing an index i instead gives O(n).

zh.q: n = len(s)。最坏情况下的时间和额外空间分别是？
zh.explain: 一共 2n - 1 个中心，每个中心最多向外扩展 O(n) 步。s 由同一个字符组成时每次都扩到边界，总共 Θ(n²)。只用了几个变量，额外空间 O(1)。

en.q: n = len(s). What are the worst-case time and extra space?
en.explain: There are 2n - 1 centers and each expands at most O(n) steps; a string of one repeated character expands to the edges every time: Θ(n²). Only a few variables: O(1) extra space.

zh.q: n = len(s)。时间复杂度是？
zh.explain: 共有约 n²/2 个子串，每个都要切片、反转、比较，代价与长度成正比，平均 O(n)。合起来是 Θ(n³)。中心扩展法是 O(n²)。

en.q: n = len(s). What is the time complexity?
en.explain: There are about n²/2 substrings, and each is sliced, reversed and compared at a cost proportional to its length, O(n) on average: Θ(n³) in total. Expanding around centers is O(n²).

zh.q: n = len(prices)，最多交易 k 次。时间和额外空间分别是？
choices: O(n + k) 时间，O(k) 空间
zh.explain: 每天对 k 个交易次数各更新一次 buy 和 sell，共 O(n·k)；只保留当前这一天的两个数组，空间 O(k)。k ≥ n/2 时可以直接按不限次数处理，O(n)。

en.q: n = len(prices), at most k transactions. What are the time and extra space?
en.explain: Each day updates buy and sell for each of the k counts: O(n·k). Only the current day's two arrays are kept: O(k) space. When k >= n/2 the unlimited version, O(n), applies.

questions.code:
from bisect import bisect_right

def best(jobs):
    jobs.sort(key=lambda j: j[1])
    ends = [e for _, e, _ in jobs]
    dp = [0] * (len(jobs) + 1)
    for i, (s, e, w) in enumerate(jobs):
        k = bisect_right(ends, s, 0, i)
        dp[i + 1] = max(dp[i], dp[k] + w)
    return dp[-1]

zh.q: jobs 是 n 个 (开始, 结束, 权值)。时间复杂度是？
zh.explain: 按结束时间排序 O(n log n)；每个任务用一次二分找出结束时间不晚于它开始时间的任务个数 k，O(log n)。合起来 O(n log n)。

en.q: jobs holds n (start, end, weight) triples. What is the time complexity?
en.explain: Sorting by end is O(n log n); each job then binary-searches how many jobs end by its start, O(log n). Altogether O(n log n).

zh.q: 下面代码的时间复杂度是？（n = len(a)，取最紧的界）
zh.explain: 状态是区间 (i, j)，共约 n²/2 个，每个只算一次，算一次只看两个子状态 O(1)。所以 O(n²) 时间和空间。不加缓存就是指数级。

en.q: What is the time complexity of this code (n = len(a), tightest bound)?
en.explain: States are intervals (i, j), about n²/2 of them, each solved once from two sub-states in O(1): O(n²) time and space. Without the cache it is exponential.

zh.q: 在空队列上执行任意 n 次 push 和 pop，每次操作的代价是？
choices: 每次 pop 都是 O(n)
均摊 O(1)，单次最坏 O(n)
zh.explain: 每个元素最多被搬运一次：压入 inbox，搬进 outbox，再从 outbox 弹出，每步 O(1)。所以 n 次操作总共 O(n)，均摊 O(1)。outbox 为空时的那次 pop 可能要搬 O(n) 个元素。

en.q: Starting empty, any n push and pop calls run. What does each operation cost?
choices: O(1) worst case for every call
O(1) amortized, O(n) worst case for one pop
en.explain: Each element moves at most once: into inbox, over to outbox, out of outbox, O(1) each step. n operations take O(n) in total, O(1) amortized, though the pop that finds outbox empty may move O(n) elements.

zh.q: get 和 put 每次的时间复杂度是？
zh.explain: OrderedDict 内部是哈希表加双向链表：查找、move_to_end、从头部 popitem 都是平均 O(1)。

en.q: What does each get and put cost?
en.explain: OrderedDict is a hash map plus a doubly linked list: lookup, move_to_end and popitem from the front are all O(1) on average.

zh.q: 缓存里已有 cap 个键时，一次命中的 get 的时间复杂度是？
zh.explain: order 是普通列表，remove(key) 要线性查找再把后面的元素前移，O(cap)。dict 的查找是 O(1)，但被这一步拖慢了。用 OrderedDict 或「哈希表 + 双向链表」可以做到 O(1)。

en.q: With cap keys in the cache, what does a get that hits cost?
en.explain: order is a plain list, so remove(key) searches linearly and shifts the rest: O(cap). The dict lookup is O(1), but this step dominates. OrderedDict, or a hash map with a doubly linked list, makes it O(1).

zh.q: 把一组单词建成字典树，时间复杂度是？
choices: O(S·L)，L 是最长单词的长度
O(S)，S 是所有单词的长度之和
zh.explain: 每个字符在字典里做一次期望 O(1) 的查找或插入，所以总共与字符总数 S 成正比。

en.q: Building a trie from a list of words takes what time?
choices: O(S·L), where L is the longest word
O(S), where S is the total length of all words
en.explain: Each character costs one expected O(1) dict lookup or insert, so the total is proportional to the character count S.

zh.q: x 是非负整数。循环执行的次数等于？
zh.explain: x &= x - 1 每次去掉最低位的 1，所以循环次数等于 x 里 1 的个数。x = 0b1000000 时只循环 1 次，逐位右移的写法则要循环 7 次。

en.q: x is a non-negative integer. How many times does the loop run?
choices: The number of bits in x
The number of 1 bits in x
en.explain: x &= x - 1 clears the lowest 1 bit each time, so the loop runs once per 1 bit. For x = 0b1000000 it runs once, where shifting bit by bit would take 7 rounds.

zh.q: a、b 是正整数，把一次取模看作 O(1)。时间复杂度是？
zh.explain: 欧几里得算法每两轮至少让较大的数减半（a % b < a / 2），所以轮数是 O(log min(a, b))。最坏情况出现在相邻的斐波那契数上。

en.q: a and b are positive; treat one modulo as O(1). What is the time complexity?
en.explain: Every two rounds of Euclid at least halve the larger number (a % b < a / 2), so the round count is O(log min(a, b)). Consecutive Fibonacci numbers are the worst case.

zh.q: n ≥ 1。时间复杂度是？（取最紧的界）
zh.explain: 这是埃氏筛。每个质数 p 划掉约 n/p 个数，对所有不超过 √n 的质数求和，是 n·Σ1/p = Θ(n log log n)。

en.q: n >= 1. What is the time complexity (tightest bound)?
en.explain: This is the sieve of Eratosthenes. Each prime p crosses out about n/p numbers; summed over primes up to √n that is n·Σ1/p = Θ(n log log n).

zh.q: bits 是低位在前的二进制计数器，从全 0 开始调用 increment n 次（位数足够）。总时间是？
choices: 总共 O(n)，均摊每次 O(1)
zh.explain: 第 0 位每次都翻转，第 1 位每 2 次翻转一次，第 k 位每 2^k 次一次。总翻转次数 n + n/2 + n/4 + … < 2n，所以总共 O(n)。单次最坏 O(log n)，但这种情况很少。

en.q: bits is a binary counter, lowest bit first, starting at all zeros; increment is called n times (enough bits). What is the total time?
choices: O(n) in total, O(1) amortized each
en.explain: Bit 0 flips every call, bit 1 every second call, bit k every 2^k calls. Total flips n + n/2 + n/4 + … < 2n: O(n). A single call can cost O(log n), but rarely.

zh.q: 下面代码在最坏情况下的时间复杂度是？（把一次取模看作 O(1)）
zh.explain: 循环在 d 超过 √n 时停止，n 是质数时要试完所有 2 到 √n 的数，O(√n)。如果 n 有不超过 √n 的因子，一定会更早被找到。

en.q: What is the worst-case time complexity (treating one modulo as O(1))?
en.explain: The loop stops once d exceeds √n, so a prime n tries every d from 2 to √n: O(√n). Any composite n has a factor at most √n and exits earlier.

zh.q: 下面代码的时间复杂度是？（n = len(a)，取最紧的界）
zh.explain: 递推式 T(n) = 2T(n/2) + O(n)，切片和合并都是线性的。按主定理，n^(log₂2) = n 与合并代价同阶，结果是 Θ(n log n)：log n 层，每层总共 O(n)。

en.q: What is the time complexity of this code (n = len(a), tightest bound)?
en.explain: The recurrence is T(n) = 2T(n/2) + O(n), slicing and merging both linear. By the master theorem n^(log₂2) = n matches the merge cost, giving Θ(n log n): log n levels of O(n) each.

zh.q: 调用 range_max(a, 0, n - 1)。时间复杂度是？
zh.explain: 递推式 T(n) = 2T(n/2) + O(1)。按主定理，n^(log₂2) = n 比 O(1) 大，结果是 Θ(n)：递归树一共约 2n 个节点，每个 O(1)。

en.q: The call is range_max(a, 0, n - 1). What is the time complexity?
en.explain: The recurrence is T(n) = 2T(n/2) + O(1). By the master theorem n^(log₂2) = n outgrows O(1), so Θ(n): the recursion tree has about 2n nodes of O(1) each.

zh.q: 下面代码的时间复杂度是？（n = len(a)，取最紧的界）
zh.explain: 递推式 T(n) = T(n/2) + O(n)：每层求和、切片都是当前长度的线性时间。n + n/2 + n/4 + … < 2n，所以是 Θ(n)，不是 O(n log n)。

en.q: What is the time complexity of this code (n = len(a), tightest bound)?
en.explain: The recurrence is T(n) = T(n/2) + O(n): summing and slicing are linear in the current length. n + n/2 + n/4 + … < 2n, so Θ(n), not O(n log n).

zh.q: 下面代码的时间复杂度是？
zh.explain: 递推式 T(n) = 3T(n/2) + Θ(n)。n^(log₂3) ≈ n^1.585 比 n 增长快，按主定理结果由递归部分决定：Θ(n^(log₂3))。Karatsuba 乘法就是这个递推式。

en.q: What is the time complexity of this code?
en.explain: The recurrence is T(n) = 3T(n/2) + Θ(n). n^(log₂3) ≈ n^1.585 outgrows n, so by the master theorem the recursion dominates: Θ(n^(log₂3)). Karatsuba multiplication has this recurrence.

zh.q: 输入是已经升序排好的 n 个不同的数。时间复杂度是？
zh.explain: 每次都选第一个元素当枢轴，有序输入下 smaller 为空、larger 有 n - 1 个，递推式 T(n) = T(n-1) + O(n)，结果 Θ(n²)，递归深度也是 n。随机选枢轴时期望是 O(n log n)。

en.q: The input is n distinct numbers already in ascending order. What is the time complexity?
en.explain: The pivot is always the first element, so on sorted input smaller is empty and larger has n - 1 items: T(n) = T(n-1) + O(n), Θ(n²), with recursion depth n. A random pivot gives O(n log n) expected.

zh.q: 下面代码的时间复杂度是？
zh.explain: 外层 n 次；内层 j 每次翻倍，从 1 到 n 需要约 log₂ n 次，而且和 i 无关。总共 Θ(n log n)。

en.q: What is the time complexity of this code?
en.explain: The outer loop runs n times; the inner j doubles, taking about log₂ n steps to reach n regardless of i. Θ(n log n) in total.

zh.q: 下面代码的时间复杂度是？
zh.explain: 内层循环步长为 i，执行约 n/i 次。总次数 n/1 + n/2 + … + n/n = n·H(n)，调和级数 H(n) ≈ ln n，所以是 Θ(n log n)。

en.q: What is the time complexity of this code?
en.explain: The inner loop steps by i, about n/i iterations. The total n/1 + n/2 + … + n/n = n·H(n), and the harmonic number H(n) ≈ ln n: Θ(n log n).

zh.q: 下面代码的时间复杂度是？
zh.explain: 内层从 i 开始，执行 n - i 次，总共 n + (n-1) + … + 1 = n(n+1)/2。少了一半的常数不影响量级，仍是 Θ(n²)。

en.q: What is the time complexity of this code?
en.explain: The inner loop starts at i and runs n - i times, n + (n-1) + … + 1 = n(n+1)/2 in all. Halving the constant does not change the order: Θ(n²).

zh.q: -1 在 8 位补码中的二进制表示是？
whys: 这是原码（符号位加绝对值）的写法。
正确：取反加一。
这是反码（只取反不加一）。

en.q: How is -1 written in 8-bit two's complement?
en.explain: In two's complement, -x is x inverted plus 1: 1 is 00000001, inverted 11111110, plus 1 gives 11111111 (0xFF).
whys: That is sign-magnitude: a sign bit plus the absolute value.
Right: invert and add one.
That is ones' complement: inverted without adding one.

zh.q: 8 位有符号整数（补码）能表示的范围是？
zh.explain: n 位补码的范围是 -2^(n-1) 到 2^(n-1) - 1。0 占了非负数的一个位置，所以负数比正数多一个：-128 到 127。
whys: 这是 8 位无符号整数的范围。
这是原码或反码的范围，它们有 +0 和 -0 两个零。
128 需要 9 位才能表示为正数。

en.q: What range does an 8-bit signed integer (two's complement) cover?
en.explain: n-bit two's complement covers -2^(n-1) to 2^(n-1) - 1. Zero takes one of the non-negative slots, so there is one more negative value than positive: -128 to 127.
whys: That is the unsigned 8-bit range.
That is sign-magnitude or ones' complement, which have both +0 and -0.
A positive 128 would need a ninth bit.

zh.q: 在 8 位补码加法器上计算 100 + 100，结果按有符号数解释是多少？
zh.explain: 200 的二进制是 11001000，存进 8 位后最高位是 1，按补码读就是 200 - 256 = -56。硬件只是按位相加，不会饱和；两个正数相加得到负数，正是有符号溢出的标志（溢出标志位 OF 被置位）。
whys: 普通加法器不做饱和截断。
8 位有符号数最大只能表示 127。

en.q: On an 8-bit two's complement adder, 100 + 100 is computed. Read as a signed number, what is the result?
en.explain: 200 is 11001000; in 8 bits the top bit is set, so as two's complement it reads 200 - 256 = -56. The hardware just adds bits and does not saturate; two positives giving a negative is exactly how signed overflow shows (the overflow flag is set).
whys: A plain adder does not saturate.
An 8-bit signed number tops out at 127.

zh.q: 对正整数 x，表达式 x & (x - 1) 的效果是？
choices: 只保留 x 最低位的那个 1
把 x 的所有位取反
把 x 最低位的那个 1 清零
zh.explain: x - 1 会把最低位的 1 变成 0，并把它右边的 0 都变成 1，与 x 相与后，正好只去掉了那一个 1。所以 x & (x - 1) == 0 可以判断 x 是不是 2 的幂；反复执行直到为 0 可以数出 1 的个数。
whys: 只保留最低位 1 的是 x & -x。
取反是 ~x。
正确：去掉最低位的 1。
除以 2 是 x >> 1。

en.q: For a positive integer x, what does x & (x - 1) do?
choices: Keeps only the lowest set bit of x
Clears the lowest set bit of x
en.explain: x - 1 turns the lowest 1 into 0 and every 0 to its right into 1, so ANDing with x removes exactly that one bit. Hence x & (x - 1) == 0 tests for a power of two, and repeating until 0 counts the set bits.
whys: Keeping only the lowest set bit is x & -x.
Inverting is ~x.
Right: the lowest set bit is removed.
Halving is x >> 1.

zh.q: x = 12 时，x & -x（补码）的值是？
zh.explain: 12 = 1100，-12 = ~1100 + 1 = …0100。相与后只剩最低位的 1，即 0100 = 4。树状数组（Fenwick tree）用的 lowbit 就是这个运算。
whys: 8 是最高位的 1。
正数和它的相反数相与不会是 0，至少留下最低位的 1。
正确：只留下最低位的 1。

en.q: With x = 12, what is x & -x in two's complement?
en.explain: 12 is 1100 and -12 is ~1100 + 1 = …0100. ANDing leaves only the lowest set bit, 0100 = 4. This is the lowbit used by Fenwick trees.
whys: 8 is the highest set bit.
A positive number ANDed with its negation keeps its lowest set bit, so it is not 0.
Right: only the lowest set bit survives.

zh.q: 数组里除了一个数只出现一次，其余数都恰好出现两次。把所有数异或（XOR）起来，结果是？
choices: 出现两次的数中最大的那个
zh.explain: 异或满足交换律和结合律，并且 a ^ a = 0、a ^ 0 = a。成对的数互相抵消成 0，剩下的就是只出现一次的数。时间 O(n)、额外空间 O(1)。
whys: 异或不是加法，没有进位。
只有所有数都成对出现时结果才是 0。
正确：成对的数抵消为 0。
异或不比较大小，成对的数互相抵消。

en.q: In an array every number appears exactly twice except one that appears once. What do you get by XORing them all?
choices: The largest of the paired numbers
en.explain: XOR is commutative and associative, with a ^ a = 0 and a ^ 0 = a. Each pair cancels to 0, leaving the lone number, in O(n) time and O(1) extra space.
whys: XOR is not addition and has no carries.
It would be 0 only if every number had a pair.
Right: the pairs cancel to 0.
XOR does not compare sizes; paired numbers cancel.

zh.q: 32 位整数 0x12345678 以小端序存放在地址 0x100 开始的 4 个字节里，地址 0x100 处的字节是？
zh.explain: 小端序把最低有效字节放在最低地址：0x100 处是 0x78，之后依次是 0x56、0x34、0x12。大端序则相反，0x100 处是 0x12。x86-64 和常见配置下的 ARM 都是小端。
whys: 字节序以整个字节为单位调换，字节内部的位不会倒过来。
正确：低位字节在低地址。
这是大端序的情况。

en.q: The 32-bit value 0x12345678 is stored little-endian in the 4 bytes starting at address 0x100. Which byte is at 0x100?
en.explain: Little-endian puts the least significant byte at the lowest address: 0x78 at 0x100, then 0x56, 0x34, 0x12. Big-endian would put 0x12 at 0x100. x86-64 and ARM as usually configured are little-endian.
whys: Endianness swaps whole bytes; it never reverses the digits inside a byte.
Right: the low byte at the low address.
0x34 is at 0x102.
That is big-endian.

zh.q: 网络协议（如 TCP/IP 报头）里的多字节整数使用哪种字节序？
choices: 由发送方的 CPU 决定
小端序，因为大多数机器是小端
没有固定规定，由双方协商
大端序，发送前用 htonl / htons 转换
zh.explain: 网络字节序规定为大端序。小端机器发送前用 htonl、htons（host to network）转换，接收后用 ntohl、ntohs 转回来；大端机器上这些函数什么也不做。
whys: 如果随 CPU 而定，不同机器之间就无法互通。
机器多数是小端，但网络字节序规定为大端。
字节序是协议本身规定好的。
正确：网络字节序就是大端。

en.q: Which byte order do network protocols such as the TCP/IP headers use for multi-byte integers?
choices: Nothing fixed; the two sides negotiate
Big-endian; convert with htonl / htons before sending
en.explain: Network byte order is defined as big-endian. Little-endian hosts convert with htonl and htons (host to network) before sending and ntohl and ntohs after receiving; on big-endian hosts these do nothing.
whys: If it followed the CPU, different machines could not talk.
Most machines are little-endian, but the network order is big-endian.
The protocol itself fixes the byte order.
Right: network byte order is big-endian.

zh.q: Java 中 -8 >> 1 和 -8 >>> 28 的值分别是？
zh.explain: >> 是算术右移，左边补符号位，-8 >> 1 = -4（相当于向下取整除以 2）。>>> 是逻辑右移，左边补 0：-8 是 0xFFFFFFF8，右移 28 位剩下 0xF = 15。
whys: >>> 左边补 0，结果是正数。
正确：>> 补符号位，>>> 补 0。
0xFFFFFFF8 右移 28 位只剩最高的 4 位 1111。
这是对 -8 做逻辑右移 1 位的结果。

en.q: In Java, what are -8 >> 1 and -8 >>> 28?
en.explain: >> is an arithmetic shift that fills with the sign bit, so -8 >> 1 = -4 (a floor division by 2). >>> is a logical shift that fills with zeros: -8 is 0xFFFFFFF8, and shifting right 28 leaves 0xF = 15.
whys: >>> fills with zeros, so the result is positive.
Right: >> fills with the sign bit, >>> with zeros.
Shifting 0xFFFFFFF8 right by 28 leaves only its top four bits, 1111.
That is -8 shifted right logically by 1.

zh.q: 对一个很大的 C/C++ 二维数组 int a[N][N] 求和，为什么按行遍历（外层 i、内层 j，访问 a[i][j]）通常比按列遍历快很多？
choices: 数组按行连续存放，按行访问能用满每条缓存行（空间局部性）
CPU 对行和列的寄存器数量不同
编译器只能给按行的循环做向量化
按行访问需要的加法次数更少
zh.explain: C/C++ 数组是行优先存储，a[i][j] 和 a[i][j+1] 相邻。缓存每次加载一整条缓存行（常见 64 字节，16 个 int），按行访问能把一条行用完；按列访问每次跨 N 个元素，几乎每次都要重新加载，缓存缺失多得多。
whys: 正确：行优先存储加上缓存行带来的空间局部性。
寄存器和行列无关。
向量化也受访存模式影响，但根本原因是缓存局部性。
两种顺序做的加法次数完全相同。

en.q: Summing a large C/C++ array int a[N][N], why is row order (outer i, inner j, reading a[i][j]) usually much faster than column order?
choices: The array is stored row by row, so row order uses every byte of each cache line (spatial locality)
The CPU has different register counts for rows and columns
Compilers can only vectorize row-order loops
en.explain: C and C++ arrays are row-major, so a[i][j] and a[i][j+1] are neighbours. The cache loads a whole line at a time (typically 64 bytes, 16 ints); row order uses all of it, while column order jumps N elements each step and needs a new line almost every access, so it misses far more.
whys: Right: row-major layout plus cache lines give spatial locality.
Registers have nothing to do with rows or columns.
Vectorization also depends on access pattern, but the root cause is cache locality.
Both orders do exactly the same additions.

zh.q: 两个线程分别频繁写各自的计数器 a 和 b，没有共享数据，但比单线程还慢。最可能的原因是？
choices: 计数器用了 volatile，被编译器禁止优化
两个线程在争用同一把锁
伪共享：a 和 b 在同一条缓存行里，缓存行在两个核心之间来回失效
线程太多，操作系统调度开销大
zh.explain: 缓存一致性以缓存行为单位。a 和 b 挨在一起时，一个核心写 a 会让另一个核心那份缓存行失效，反之亦然，缓存行在两个核心之间不停传来传去。把它们分到不同的缓存行（填充或按 64 字节对齐，如 C++ 的 alignas）就能解决。
whys: volatile 会多一些内存访问，但解释不了比单线程还慢这么多。
题目里没有锁。
正确：不同变量共享一条缓存行导致的伪共享。
只有两个线程，调度开销很小。

en.q: Two threads each update their own counter, a and b, with no shared data, yet it runs slower than one thread. What is the likely cause?
choices: The counters are volatile, so the compiler cannot optimize
Both threads contend for one lock
False sharing: a and b sit in the same cache line, which keeps bouncing between the two cores
Too many threads, so scheduling overhead dominates
en.explain: Cache coherence works per cache line. With a and b side by side, a write to a invalidates the other core's copy of the line and vice versa, so the line ping-pongs between cores. Putting them on separate lines (padding, or 64-byte alignment such as alignas in C++) fixes it.
whys: volatile adds some memory traffic but cannot explain being slower than one thread.
There is no lock in the setup.
Right: false sharing between variables on one cache line.
With two threads the scheduling cost is tiny.

zh.q: 缓存命中时间 1 ns，缺失率 10%，缺失代价 100 ns。平均访存时间（AMAT）是多少？
zh.explain: AMAT = 命中时间 + 缺失率 × 缺失代价 = 1 + 0.1 × 100 = 11 ns。每次访问都要先花命中时间查缓存，缺失时再额外付出缺失代价。
whys: 这是一次缺失访问的耗时，不是平均值。
这是 0.9 × 1 + 0.1 × 100，假设缺失时不需要先查缓存。
漏掉了每次访问都要付的命中时间。

en.q: A cache has a 1 ns hit time, a 10% miss rate and a 100 ns miss penalty. What is the average memory access time (AMAT)?
en.explain: AMAT = hit time + miss rate × miss penalty = 1 + 0.1 × 100 = 11 ns. Every access pays the hit time to check the cache, and misses add the penalty on top.
whys: That is one missing access, not the average.
That is 0.9 × 1 + 0.1 × 100, as if misses skipped the cache lookup.
This leaves out the hit time every access pays.

zh.q: 把直接映射缓存改成 4 路组相联（总容量不变），主要能减少哪一类缓存缺失？
zh.explain: 直接映射时，映射到同一位置的几块数据会互相挤掉，即使缓存还有空位，这就是冲突缺失。组相联让每组能放多块，缓解了这个问题。第一次访问的强制缺失、工作集超过容量的容量缺失都和相联度无关。
whys: 正确：相联度针对的是冲突缺失。
总容量没变，装不下的仍然装不下。
第一次访问总会缺失，靠预取才能减少。
一致性缺失来自多核间的失效，与相联度无关。

en.q: Changing a direct-mapped cache to 4-way set associative (same total size) mainly reduces which kind of miss?
en.explain: In a direct-mapped cache, blocks that map to the same slot evict each other even when space is free elsewhere: conflict misses. Set associativity lets each set hold several blocks, which eases that. First-touch compulsory misses and capacity misses from an oversized working set do not depend on associativity.
whys: Right: associativity targets conflict misses.
The total size is unchanged, so what did not fit still does not.
First accesses always miss; only prefetching helps.
Coherence misses come from invalidations between cores, not associativity.

zh.q: 在使用 IEEE 754 双精度浮点数的语言里，0.1 + 0.2 == 0.3 为假，根本原因是？
choices: 比较浮点数时会先转换成整数
CPU 的浮点加法有缺陷
双精度只有 6 位有效数字
0.1、0.2、0.3 都无法用二进制精确表示，舍入误差累积后不相等
zh.explain: 0.1 在二进制里是无限循环小数，只能存最接近的近似值；0.2、0.3 也一样。0.1 + 0.2 的结果是 0.30000000000000004，和 0.3 的近似值差一个最低位。比较浮点数应该用误差容限，比如 abs(a - b) < 1e-9。
whys: 浮点比较直接比较浮点值，不会转成整数。
这是 IEEE 754 规定的正确舍入结果，不是硬件缺陷。
双精度约有 15 到 17 位有效十进制数字。
正确：二进制无法精确表示这些十进制小数。

en.q: In languages with IEEE 754 doubles, 0.1 + 0.2 == 0.3 is false. What is the root cause?
choices: Floats are converted to integers before comparing
The CPU's floating-point adder is faulty
0.1, 0.2 and 0.3 have no exact binary form, and the rounding errors do not line up
en.explain: 0.1 is a repeating fraction in binary, so only the nearest value is stored; the same goes for 0.2 and 0.3. 0.1 + 0.2 comes out as 0.30000000000000004, one unit in the last place away from the stored 0.3. Compare floats with a tolerance such as abs(a - b) < 1e-9.
whys: Floats are compared as floats; no integer conversion happens.
This is the correctly rounded IEEE 754 result, not a hardware fault.
Doubles hold about 15 to 17 significant decimal digits.
Right: binary cannot represent these decimals exactly.

zh.q: IEEE 754 单精度 float 的有效数字（含隐含位）是 24 位。下面哪个整数不能用 float 精确表示？
zh.explain: 2^24 = 16777216 以内的整数都能精确表示。超过 2^24 后，相邻两个 float 之间相差 2，奇数 16777217 落在两个可表示值中间，会被舍入成 16777216。16777218 是偶数，仍然能表示。
whys: 小于 2^24 的整数都能精确表示。
正确：超过 2^24 的奇数无法表示。
超过 2^24 后间隔是 2，偶数 16777218 仍可表示。

en.q: An IEEE 754 single-precision float has a 24-bit significand (counting the hidden bit). Which integer cannot be stored exactly in a float?
en.explain: Every integer up to 2^24 = 16777216 is exact. Beyond 2^24 neighbouring floats are 2 apart, so the odd 16777217 falls between two representable values and rounds to 16777216. 16777218 is even and still fits.
whys: Integers below 2^24 are all exact.
Right: odd integers beyond 2^24 do not fit.
16777216 is 2^24 itself and is exact.
Past 2^24 the spacing is 2, so the even 16777218 still fits.

zh.q: JavaScript 的 Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER 是 2^53 - 1，这个 53 来自哪里？
choices: 64 位中有 11 位留给了符号
JavaScript 引擎用 53 位整数寄存器
双精度浮点数的有效数字是 53 位（52 位尾数加 1 个隐含位）
IEEE 754 规定整数最多用 53 位
zh.explain: JS 的 Number 是 64 位双精度浮点：1 位符号、11 位指数、52 位尾数，加上隐含的 1 共 53 位有效数字。2^53 以内的整数都能精确表示且相邻整数可区分，超过之后会丢精度，比如 2^53 + 1 === 2^53。需要更大的整数用 BigInt。
whys: 符号只占 1 位，11 位是指数。
这个限制来自浮点格式，不是寄存器宽度。
正确：52 位尾数加隐含位。
IEEE 754 规定的是浮点格式，53 是它的有效位数推出来的。

en.q: JavaScript's Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER is 2^53 - 1. Where does the 53 come from?
choices: 11 of the 64 bits are reserved for the sign
A double's significand has 53 bits (52 stored plus one hidden bit)
en.explain: A JS Number is a 64-bit double: 1 sign bit, 11 exponent bits and 52 fraction bits, plus a hidden leading 1, for 53 significant bits. Integers up to 2^53 are exact and distinguishable; beyond that precision runs out, so 2^53 + 1 === 2^53. Use BigInt for larger integers.
whys: The sign takes 1 bit; the 11 bits are the exponent.
The limit comes from the float format, not register width.
Right: 52 fraction bits plus the hidden bit.
IEEE 754 defines the float format; 53 follows from its significand.

zh.q: 在 IEEE 754 浮点运算中，x 是 NaN 时，下面哪个表达式为真？
zh.explain: NaN 与任何值（包括自己）比较，==、<、>、<=、>= 都为假，只有 != 为真。所以 x != x 是判断 NaN 的经典写法，现在通常用 isnan、Number.isNaN 之类的函数。
whys: NaN 与任何数比较大小都为假，两边都不成立。
和 NaN 用 == 比较永远为假。
正确：NaN 不等于任何值，包括自己。
NaN 不等于自己。

en.q: Under IEEE 754, if x is NaN, which expression is true?
en.explain: NaN compares false with everything, itself included, under ==, <, >, <= and >=; only != is true. That makes x != x the classic NaN test; today you would use isnan, Number.isNaN and the like.
whys: Every ordering comparison with NaN is false, so both sides fail.
Comparing with NaN using == is always false.
Right: NaN equals nothing, not even itself.
NaN is not equal to itself.

zh.explain: 第一个先抵消成 0 再加 1，得 1。第二个里 -1e20 + 1 时，1 远小于 1e20 的精度（相邻双精度数之间相差约 16384），被舍入掉，结果还是 -1e20，再加 1e20 得 0。浮点加法不满足结合律，所以求和顺序会影响结果。
whys: 第二种算法里 1 在和 -1e20 相加时被舍入掉了。
说反了：丢掉 1 的是第二种。
正确：加法顺序不同，舍入不同。
第一种先得到精确的 0，再加 1 不会丢。

en.q: With doubles, what are (1e20 + -1e20) + 1 and 1e20 + (-1e20 + 1)?
en.explain: The first cancels to 0 and then adds 1, giving 1. In the second, -1e20 + 1 loses the 1 entirely, since neighbouring doubles near 1e20 are about 16384 apart, so it stays -1e20, and adding 1e20 gives 0. Floating-point addition is not associative, so summation order matters.
whys: In the second, the 1 is rounded away when added to -1e20.
Reversed: the second one loses the 1.
Right: different order, different rounding.
The first reaches an exact 0 before adding 1, so nothing is lost.

zh.q: 同一段代码「if (a[i] >= 128) sum += a[i];」遍历同一个大数组，数组排好序后明显更快，主要原因是？
choices: 排序后分支结果很有规律，分支预测几乎总是对的
排序后可以提前结束循环
排序后数组占用的内存更少
排好序的数据被编译器当成常量
zh.explain: 流水线 CPU 会预测分支的走向提前执行，预测错了要清空流水线，损失十几个周期。随机数据下分支一半一半，预测经常失败；排序后先是一长串「不成立」再是一长串「成立」，预测几乎全对。写成无分支的形式（条件传送、按位运算）也能避免这个问题。
whys: 正确：分支预测成功率大大提高。
代码里没有提前结束的逻辑，仍然遍历整个数组。
排序不改变元素个数和数组大小。
数组内容在运行时才知道，编译器无法当成常量。

en.q: The loop "if (a[i] >= 128) sum += a[i];" runs over the same large array. It is much faster once the array is sorted. Why?
choices: Sorted, the branch outcome is regular and the predictor is almost always right
Sorted, the loop can stop early
A sorted array takes less memory
The compiler treats sorted data as constants
en.explain: A pipelined CPU guesses which way a branch goes and runs ahead; a wrong guess flushes the pipeline and costs a dozen or more cycles. On random data the branch is a coin flip and guesses often fail; sorted, it is a long run of not-taken and then a long run of taken, so guesses are nearly always right. A branchless form (conditional move, bit tricks) avoids the problem too.
whys: Right: branch prediction becomes almost perfect.
The loop has no early exit; it still visits every element.
Sorting does not change the number of elements or the size.
The contents are only known at run time; the compiler cannot fold them.

zh.q: 按访问速度从快到慢排列，下面哪一组顺序正确？
choices: 内存 > 寄存器 > L1 缓存 > L3 缓存 > SSD
寄存器 > 内存 > L1 缓存 > SSD > L3 缓存
寄存器 > L1 缓存 > L3 缓存 > 内存（DRAM）> SSD
L1 缓存 > 寄存器 > 内存 > L3 缓存 > SSD
zh.explain: 越靠近 CPU 越快、越小：寄存器不到 1 ns，L1 约 1 ns，L3 约 10 ns 量级，内存约 100 ns，SSD 在数十微秒以上，每一级大约慢一个数量级甚至更多。
whys: 内存比寄存器和缓存都慢。
缓存比内存快，内存又比 SSD 快得多。
正确：寄存器、各级缓存、内存、外存依次变慢。
寄存器比 L1 缓存更快。

en.q: Which ordering goes from fastest to slowest access?
choices: Memory > registers > L1 cache > L3 cache > SSD
Registers > memory > L1 cache > SSD > L3 cache
Registers > L1 cache > L3 cache > memory (DRAM) > SSD
L1 cache > registers > memory > L3 cache > SSD
en.explain: The closer to the CPU, the faster and smaller: registers under 1 ns, L1 about 1 ns, L3 around 10 ns, DRAM about 100 ns and an SSD tens of microseconds or more, each level roughly an order of magnitude slower or worse.
whys: Memory is slower than both registers and caches.
Caches beat memory, and memory is far faster than an SSD.
Right: registers, caches, memory, then storage, each slower.
Registers are faster than L1.

zh.q: 下面的 C++ 程序（g++ -std=c++17）输出什么？
whys: *(p + 2) 从 a[1] 往后数两格，是 a[3] 而不是 a[2]。
把 *p 当成了 a[0]，但 p = a + 1 已经指向 a[1]。
正确：先取 *p 得 20 再加 1；p + 2 指向 a[3]。
*p + 1 是把值加 1，不是移动指针后再取值。

en.q: What does this C++ program print (g++ -std=c++17)?
en.explain: p points at a[1] (20). *p + 1 dereferences first and then adds 1, giving 21; *(p + 2) is a[3], which is 40.
whys: *(p + 2) is two places after a[1], so a[3], not a[2].
Takes *p as a[0], but p = a + 1 already points at a[1].
Right: *p is 20, plus 1; p + 2 points at a[3].
*p + 1 adds 1 to the value; it does not move the pointer.

zh.q: 下面的 C++ 程序（g++ -std=c++17）输出什么？
zh.explain: r 是 x 的别名，r += 3 直接把 x 改成 8。y 是普通 int，int y = r 复制了 8，之后改 y 不影响 x。
whys: 正确：通过引用改的就是 x；y 是拷贝。
y 是在 r += 3 之后才复制的，复制到的是 8。
引用不是拷贝，r += 3 改的就是 x。
y *= 2 之后 y 是 16。y 是独立的变量，翻倍的只是 y。

en.q: What does this C++ program print (g++ -std=c++17)?
en.explain: r is another name for x, so r += 3 makes x 8. y is a plain int: int y = r copies 8, and changing y later leaves x alone.
whys: Right: writing through the reference writes x; y is a copy.
y is copied after r += 3, so it starts at 8.
A reference is not a copy: r += 3 changes x.
After y *= 2, y is 16; y is its own variable and only it doubles.

zh.q: 下面的 C++ 程序（g++ -std=c++17）输出什么？
zh.explain: f 按值传参，改的是自己的副本，a 不变；g 按引用传参，改的就是 b。
whys: 正确：按值传参改副本，按引用传参改原变量。
两个函数的效果正好说反了。
f 拿到的是 a 的副本，函数里赋值不会写回 a。
g 的参数是 int&，赋值会改掉调用方的 b。

en.q: What does this C++ program print (g++ -std=c++17)?
en.explain: f takes its argument by value and changes its own copy, so a stays 1; g takes a reference and changes b itself.
whys: Right: by value changes a copy; by reference changes the caller's variable.
This swaps what the two functions do.
f gets a copy of a; assigning to it never reaches a.
g takes int&, so assigning to v changes the caller's b.

zh.q: 下面的 C++ 程序（g++ -std=c++17）输出什么？
zh.explain: 指针本身也是按值传递的。swapPtr 交换的是两个局部指针副本，main 里的 p、q 和 x、y 都没变。要交换指向的值得写 *a 和 *b，要交换指针本身得传 int*&。
whys: 要得到 2 1，函数得交换 *a 和 *b，或者参数写成 int*&。
正确：交换的只是函数里的两个指针副本。
p 仍指向 x，x 仍是 1。
q 仍指向 y，y 仍是 2。

en.q: What does this C++ program print (g++ -std=c++17)?
en.explain: The pointers themselves are passed by value. swapPtr swaps its two local copies; p, q, x and y in main are untouched. Swapping the values needs *a and *b; swapping the pointers needs int*&.
whys: Getting 2 1 needs swapping *a and *b, or taking int*& parameters.
Right: only the function's copies of the pointers were swapped.
p still points at x, and x is still 1.
q still points at y, and y is still 2.

zh.q: 下面的 C++ 程序（g++ -std=c++17）输出什么？
zh.explain: A a 调用默认构造（D）；按值传给 take 要拷贝一次（C）；A b = a 用左值初始化，也是拷贝构造（C）。
whys: 只有两处拷贝；函数返回时没有再拷贝（take 返回 void）。
按值传参会调用拷贝构造，A b = a 也会。
漏掉了一次：按值传参和 A b = a 各拷贝一次。
正确：一次默认构造，两次拷贝构造。

en.q: What does this C++ program print (g++ -std=c++17)?
en.explain: A a runs the default constructor (D); passing it by value to take copies it (C); A b = a initializes from an lvalue, another copy (C).
whys: There are only two copies; take returns void, so nothing is copied back.
Passing by value calls the copy constructor, and so does A b = a.
One copy is missing: passing by value and A b = a each copy once.
Right: one default construction, two copy constructions.

zh.q: 下面的 C++ 程序（g++ -std=c++17）输出什么？
zh.explain: vector 的移动构造把 a 的缓冲区直接交给 b，标准规定移动构造之后源对象为空，所以 a.size() 是 0。读一个被移走的 vector 的 size 是合法的。
whys: std::move 只是转换成右值；这里调用的是移动构造，元素没有被复制。
方向反了：数据从 a 移到了 b。
移走之后的对象仍处于有效状态，调用 size() 没有问题。
正确：缓冲区转给了 b，a 变成空的。

en.q: What does this C++ program print (g++ -std=c++17)?
en.explain: vector's move constructor hands a's buffer to b, and the standard guarantees the source is empty after a move construction, so a.size() is 0. Asking a moved-from vector for its size is fine.
whys: std::move is only a cast; the move constructor runs and nothing is copied.
Backwards: the data moved from a to b.
A moved-from object is still valid, so calling size() is fine.
Right: the buffer moved to b and a is left empty.

zh.q: 下面的 C++ 程序（g++ -std=c++17）输出什么？
zh.explain: C++17 起，用同类型的纯右值（prvalue）初始化对象时保证省略拷贝：return A() 和 A a = make() 直接在 a 的位置构造，只打印一次 D，即使编译器没开优化。
whys: C++17 之前可能看到一次移动，C++17 里这种写法必须省略。
两次移动是 C++11 不做省略时的情况，C++17 里不会发生。
正确：C++17 保证的拷贝省略，不调用移动或拷贝构造。
就算没有省略，也会优先用移动构造，而不是拷贝构造。

en.q: What does this C++ program print (g++ -std=c++17)?
en.explain: Since C++17, initializing an object from a prvalue of the same type is guaranteed to skip the copy: return A() and A a = make() construct straight into a, so only D prints, even at -O0.
whys: Before C++17 a move could show up here; C++17 requires the elision.
Two moves is C++11 without elision, which C++17 rules out.
Right: C++17 guaranteed copy elision; no move or copy runs.
Even without elision the move constructor would win over the copy.

zh.q: 下面的 C++ 程序（g++ -std=c++17）输出什么？
zh.explain: std::move(a) 得到的是 const A&&，移动构造要 A&&（非 const），绑不上，只能退回拷贝构造，打印 C。b 不是 const，std::move(b) 走移动构造，打印 M。
whys: 第二次的 b 不是 const，会调用移动构造。
正确：const 对象没法被移动，只能拷贝。
const A&& 绑不到 A&& 参数上，第一次其实是拷贝。
顺序反了：先拷贝（const 的 a），后移动（b）。

en.q: What does this C++ program print (g++ -std=c++17)?
en.explain: std::move(a) yields const A&&. The move constructor takes a non-const A&&, so it cannot bind and the copy constructor runs: C. b is not const, so std::move(b) moves: M.
whys: b is not const, so the second one moves.
Right: a const object cannot be moved from, so it is copied.
const A&& cannot bind to an A&& parameter, so the first one copies.
Reversed: the const a is copied first, then b is moved.

zh.q: 下面的 C++ 程序（g++ -std=c++17）输出什么？
zh.explain: hi 是虚函数，按对象的实际类型（Derived）调用；plain 不是虚函数，按指针的静态类型（Base*）调用，Derived::plain 只是把它隐藏了。
whys: hi 是虚函数且被重写，会调用 Derived::hi。
非虚函数不会动态分派，p->plain() 调的是 Base::plain。
正确：虚函数看对象，非虚函数看指针类型。
两处都说反了。

en.q: What does this C++ program print (g++ -std=c++17)?
en.explain: hi is virtual, so the call goes by the object's real type, Derived. plain is not virtual, so it goes by the pointer's static type, Base*; Derived::plain only hides it.
whys: hi is virtual and overridden, so Derived::hi runs.
A non-virtual call is not dispatched: p->plain() calls Base::plain.
Right: virtual calls follow the object, non-virtual ones the pointer type.
Both calls are the wrong way round.

zh.q: 下面的 C++ 程序（g++ -std=c++17）输出什么？
zh.explain: 按值传递时只拷贝了 Base 那一部分（对象切片），b 就是一个 Base，name() 返回 "Base"。按引用传递不拷贝，虚函数仍分派到 Derived。
whys: 正确：按值传参发生切片，按引用传参保留动态类型。
说反了：切片发生在按值传参那一边。
引用绑定的是原来的 Derived 对象，虚函数会分派过去。
按值传参会切片，b 已经是一个 Base 对象了。

en.q: What does this C++ program print (g++ -std=c++17)?
en.explain: Passing by value copies only the Base part (object slicing): b is a real Base, so name() returns "Base". Passing by reference copies nothing, and the virtual call reaches Derived.
whys: Right: by value slices, by reference keeps the dynamic type.
Reversed: slicing happens on the by-value side.
The reference binds to the original Derived, so the virtual call reaches it.
Pass by value slices: b is a plain Base object.

zh.q: 下面的 C++ 程序（g++ -std=c++17）输出什么？
zh.explain: 构造 Base 部分时，对象的动态类型还是 Base（Derived 的成员还没初始化），所以在构造函数里调用虚函数只会调到 Base::hello。这是确定的行为，不是未定义行为（纯虚函数才另当别论）。
whys: 此时 Derived 部分还没构造，不会分派到 Derived::hello。
构造函数只调用了一次 hello。
正确：构造期间虚函数按正在构造的那一层分派。
调用的不是纯虚函数，行为是确定的。

en.q: What does this C++ program print (g++ -std=c++17)?
en.explain: While the Base part is being built, the object's dynamic type is still Base (Derived's members are not initialized yet), so a virtual call in the constructor reaches Base::hello. This is well defined; only calling a pure virtual function would not be.
whys: The Derived part is not built yet, so Derived::hello is not reached.
The constructor calls hello only once.
Right: during construction, virtual calls go to the class being constructed.
It is not a pure virtual call, so the behaviour is defined.

zh.q: 下面的 C++ 程序（g++ -std=c++17）输出什么？
zh.explain: 局部对象按声明顺序构造，离开作用域时按相反顺序析构：先 b 后 a。析构发生在 main 结束时，在打印 | 之后。
whys: 析构顺序与构造相反，b 先析构。
对象活到作用域结束，不会构造完立刻析构。
正确：先构造的后析构。
离开 main 的作用域时析构函数一定会运行。

en.q: What does this C++ program print (g++ -std=c++17)?
en.explain: Local objects are constructed in declaration order and destroyed in reverse when the scope ends: b first, then a. That happens as main returns, after the | is printed.
whys: Destruction runs in reverse order, so b goes first.
Objects live until the end of their scope, not just past construction.
Right: first constructed, last destroyed.
Leaving main's scope always runs the destructors.

zh.q: 下面的 C++ 程序（g++ -std=c++17）输出什么？
zh.explain: 通过基类指针 delete 派生类对象，而基类析构函数不是虚函数，C++ 标准规定这是未定义行为。实际编译出来常常只打印 ~B（Derived 部分没被析构），但不能依赖。修法是给 Base 加 virtual ~Base()。
whys: 析构顺序是先派生类后基类，而且这里本身就是未定义行为。
常见的实际现象，但标准不保证，属于未定义行为。
正确：基类析构函数非虚，通过基类指针 delete 是未定义行为。
这是 ~Base 为虚函数时的输出。

en.q: What does this C++ program print (g++ -std=c++17)?
en.explain: Deleting a derived object through a base pointer when the base destructor is not virtual is undefined behaviour by the standard. Real builds often print just ~B (the Derived part is never destroyed), but nothing guarantees it. The fix is virtual ~Base().
whys: Derived parts are destroyed before base parts, and this is UB anyway.
Often what happens, but nothing guarantees it: it is undefined.
Right: deleting through a base pointer with a non-virtual destructor is UB.
That is what a virtual ~Base would print.

zh.q: 下面的 C++ 程序（g++ -std=c++17）输出什么？
zh.explain: 函数内的 static 变量只初始化一次，之后一直保留上次的值。三次调用依次返回 1、2、3。
whys: 正确：static 局部变量在调用之间保留值。
打印的是第三次调用的返回值，前两次也都加过。
每次调用并不会把 n 重新设成 0；= 0 只在第一次执行。
打印的是 ++n 的结果，至少是 1。

en.q: What does this C++ program print (g++ -std=c++17)?
en.explain: A static local is initialized once and keeps its value between calls. The three calls return 1, 2 and 3.
whys: Right: a static local keeps its value between calls.
It prints the third call; the first two also counted.
n is not reset each call; = 0 runs only the first time.
It prints the result of ++n, which is at least 1.

zh.q: 下面的 C++ 程序（g++ -std=c++17）输出什么？
zh.explain: 静态成员属于类，所有对象共用一份。构造了 a、b、c 三个对象，count 加了三次；c 析构时没有减少（没写析构函数）。
whys: Dog::count 是共享的，每次构造都加 1。
静态成员不是每个对象各一份。
c 虽然已经析构，但没有代码去减少 count。
正确：三次构造，共用一个计数。

en.q: What does this C++ program print (g++ -std=c++17)?
en.explain: A static member belongs to the class; all objects share one copy. Three Dogs were constructed, so count went up three times; destroying c does not decrease it (there is no destructor doing that).
whys: Dog::count is shared and each construction adds 1.
A static member is not one per object.
c was destroyed, but nothing decrements count.
Right: three constructions, one shared counter.

zh.q: 下面的 C++ 程序（g++ -std=c++17）输出什么？
zh.explain: 无符号整数的运算按模 2^32 进行，0 - 1 回绕成 2^32 - 1 = 4294967295。这是标准定义好的行为，和有符号溢出不同。
whys: 无符号回绕是定义好的行为；有符号溢出才是未定义行为。
无符号类型不能表示负数，结果会回绕。
运算结果不会被截到 0。
正确：无符号数回绕到最大值。

en.q: What does this C++ program print (g++ -std=c++17)?
en.explain: Unsigned arithmetic is modulo 2^32, so 0 - 1 wraps to 2^32 - 1 = 4294967295. This is defined by the standard, unlike signed overflow.
whys: Unsigned wraparound is defined; signed overflow is the undefined one.
An unsigned type cannot hold -1; the result wraps.
The result is not clamped to 0.
Right: unsigned values wrap around to the maximum.

zh.q: 下面的 C++ 程序（g++ -std=c++17）输出什么？
zh.explain: 有符号整数溢出是未定义行为。很多机器上实际会打印 -2147483648，但编译器可以假设它不会发生并据此优化（比如把 x + 1 > x 直接当成 true），所以不能依赖任何结果。
whys: 正确：有符号溢出是未定义行为。
常见的实际结果，但标准不保证。
溢出不会归零。

en.q: What does this C++ program print (g++ -std=c++17)?
en.explain: Signed integer overflow is undefined behaviour. Many machines will print -2147483648, but the compiler may assume it never happens and optimize on that (treating x + 1 > x as always true, say), so no result can be relied on.
whys: Right: signed overflow is undefined behaviour.
An int cannot hold 2147483648.
A common result in practice, but not guaranteed.
Overflow does not reset to 0.

zh.q: 下面的 C++ 程序（g++ -std=c++17）输出什么？
zh.explain: 算术运算前，unsigned char 会先提升为 int，所以 a + b 是 int 的 300，不会在 8 位里回绕；结果是 int，打印成数字。
whys: 300 - 256 = 44 是在 8 位里回绕的结果，但运算是在 int 里做的。
结果是 int，不是 char，不会打印成字符。
int 装得下 300，没有溢出。
正确：整型提升后按 int 相加。

en.q: What does this C++ program print (g++ -std=c++17)?
en.explain: Before arithmetic, unsigned char operands are promoted to int, so a + b is the int 300, with no 8-bit wraparound, and it prints as a number.
whys: 44 is 300 - 256, an 8-bit wrap, but the addition happens in int.
The sum is an int, not a char, so it is not printed as a character.
An int holds 300 easily; nothing overflows.
Right: promoted to int, then added.

zh.q: 下面的 C++ 程序（g++ -std=c++17）输出什么？
zh.explain: int 和 unsigned int 比较时，int 会转换成 unsigned int，-1 变成 4294967295，比 1 大，所以 a < b 为假。编译器一般会给出 sign-compare 警告。
whys: 正确：-1 被转成很大的无符号数。
有符号到无符号的转换是定义好的（按模），不是未定义行为。
这段代码能编译，最多是警告。
数学上 -1 < 1，但比较是在无符号类型下做的。

en.q: What does this C++ program print (g++ -std=c++17)?
en.explain: Comparing int with unsigned int converts the int to unsigned: -1 becomes 4294967295, which is larger than 1, so a < b is false. Compilers usually warn (sign-compare).
whys: Right: -1 converts to a huge unsigned value.
Signed-to-unsigned conversion is defined (modulo), not UB.
It compiles; at most you get a warning.
Mathematically -1 < 1, but the comparison is done in unsigned.

zh.q: 下面的 C++ 程序（g++ -std=c++17）输出什么？
zh.explain: C++11 起整数除法向零取整：-7 / 2 = -3。余数满足 (a / b) * b + a % b == a，所以 -7 % 2 = -7 - (-6) = -1，余数和被除数同号。
whys: 商向零取整得 -3，不是 -4。
正确：向零取整，余数与被除数同号。
向下取整（-4、1）是 Python 的规则，不是 C++ 的。
商 -3 时余数必须是 -1，等式才成立。

en.q: What does this C++ program print (g++ -std=c++17)?
en.explain: Since C++11, integer division truncates toward zero: -7 / 2 is -3. The remainder satisfies (a / b) * b + a % b == a, so -7 % 2 = -7 - (-6) = -1; it takes the sign of the dividend.
whys: Truncating toward zero gives -3, not -4.
Right: truncation toward zero, remainder takes the dividend's sign.
Flooring (-4 and 1) is Python's rule, not C++'s.
With a quotient of -3, the remainder has to be -1 for the identity to hold.

zh.q: 下面的 C++ 程序（g++ -std=c++17）输出什么？
zh.explain: 同一数组内两个指针相减，结果是相隔的元素个数（不是字节数）：4 - 1 = 3。q = a + 1 指向 a[1]，值为 2。
whys: p 是 a[4]、q 是 a[1]，相差 3 个元素。
a + 1 指向 a[1]，值是 2 而不是 1。
12 是字节数（3 × sizeof(int)），指针相减按元素算。
正确：按元素计数，q 指向 a[1]。

en.q: What does this C++ program print (g++ -std=c++17)?
en.explain: Subtracting two pointers into the same array gives the distance in elements, not bytes: 4 - 1 = 3. q = a + 1 points at a[1], which is 2.
whys: p is a[4] and q is a[1]: 3 elements apart.
a + 1 points at a[1], which holds 2, not 1.
12 would be bytes (3 × sizeof(int)); pointer subtraction counts elements.
Right: counted in elements, and q points at a[1].

zh.q: 下面的 C++ 程序（g++ -std=c++17）输出什么？
zh.explain: const int* 是「指向 const int 的指针」：指针本身可以改指向（p = &y 没问题），但不能通过它修改所指的值，*p = 5 编译报错。若写成 int* const p，则正好相反。
whys: p 已经改指向 y，而且这段代码根本编译不过。
如果去掉 *p = 5，才会打印 2。
正确：不能通过指向 const 的指针赋值。
*p = 5 这一行编译不过，程序不会运行。

en.q: What does this C++ program print (g++ -std=c++17)?
en.explain: const int* is a pointer to const int: the pointer can be re-pointed (p = &y is fine), but you cannot write through it, so *p = 5 fails to compile. int* const p would be the other way round.
whys: p was re-pointed to y, and the code does not compile anyway.
Without *p = 5 it would print 2.
Right: you cannot assign through a pointer to const.
The line *p = 5 does not compile, so nothing runs.

zh.q: 下面的 C++ 程序（g++ -std=c++17）输出什么？
zh.explain: 引用一旦绑定就不能改绑。r = b 不是让 r 改指 b，而是把 b 的值 2 赋给 a。之后改 b 和 a、r 无关。
whys: r 还是 a 的别名，r = b 把 a 改成了 2。
r 没有改绑到 b，所以 r 不会跟着变成 3。
正确：r = b 是给 a 赋值。
a 已经被 r = b 改成 2 了。

en.q: What does this C++ program print (g++ -std=c++17)?
en.explain: A reference cannot be re-bound. r = b does not make r refer to b; it assigns b's value, 2, to a. Changing b afterwards does not touch a or r.
whys: r still names a, and r = b set a to 2.
r was not re-bound to b, so it does not become 3.
Right: r = b assigns to a.
a was already set to 2 by r = b.

zh.q: 下面的 C++ 程序（g++ -std=c++17）输出什么？
zh.explain: Box 没有自定义拷贝构造，默认拷贝逐个成员复制，b.v 和 a.v 是同一个指针（浅拷贝）。通过 b.v 改值，a 看到的也变了。程序有内存泄漏，但输出是确定的。
whys: 默认拷贝只复制指针，不会复制它指向的 int。
编译器会自动生成拷贝构造，可以编译。
这里没有释放内存，也没有越界，只是泄漏，行为是确定的。
正确：浅拷贝，两个对象共享同一个 int。

en.q: What does this C++ program print (g++ -std=c++17)?
en.explain: Box has no copy constructor of its own, so the default one copies member by member: b.v and a.v are the same pointer (a shallow copy). Writing through b.v changes what a sees. The program leaks memory, but its output is defined.
whys: The default copy copies the pointer, not the int behind it.
The compiler generates a copy constructor, so it compiles.
Nothing is freed or read out of bounds; it only leaks, which is defined.
Right: a shallow copy, both objects share one int.

zh.q: 下面的 C++ 程序（g++ -std=c++17）输出什么？
zh.explain: unique_ptr 独占所有权，不能拷贝只能移动。移动之后标准保证源指针为空，q 接管了那个 int。
whys: 对象本身没被改动，*q 仍是 7。
正确：移动后 p 为空，q 指向 7。
unique_ptr 的移动会把源置空，p 不再拥有对象。
auto q = std::move(p) 是移动构造，可以编译；拷贝才会报错。

en.q: What does this C++ program print (g++ -std=c++17)?
en.explain: unique_ptr has sole ownership: it can be moved, not copied. After a move the source is guaranteed to be null, and q owns the int.
whys: The int itself is untouched; *q is still 7.
Right: after the move p is null and q points at 7.
Moving a unique_ptr empties the source; p no longer owns anything.
auto q = std::move(p) is a move and compiles; only a copy would not.

zh.q: 下面的 C++ 程序（g++ -std=c++17）输出什么？
zh.explain: a、b、c 三个 shared_ptr 共享同一个对象，内层作用域里引用计数是 3；c 离开作用域析构，计数减到 2。
whys: c 离开作用域会析构，计数会减 1。
正确：3 个持有者，c 析构后剩 2 个。
离开内层作用域后 a、b 还在，计数是 2。
内层作用域里有 a、b、c 三个持有者。

en.q: What does this C++ program print (g++ -std=c++17)?
en.explain: a, b and c all share one object, so the count is 3 inside the block; c is destroyed when the block ends, bringing it back to 2.
whys: c is destroyed at the end of the block, so the count drops.
Right: three owners, then two once c is gone.
After the block a and b remain, so the count is 2.
Inside the block there are three owners: a, b and c.

zh.q: 下面的 C++ 程序（g++ -std=c++17）输出什么？
zh.explain: 调用哪个函数是运行时按对象类型决定的（D::f），但默认参数是编译时按静态类型（B&）填进去的，所以 x 用的是 B::f 的默认值 1。所以重写虚函数时不要改默认参数。
whys: 调用的是 D::f，而且默认参数是 1。
f 是虚函数，会调用 D::f。
正确：函数动态分派，默认参数静态绑定。
默认参数不随动态类型变化，用的是 B 的默认值。

en.q: What does this C++ program print (g++ -std=c++17)?
en.explain: Which function runs is decided at run time by the object (D::f), but default arguments are filled in at compile time from the static type (B&), so x gets B::f's default, 1. That is why overrides should not change default arguments.
whys: D::f runs, and the default argument is 1.
f is virtual, so D::f runs.
Right: the function is dispatched dynamically, the default is bound statically.
Default arguments do not follow the dynamic type; B's default is used.

zh.q: 下面的 C++ 程序（g++ -std=c++17）输出什么？
zh.explain: i++ 返回自增前的值（5），之后 i 为 6；++i 先自增再返回（7）。最后 i 是 7。每条语句只改一次 i，没有未定义行为。
whys: 执行了两次自增，i 最后是 7。
a 是 5，而且 ++i 之后 b 是 7。
正确：后置返回旧值，前置返回新值。
a 拿到的是 i++ 自增前的值 5。

en.q: What does this C++ program print (g++ -std=c++17)?
en.explain: i++ yields the old value (5) and leaves i at 6; ++i increments first and yields 7. i ends at 7. Each statement changes i once, so nothing is undefined.
whys: i was incremented twice, so it ends at 7.
a is 5, and after ++i b is 7.
Right: postfix yields the old value, prefix the new one.
a gets the value before i++, which is 5.

zh.q: 下面的 C++ 程序（g++ -std=c++17）输出什么？
zh.explain: 100000 和 100000 都是 int，乘法在 int 里做，10^10 超出 int 范围，是有符号溢出，属于未定义行为；结果再存进 long long 已经晚了。正确写法是 100000LL * 100000。这类错误在 OA 里很常见。
whys: 正确：int 乘法溢出，是未定义行为。
代码能编译，最多给出溢出警告。
这是截断到 32 位后常见的实际结果，但标准不保证。
乘法是在 int 里做完再转成 long long 的，不会得到这个值。

en.q: What does this C++ program print (g++ -std=c++17)?
en.explain: Both 100000s are ints, so the multiplication happens in int; 10^10 does not fit, which is signed overflow and undefined behaviour. Storing the result in a long long comes too late. Write 100000LL * 100000. This mistake shows up in OAs all the time.
whys: Right: the int multiplication overflows, which is UB.
It compiles; you may get an overflow warning.
What a 32-bit wrap often prints, but nothing guarantees it.
The product is computed in int and only then converted, so you do not get this.

zh.q: 下面的 C++ 程序（g++ -std=c++17）输出什么？
zh.explain: [n] 在创建 lambda 时把 n 的值（1）拷贝进去；[&n] 保存的是引用，调用时读的是 n 当前的值 5。
whys: 正确：按值捕获拷贝当时的值，按引用捕获读当前值。
按值捕获发生在创建 lambda 的时候，那时 n 是 1。
按引用捕获会看到 n = 5 之后的值。
两种捕获说反了。

en.q: What does this C++ program print (g++ -std=c++17)?
en.explain: [n] copies n's value (1) when the lambda is created; [&n] holds a reference, so a call reads n's current value, 5.
whys: Right: by value copies the value at creation, by reference reads it now.
Capture by value happens when the lambda is made, when n was 1.
Capture by reference sees n after n = 5.
The two captures are the wrong way round.

zh.q: 你刚提交了一个改动，执行 git reset --soft HEAD~1 之后，仓库是什么状态？
choices: 当前分支退回上一个提交，那次提交的改动仍在暂存区里
改动留在工作区，但已经不在暂存区
改动被彻底删除，工作区回到上一个提交
生成一个新提交来抵消上一次提交
zh.explain: reset 移动当前分支指针。--soft 只移动指针，暂存区和工作区都不动，所以改动处于「已暂存待提交」的状态，可以改完再重新提交。--mixed（默认）会把暂存区也重置，--hard 连工作区一起重置。
whys: 正确：--soft 只移动分支指针。
这是 --mixed（默认）的效果。
这是 --hard 的效果。
新建一个反向提交的是 git revert。

en.q: You just committed a change. After git reset --soft HEAD~1, what state is the repository in?
choices: The branch moves back one commit, and that commit's changes are still staged
The changes are in the working tree but no longer staged
The changes are gone and the working tree matches the previous commit
A new commit is made that undoes the last one
en.explain: reset moves the current branch pointer. --soft moves only the pointer and leaves the index and working tree alone, so the changes sit staged, ready to be committed again. --mixed (the default) also resets the index; --hard resets the working tree too.
whys: Right: --soft moves only the branch pointer.
That is --mixed, the default.
That is --hard.
Making an undoing commit is git revert.

zh.q: 不带选项执行 git reset HEAD~1（即 --mixed），上一次提交里的改动去哪了？
choices: 留在工作区，处于未暂存状态
zh.explain: --mixed 移动分支指针并重置暂存区，但不碰工作区。文件内容还是改过的样子，只是需要重新 git add。
whys: --mixed 不改工作区，改动还在文件里。
正确：工作区保留，暂存区被重置。
reset 不会动 stash。
仍在暂存区的是 --soft。

en.q: After git reset HEAD~1 with no option (that is, --mixed), where do the last commit's changes go?
choices: They stay in the working tree, unstaged
en.explain: --mixed moves the branch pointer and resets the index but leaves the working tree alone. The files still hold the changes; they just need git add again.
whys: --mixed leaves the working tree, so the changes are still in the files.
Right: working tree kept, index reset.
reset never touches the stash.
Staying staged is --soft.

zh.q: 执行 git reset --hard HEAD~1 之后，被撤掉的那个提交还能找回来吗？
choices: 能，但只能恢复提交信息，文件内容丢了
只能从远端仓库重新拉取
能：用 git reflog 找到它的哈希，在被垃圾回收前可以恢复
不能：--hard 会立即从仓库删除这个提交
zh.explain: reset 只是移动分支指针，提交对象仍在仓库里，只是没有分支指向它。reflog 记录了 HEAD 的移动历史，git reset --hard <哈希> 或新建分支就能找回。真正丢的是没提交过的工作区改动。
whys: 提交对象完整保存着文件快照。
本地的 reflog 就够了，不需要远端。
正确：提交还在，reflog 能找到。
reset 不会删除提交对象，只是不再被分支引用。

en.q: After git reset --hard HEAD~1, can the commit you dropped still be recovered?
choices: Partly: the message survives but the files are lost
Only by pulling it again from the remote
Yes: git reflog shows its hash, and it can be restored until garbage collection
No: --hard deletes the commit from the repository at once
en.explain: reset just moves the branch pointer; the commit object stays in the repository with nothing pointing at it. The reflog records where HEAD has been, so git reset --hard <hash> or a new branch brings it back. What is really lost is uncommitted work.
whys: The commit object keeps its full snapshot of files.
The local reflog is enough; no remote needed.
Right: the commit still exists and the reflog finds it.
reset does not delete commit objects; they just lose their branch.

zh.q: main 上的一个提交已经推送并被同事拉取，现在要撤销它，最安全的做法是？
choices: git revert <该提交>，生成一个反向提交再推送
git reset --hard 到它之前，再 git push --force
git commit --amend 修改这个提交
git rebase -i 把它删掉再推送
zh.explain: revert 不改历史，而是新加一个提交把那次改动反着做一遍，大家正常 pull 就行。reset、amend、rebase 都会改写已经共享出去的历史，需要强推，会让同事的副本分叉。
whys: 正确：revert 追加反向提交，不改写历史。
强推改写了共享历史，别人的副本会和远端分叉。
amend 会生成新的提交替换旧的，同样是改写历史。
rebase 删提交也是改写历史，需要强推。

en.q: A commit on main has been pushed and pulled by teammates. What is the safest way to undo it?
choices: git revert <that commit>, which adds an undoing commit, then push
git reset --hard to before it, then git push --force
git commit --amend to change that commit
git rebase -i to drop it, then push
en.explain: revert leaves history alone and adds a commit that applies the change in reverse, so everyone just pulls as usual. reset, amend and rebase all rewrite history that others already have, need a force push and leave teammates' copies diverged.
whys: Right: revert adds an undoing commit without rewriting history.
A force push rewrites shared history and leaves others diverged.
amend replaces the commit with a new one, which also rewrites history.
Dropping a commit in a rebase rewrites history and needs a force push.

zh.q: feature 分支从 main 的提交 A 拉出，之后 feature 上有 B、C，main 没有新提交。在 main 上执行 git merge feature 的结果是？
choices: 生成一个合并提交 M，父提交是 A 和 C
把 B、C 复制成新提交接在 main 后面
快进（fast-forward）：main 直接指向 C，不产生合并提交
zh.explain: main 是 feature 的祖先时，不需要真正合并，Git 只把 main 指针往前移到 C。想保留「这里合并过一个分支」的记录，可以用 git merge --no-ff 强制生成合并提交。
whys: 只有加 --no-ff（或两边都有新提交）时才会生成合并提交。
复制成新提交是 rebase 或 cherry-pick 的做法。
main 没有新改动，不会有冲突。
正确：main 是祖先，直接快进。

en.q: feature branched from main at commit A and has B and C on top; main has nothing new. What does git merge feature on main do?
choices: A merge commit M with parents A and C
B and C are copied as new commits onto main
A conflict that must be resolved by hand
A fast-forward: main simply points at C, with no merge commit
en.explain: When main is an ancestor of feature, there is nothing to combine: Git just moves main forward to C. To keep a record that a branch was merged, git merge --no-ff forces a merge commit.
whys: A merge commit appears only with --no-ff, or when both sides moved.
Copying commits is what rebase or cherry-pick do.
main has no new changes, so nothing can conflict.
Right: main is an ancestor, so it fast-forwards.

zh.q: feature 从 A 拉出后有提交 B、C；main 在 A 之后有了 D。在 feature 上执行 git rebase main 之后，feature 的历史是？
choices: A → B → C，外加一个父提交为 C 和 D 的合并提交
A → D → B → C，B、C 的哈希不变
A → D → B' → C'，B'、C' 是内容相同但哈希不同的新提交
zh.explain: rebase 把 B、C 的改动依次重新应用到 D 之后。提交的哈希包含父提交，父提交变了，所以生成的是新提交 B'、C'。原来的 B、C 不再被 feature 引用。
whys: rebase 是把 feature 的提交接到 main 后面，不是反过来。
生成合并提交的是 git merge main。
父提交变了，哈希一定会变。
正确：重放到 D 之后，哈希改变。

en.q: feature branched at A and has B and C; main has D after A. After git rebase main on feature, what is feature's history?
choices: A → B → C plus a merge commit whose parents are C and D
A → D → B → C, with B and C keeping their hashes
A → D → B' → C', where B' and C' are new commits with the same changes and new hashes
en.explain: rebase replays the changes of B and C on top of D. A commit's hash covers its parent, and the parents changed, so the results are new commits B' and C'. The original B and C are no longer on feature.
whys: rebase puts feature's commits after main's, not the other way.
A merge commit is what git merge main would make.
The parents changed, so the hashes must change.
Right: replayed after D, with new hashes.

zh.q: 为什么不要对已经推送、别人也在用的分支执行 rebase？
choices: rebase 会把所有提交压成一个
rebase 会丢掉别人的提交
rebase 之后无法再 push 到远端
rebase 会用新提交替换旧提交，别人的副本仍基于旧提交，会出现重复和分叉
zh.explain: rebase 改写历史：旧提交被新哈希的提交取代，推送需要 --force。同事本地还有旧提交，再拉取时两套内容相同的提交会混在一起。所以 rebase 适合整理还没共享的本地提交。
whys: 压缩提交是 rebase -i 里 squash 的可选操作，不是默认行为。
rebase 不会丢掉提交的改动，问题在于哈希变了。
可以推送，只是需要强制推送。
正确：改写共享历史会让别人的副本分叉。

en.q: Why should you not rebase a branch that is already pushed and used by others?
choices: It squashes every commit into one
It throws away other people's commits
You can never push after a rebase
It replaces commits with new ones while others still build on the old ones, causing duplicates and divergence
en.explain: rebase rewrites history: old commits are replaced by new ones with new hashes, and pushing needs --force. Teammates still have the old commits, and pulling mixes the two sets of identical changes. So rebase is for tidying local commits nobody else has yet.
whys: Squashing is an optional step in rebase -i, not the default.
rebase keeps the changes; the problem is the new hashes.
You can push, but only with a force push.
Right: rewriting shared history leaves others diverged.

zh.q: 只改了上一次提交的提交信息，执行 git commit --amend 之后会怎样？
choices: 生成一个哈希不同的新提交，取代原来的提交
只修改本地，推送时自动同步成原来的哈希
原提交的哈希不变，只更新信息
在原提交之后追加一个新提交
zh.explain: 提交信息也是提交对象的一部分，参与哈希计算。amend 实际上是用新的信息（和当前暂存区）创建一个新提交，再把分支指过去。如果原提交已经推送，就成了改写历史。
whys: 正确：任何改动都会产生新哈希。
推送的是新提交；远端如果有旧提交需要强推。
提交信息参与哈希计算，哈希一定会变。
amend 是替换，不是追加。

en.q: You change only the message of your last commit with git commit --amend. What happens?
choices: A new commit with a different hash replaces the old one
Only the local copy changes; pushing restores the old hash
The commit keeps its hash and only the message changes
A new commit is added after the old one
en.explain: The message is part of the commit object and goes into its hash. amend creates a new commit with the new message (and the current index) and points the branch at it. If the old commit was pushed, this rewrites history.
whys: Right: any change makes a new hash.
Pushing sends the new commit; if the remote has the old one you need a force push.
The message is hashed too, so the hash changes.
amend replaces; it does not append.

zh.q: git checkout <某个提交的哈希> 之后提示 detached HEAD。此时新建的提交会怎样？
choices: 自动创建一个以哈希命名的分支
无法提交，必须先切回分支
它们不在任何分支上，切走之后若不建分支，可能被垃圾回收
自动加到 main 分支上
zh.explain: detached HEAD 表示 HEAD 直接指向一个提交，而不是指向分支。仍然可以提交，但没有分支名记住它们。想保留就在切走前执行 git switch -c 新分支名；切走之后也能在 reflog 里找回一段时间。
whys: Git 不会自动建分支。
detached HEAD 下可以正常提交。
正确：没有分支引用，需要自己建分支保存。
提交不会自动加到任何分支上。

en.q: git checkout <a commit hash> says detached HEAD. What happens to commits you make now?
choices: A branch named after the hash is created automatically
You cannot commit until you switch back to a branch
They are on no branch; switch away without making one and they may be garbage-collected
They are added to main automatically
en.explain: Detached HEAD means HEAD points straight at a commit rather than at a branch. You can still commit, but no branch name keeps track of the new commits. Run git switch -c <name> before leaving to keep them; the reflog can still find them for a while after.
whys: Git does not create a branch for you.
You can commit normally with a detached HEAD.
Right: no branch refers to them; make one to keep them.
They are not added to any branch.

zh.q: feature 上还有没合并到当前分支的提交，执行 git branch -d feature 会怎样？
choices: 拒绝删除并提示分支未完全合并；要强删用 -D
删除分支和其中所有提交，且无法恢复
zh.explain: -d 是安全删除，分支上有没合并的提交时会拒绝，避免误删工作。-D 强制删除；即使删了，提交对象在被垃圾回收前仍可通过 reflog 找回。删除远端分支是 git push origin --delete feature。
whys: 正确：-d 会检查是否已合并。
branch -d 从不自动合并。
git branch -d 只操作本地分支。
-d 不会删除未合并的分支；即使用 -D，提交在一段时间内也能找回。

en.q: feature has commits not merged into your current branch. What does git branch -d feature do?
choices: It refuses, saying the branch is not fully merged; -D forces it
It merges the branch first, then deletes it
It deletes only the remote branch
It deletes the branch and its commits for good
en.explain: -d is the safe delete: it refuses while the branch has unmerged commits, so work is not lost by accident. -D forces it; even then the commits can be found through the reflog until garbage collection. Deleting the remote branch is git push origin --delete feature.
whys: Right: -d checks that the branch is merged.
branch -d never merges anything.
git branch -d only touches the local branch.
-d will not delete an unmerged branch, and even after -D the commits are recoverable for a while.

zh.q: git fetch 和 git pull 的区别是？
choices: 两者完全相同，只是名字不同
fetch 只更新远端跟踪分支（如 origin/main），pull 是 fetch 之后再合并（或变基）到当前分支
fetch 会覆盖本地未提交的改动，pull 不会
fetch 只下载提交信息，pull 才下载文件内容
zh.explain: fetch 把远端的新提交下载下来，更新 origin/main 这类远端跟踪分支，不碰你的分支和工作区，可以先 git log main..origin/main 看看再决定。pull 等于 fetch 加 merge（配置后可以是 rebase）。
whys: pull 比 fetch 多了合并这一步。
正确：pull = fetch + merge/rebase。
fetch 完全不碰工作区。
fetch 会下载完整的提交对象，包括文件内容。

en.q: What is the difference between git fetch and git pull?
choices: They are identical apart from the name
fetch only updates remote-tracking branches such as origin/main; pull is a fetch followed by a merge (or rebase) into your branch
fetch overwrites uncommitted changes; pull does not
fetch downloads only commit messages; pull downloads the files
en.explain: fetch downloads new commits and updates remote-tracking branches such as origin/main, without touching your branch or working tree, so you can inspect with git log main..origin/main first. pull is fetch plus merge (or rebase, if configured).
whys: pull adds a merge step that fetch does not have.
Right: pull is fetch plus merge or rebase.
fetch never touches the working tree.
fetch downloads whole commit objects, file contents included.

zh.q: 在 main 上执行 git cherry-pick <hotfix 分支上的某个提交>，结果是？
choices: 把那个提交从 hotfix 移到 main，hotfix 上不再有它
main 直接指向那个提交
把那个提交的改动作为一个新提交应用到 main 上，哈希不同
把 hotfix 整个分支合并进 main
zh.explain: cherry-pick 只取一个提交的改动（相对于它的父提交的差异），在当前分支上新建一个提交。原提交还留在 hotfix 上，两个提交改动相同、哈希不同。
whys: 原提交仍在 hotfix 上，cherry-pick 是复制不是移动。
移动指针的是 reset 或快进合并。
正确：复制改动，生成新提交。
只取这一个提交，不会合并整个分支。

en.q: On main you run git cherry-pick <a commit from the hotfix branch>. What happens?
choices: The commit moves from hotfix to main and leaves hotfix
main is pointed straight at that commit
That commit's changes are applied to main as a new commit with a different hash
The whole hotfix branch is merged into main
en.explain: cherry-pick takes one commit's changes (its diff from its parent) and makes a new commit on the current branch. The original stays on hotfix; the two commits share the change but not the hash.
whys: The original stays on hotfix; cherry-pick copies, it does not move.
Moving the pointer is reset or a fast-forward.
Right: the change is copied into a new commit.
Only that commit is taken, not the whole branch.

zh.q: 修改 app.js 后执行 git add app.js，又接着修改了 app.js，然后直接 git commit（不加 -a）。这次提交里是哪个版本？
choices: 两次修改都不提交，因为文件在 add 之后变了
Git 报错，要求先解决冲突
git add 时的版本；第二次修改仍留在工作区未暂存
zh.explain: git add 把文件当时的内容放进暂存区，commit 提交的是暂存区里的快照，不会去读工作区的最新内容。git status 会同时显示这个文件「已暂存」和「未暂存」的改动。
whys: 要提交最新版本得再 add 一次，或用 commit -a。
暂存区里有内容，可以正常提交。
这不是冲突，只是暂存区和工作区不同。
正确：提交的是暂存区的快照。

en.q: You edit app.js, run git add app.js, edit app.js again, then git commit without -a. Which version is committed?
choices: Neither, because the file changed after add
Git errors and asks you to resolve a conflict
The version at git add time; the second edit stays unstaged
en.explain: git add puts the file's content at that moment into the index, and commit records the index, not the latest working copy. git status shows the file under both staged and unstaged changes.
whys: The latest version needs another add, or commit -a.
The index has content, so the commit goes through.
This is not a conflict; the index and working tree just differ.
Right: commit records the index snapshot.

zh.q: 关于 git stash（不带参数），哪项正确？
choices: 丢弃所有未提交的改动
保存工作区里的所有文件，包括未跟踪和被忽略的
保存已跟踪文件的未提交改动并清理工作区，新建的未跟踪文件默认不保存
把改动提交到一个名为 stash 的分支
zh.explain: stash 把已跟踪文件的修改（暂存和未暂存的）存起来，工作区回到 HEAD 的样子，之后用 git stash pop 取回。未跟踪文件要加 -u，被忽略的文件要加 -a。
whys: 改动被保存了，可以用 pop 或 apply 取回。
未跟踪文件要 -u，被忽略的要 -a。
正确：默认只处理已跟踪文件。
stash 存在专门的 stash 列表里，不是普通分支。

en.q: Which is true of git stash with no options?
choices: It throws away all uncommitted changes
It saves every file, untracked and ignored ones included
It saves uncommitted changes to tracked files and cleans the working tree; new untracked files are left out by default
It commits the changes to a branch called stash
en.explain: stash saves changes to tracked files, staged and unstaged, and resets the working tree to HEAD; git stash pop brings them back. Untracked files need -u, and ignored ones -a.
whys: The changes are saved and come back with pop or apply.
Untracked files need -u, ignored ones -a.
Right: by default it only handles tracked files.
Stashes live in their own list, not on a branch.

zh.q: git log main..feature 列出的是哪些提交？
choices: 在 main 上、但不在 feature 上的提交
在 feature 上、但不在 main 上的提交
两个分支上所有的提交
两个分支共同拥有的提交
zh.explain: A..B 表示「从 B 可达、从 A 不可达」的提交，常用来查看 feature 比 main 多了什么，比如合并前审查。反过来 feature..main 是 main 上新增的提交。
whys: 那是 git log feature..main。
正确：B 有而 A 没有的提交。
列出全部提交不需要 .. 语法。
共同的祖先提交被排除在外。

en.q: Which commits does git log main..feature list?
choices: Commits on main that are not on feature
Commits on feature that are not on main
en.explain: A..B means commits reachable from B but not from A, the usual way to see what feature adds over main, say before merging. feature..main would list what main has gained.
whys: That would be git log feature..main.
Right: what B has that A does not.
Listing everything does not use .. at all.
Shared ancestors are exactly what gets excluded.

zh.q: umask 是 022 时，用 touch 新建的普通文件权限是多少？
zh.explain: 普通文件的起点是 666（新文件默认不带执行权限），umask 表示要去掉的位：666 去掉 022 得 644。目录的起点是 777，同样的 umask 下是 755。
whys: 600 对应 umask 077。
这是把 umask 当成了要保留的位。
755 是新建目录的权限；普通文件默认没有执行位。

en.q: With umask 022, what permissions does a new regular file made by touch get?
en.explain: Regular files start from 666 (new files get no execute bit), and the umask lists the bits to clear: 666 minus 022 is 644. Directories start from 777 and would get 755.
whys: 600 needs umask 077.
This treats the umask as bits to keep.
Right: 666 with 022 cleared.
755 is what a new directory gets; files get no execute bit by default.

zh.q: umask 是 027 时，mkdir 新建的目录权限是多少？
zh.explain: 目录的起点是 777。umask 027 去掉组的写权限和其他人的全部权限：777 去掉 027 得 750。
whys: 640 是同一 umask 下新建普通文件的权限。
755 对应 umask 022。
umask 是要去掉的位，不是最终权限。

en.q: With umask 027, what permissions does a directory made by mkdir get?
en.explain: Directories start from 777. umask 027 clears the group's write bit and every bit for others: 777 minus 027 is 750.
whys: 640 is what a regular file gets under the same umask.
755 comes from umask 022.
Right: 777 with 027 cleared.
The umask is the bits to remove, not the result.

zh.q: 执行 chmod 754 report.sh 之后，ls -l 显示的权限是？
zh.explain: 每一位八进制数对应 r=4、w=2、x=1 之和：7 = rwx（所有者），5 = r-x（组），4 = r--（其他人）。
whys: 所有者的 7 包含执行位。
组的 5 是 r-x，不是 rw-。
正确：7、5、4 分别是 rwx、r-x、r--。
4 是读（r），不是写（w）。

en.q: After chmod 754 report.sh, which permissions does ls -l show?
en.explain: Each octal digit is the sum of r=4, w=2, x=1: 7 = rwx (owner), 5 = r-x (group), 4 = r-- (others).
whys: The owner's 7 includes execute.
The group's 5 is r-x, not rw-.
Right: 7, 5 and 4 are rwx, r-x and r--.
4 is read (r), not write (w).

zh.q: 对一个目录来说，x（执行）权限意味着什么？
choices: 进入该目录，并按名字访问其中的文件
在目录里新建和删除文件
zh.explain: 目录的 r 允许列出文件名，w（配合 x）允许增删文件，x 允许进入目录（cd）和通过路径访问里面的文件。只有 r 没有 x，能看到文件名却打不开文件。
whys: 正确：x 控制进入目录和路径解析。
目录不能被执行，x 在目录上有专门的含义。
增删文件需要 w 权限（并且有 x）。
列文件名靠的是 r 权限。

en.q: For a directory, what does the x (execute) permission allow?
choices: Entering it and reaching files inside by name
Running the directory as a program
Creating and deleting files in it
Listing the file names in it
en.explain: On a directory, r lets you list names, w (together with x) lets you add and remove entries, and x lets you enter it (cd) and reach files through it. With r but no x you can see names but not open the files.
whys: Right: x controls entering the directory and resolving paths through it.
A directory is never executed; x has its own meaning there.
Adding and removing entries needs w (plus x).
Listing names needs r.

zh.q: 想把一个命令的标准输出和标准错误都写进 out.txt，应该用哪一条？
zh.explain: 重定向从左到右处理。先 > out.txt 让 1 指向文件，再 2>&1 让 2 指向 1 当前指向的地方（文件）。顺序反过来时，2 先复制了 1 原来的去向（终端），之后 1 才改到文件。
whys: 2>&1 先执行时，stderr 复制的是终端，仍然打印到屏幕。
管道只传 stdout，stderr 不会进 tee。
正确：先重定向 1，再让 2 跟着 1。
这样只有 stderr 进文件，stdout 还在终端。

en.q: Which command sends both a command's standard output and standard error to out.txt?
en.explain: Redirections apply left to right. > out.txt points fd 1 at the file, then 2>&1 points fd 2 wherever fd 1 points now: the file. The other order copies fd 1's old target (the terminal) into fd 2 before fd 1 moves.
whys: With 2>&1 first, stderr copies the terminal and still goes to the screen.
A pipe carries only stdout; stderr never reaches tee.
Right: redirect fd 1 first, then make fd 2 follow it.
That sends only stderr to the file.

zh.q: cat access.log | grep " 404 " | wc -l 输出的是什么？
choices: access.log 中包含 " 404 " 的行数
" 404 " 在文件中出现的总次数
zh.explain: grep 按行输出匹配的行，wc -l 统计收到的行数。同一行出现两次也只算一行，要数出现次数得用 grep -o 再 wc -l。
whys: 正确：统计匹配的行数。
最后的 wc -l 把行变成了一个数字。
grep 已经过滤掉了不匹配的行。
一行里出现多次也只算一行；数次数要 grep -o。

en.q: What does cat access.log | grep " 404 " | wc -l print?
choices: The number of lines in access.log containing " 404 "
The number of lines in access.log
The total number of times " 404 " appears
en.explain: grep prints each matching line once, and wc -l counts the lines it receives. A line with two matches still counts once; counting occurrences needs grep -o before wc -l.
whys: Right: it counts matching lines.
The final wc -l turns the lines into a count.
grep has already dropped the lines that do not match.
Several matches on one line count once; occurrences need grep -o.

zh.q: 统计每个 IP 出现次数时常写 sort | uniq -c，为什么要先 sort？
choices: sort 会顺便去掉重复行
uniq 只能处理排好序的数字
uniq -c 的输出需要按次数排序
uniq 只合并相邻的重复行
zh.explain: uniq 只比较相邻的两行，不相邻的重复行会被当成不同的组分别计数。先 sort 让相同的行挨在一起，uniq -c 才能数对。想按次数排序还要再接一个 sort -rn。
whys: 普通 sort 不去重；去重要 sort -u。
uniq 处理任意文本，不要求是数字。
按次数排序是之后再加 sort -rn 的事，不是先 sort 的原因。
正确：uniq 只看相邻行。

en.q: Counting hits per IP is often written sort | uniq -c. Why sort first?
choices: sort removes duplicate lines on the way
uniq only works on sorted numbers
uniq -c needs its output ordered by count
uniq only merges adjacent duplicate lines
en.explain: uniq compares each line only with the one before it, so duplicates that are not adjacent are counted as separate groups. Sorting first puts equal lines together so uniq -c counts them right. Ordering by count needs another sort -rn after.
whys: Plain sort keeps duplicates; sort -u removes them.
uniq handles any text, not just numbers.
Ordering by count is a later sort -rn, not why we sort first.
Right: uniq only looks at adjacent lines.

zh.q: 关于 kill -9 <pid>，下面哪项正确？
choices: 发送 SIGTERM，进程可以做完清理再退出
先通知子进程退出，再结束该进程
发送 SIGKILL，进程不能捕获或忽略，来不及执行清理代码
只会暂停进程，之后可以用 fg 恢复
zh.explain: 9 号信号是 SIGKILL，由内核直接结束进程，进程没有机会处理。不带参数的 kill 发送的是 15 号 SIGTERM，程序可以捕获它后关闭连接、写完文件再退出，所以应先用 kill，再不行才用 kill -9。
whys: 这是不带 -9 的 kill（SIGTERM）的行为。
信号只发给指定的进程，子进程不会先被处理。
正确：SIGKILL 无法捕获、阻塞或忽略。
暂停是 SIGSTOP / SIGTSTP 的效果。

en.q: Which is true of kill -9 <pid>?
choices: It sends SIGTERM, so the process can clean up and exit
It stops the children first, then the process
It sends SIGKILL, which cannot be caught or ignored, so no cleanup code runs
It only pauses the process; fg resumes it
en.explain: Signal 9 is SIGKILL: the kernel ends the process and the process gets no say. Plain kill sends signal 15, SIGTERM, which a program can catch to close connections and flush files before exiting, so try kill first and kill -9 only if that fails.
whys: That is plain kill, which sends SIGTERM.
The signal goes to that process only; children are not handled first.
Right: SIGKILL cannot be caught, blocked or ignored.
Pausing is what SIGSTOP or SIGTSTP do.

zh.q: 在终端里运行一个程序时按下 Ctrl+Z，会发生什么？
choices: 进程转到后台继续运行
撤销上一条命令的效果
前台进程收到 SIGINT 并退出
前台进程收到 SIGTSTP 被挂起，之后可以用 fg 或 bg 继续
zh.explain: Ctrl+Z 发送 SIGTSTP，让前台作业暂停（jobs 里显示 Stopped）。fg 让它回到前台继续，bg 让它在后台继续。Ctrl+C 才是发送 SIGINT 中断程序。
whys: 挂起后进程是停止状态，要用 bg 才会在后台继续运行。
终端没有撤销命令这种操作。
发送 SIGINT 的是 Ctrl+C。
正确：挂起，而不是结束。

en.q: What happens when you press Ctrl+Z while a program runs in the terminal?
choices: The process keeps running in the background
The foreground process gets SIGINT and exits
The foreground process gets SIGTSTP and is suspended; fg or bg resumes it
en.explain: Ctrl+Z sends SIGTSTP and stops the foreground job (jobs shows it as Stopped). fg resumes it in the foreground, bg in the background. Ctrl+C is the one that sends SIGINT to interrupt it.
whys: The process is stopped; it only runs in the background after bg.
A terminal has no undo for commands.
Ctrl+C is the one that sends SIGINT.
Right: suspended, not ended.

zh.q: ps 里看到一个状态为 Z（defunct）的僵尸进程，它是怎么产生的？
choices: 进程陷入死循环，占满了 CPU
进程收到 SIGSTOP 被暂停了
父进程先退出了，子进程没人管
子进程已经退出，但父进程还没有调用 wait 读取它的退出状态
zh.explain: 进程退出后，内核保留一条进程表项，存放退出状态，等父进程 wait。父进程一直不 wait，这条表项就一直留着，这就是僵尸进程。它不占 CPU 和内存，但占 PID；解决办法是让父进程 wait，或者结束父进程，让 init 收养后清理。
whys: 僵尸进程已经结束运行，不占 CPU。
被暂停的进程状态是 T（stopped），不是 Z。
父进程先退出产生的是孤儿进程，会被 init 收养并回收。
正确：已退出但未被回收。

en.q: ps shows a process in state Z (defunct), a zombie. How did it get there?
choices: The process is stuck in a loop using all the CPU
It received SIGSTOP and is paused
Its parent exited first and left it alone
The child has exited, but its parent has not called wait to collect its exit status
en.explain: When a process exits, the kernel keeps a process-table entry holding its exit status until the parent waits for it. If the parent never waits, the entry stays: that is a zombie. It uses no CPU or memory but holds a PID; fix the parent to wait, or end the parent so init adopts and reaps it.
whys: A zombie has finished running and uses no CPU.
A paused process shows state T (stopped), not Z.
A parent exiting first makes an orphan, which init adopts and reaps.
Right: exited but not yet reaped.

zh.q: 父进程先退出了，它的子进程还在运行。子进程会怎样？
choices: 暂停，直到有新的父进程接管
成为孤儿进程，被 init（PID 1）或指定的 subreaper 收养，继续运行
zh.explain: 父进程退出不会自动结束子进程。孤儿进程会被重新挂到 init（或设置了 subreaper 的进程，如 systemd --user）下面，它退出时由新的父进程回收。终端关闭时子进程往往结束，是因为收到了 SIGHUP，而不是因为父进程没了。
whys: 进程不会因为换父进程而暂停。
僵尸是「已退出但没被 wait」，这个子进程还在运行。
内核不会因为父进程退出就结束子进程。
正确：被收养，继续运行。

en.q: A parent exits while its child is still running. What happens to the child?
choices: It pauses until a new parent takes over
The kernel ends it at once
It becomes an orphan, is adopted by init (PID 1) or a designated subreaper, and keeps running
en.explain: A parent exiting does not end its children. The orphan is re-parented to init (or a subreaper such as systemd --user), which reaps it when it exits. Children often die when a terminal closes because they get SIGHUP, not because the parent is gone.
whys: Changing parents does not pause a process.
A zombie has exited without being waited on; this child is still running.
The kernel does not end a child because its parent exited.
Right: adopted, still running.

zh.q: 在 bash 里，$? 保存的是什么？
choices: 上一条命令的退出状态，0 表示成功
最近一个后台进程的进程号
当前 shell 的进程号
zh.explain: $? 是上一条命令的退出码，0 表示成功，非 0 表示某种失败。$$ 是当前 shell 的 PID，$! 是最近的后台进程 PID，$# 是参数个数。
whys: 正确：退出码，0 为成功。
参数个数是 $#。
最近的后台进程 PID 是 $!。
当前 shell 的 PID 是 $$。

en.q: In bash, what does $? hold?
choices: The exit status of the last command; 0 means success
The number of arguments passed to the script
The PID of the most recent background job
The PID of the current shell
en.explain: $? is the last command's exit code: 0 for success, anything else for some failure. $$ is the shell's PID, $! the latest background job's PID, and $# the argument count.
whys: Right: the exit code, 0 for success.
The argument count is $#.
The latest background PID is $!.
The shell's PID is $$.

zh.q: 在 bash 里执行 false | true; echo $?（没有 set -o pipefail），输出什么？
zh.explain: 默认情况下，管道的退出状态是最后一个命令的退出状态，true 返回 0，前面 false 的失败被吞掉了。脚本里常加 set -o pipefail，让任一环节失败时整个管道失败（这时会是 1）。
whys: $? 只是一个数；每段的状态在 PIPESTATUS 数组里。
正确：默认取最后一个命令的状态。
127 表示命令找不到。
只有开了 pipefail 才会是 1。

en.q: In bash, without set -o pipefail, what does false | true; echo $? print?
en.explain: By default a pipeline's exit status is that of its last command; true returns 0, so the failing false is swallowed. Scripts often add set -o pipefail so any failing stage fails the pipeline (then it would be 1).
whys: $? is a single number; per-stage statuses live in PIPESTATUS.
Right: by default the last command's status.
127 means command not found.
Only with pipefail would it be 1.

zh.q: 执行 ln a.txt b 和 ln -s a.txt c 之后删除 a.txt，b 和 c 还能读出原来的内容吗？
choices: b 和 c 都不行
b 和 c 都可以
zh.explain: 硬链接 b 和 a.txt 指向同一个 inode，删除 a.txt 只是删掉一个名字，数据在最后一个链接消失前都还在。软链接 c 只记录路径 "a.txt"，目标没了就成了悬空链接。
whys: 硬链接还指向同一个 inode，数据没被删。
软链接指向的路径已不存在，读取会报 No such file。
说反了：存路径的是软链接。
正确：硬链接共享 inode，软链接只存路径。

en.q: After ln a.txt b and ln -s a.txt c, a.txt is deleted. Can b and c still be read?
en.explain: The hard link b and a.txt name the same inode; deleting a.txt removes one name, and the data stays until the last link goes. The symlink c only stores the path "a.txt", so it dangles once the target is gone.
whys: The hard link still names the inode, so the data remains.
The symlink's target path is gone, so reading it fails with No such file.
Reversed: the symlink is the one that stores a path.
Right: a hard link shares the inode; a symlink stores a path.

zh.q: script.sh 没有执行权限（也不在 PATH 里），下面哪种方式仍然能运行它？
zh.explain: bash script.sh 是运行 bash 这个程序，把文件当参数读进去，只要求文件可读。./script.sh 和 exec 要求文件本身可执行，会报 Permission denied；不带路径的 script.sh 还要在 PATH 里能找到。
whys: exec 同样要执行这个文件，需要 x 权限。
不带路径时 shell 只在 PATH 里找，找不到。
正确：解释器读取文件，只要求可读。
直接执行要求文件有 x 权限。

en.q: script.sh has no execute permission and is not on PATH. Which way still runs it?
en.explain: bash script.sh runs bash and hands it the file to read, which needs only read permission. ./script.sh and exec need the file itself to be executable and fail with Permission denied; a bare script.sh must also be found on PATH.
whys: exec also executes the file and needs the x bit.
Without a path the shell only searches PATH, and it is not there.
Right: the interpreter reads the file, which needs only read access.
Running it directly needs the x bit.

zh.q: 想在关掉 SSH 终端之后让一个长任务继续跑，下面哪种做法可行？
choices: 按 Ctrl+Z 挂起，再关掉终端
zh.explain: 终端断开时，shell 收到 SIGHUP 并转发给它的作业，默认处理是结束进程。nohup 让程序忽略 SIGHUP，& 让它在后台运行；也可以用 setsid、disown，或者在 tmux、screen 里运行。
whys: 挂起的进程是停止状态，关掉终端后也会收到 SIGHUP。
正确：忽略 SIGHUP 并放到后台。
前台运行时 exit 要等任务结束才执行。
只加 & 的后台作业仍会在终端关闭时收到 SIGHUP。

en.q: You want a long job to keep running after you close the SSH session. Which works?
choices: Press Ctrl+Z to suspend it, then close the terminal
en.explain: When the terminal goes away, the shell gets SIGHUP and passes it to its jobs, whose default reaction is to exit. nohup makes the program ignore SIGHUP and & puts it in the background; setsid, disown, tmux or screen also work.
whys: A suspended job is stopped and still gets SIGHUP when the terminal closes.
Right: ignore SIGHUP and run in the background.
Run in the foreground, exit waits until the job finishes.
A job started with & alone still gets SIGHUP when the terminal closes.

zh.q: find /var/log -name "*.log" -mtime +7 找的是什么文件？
choices: /var/log 下（含子目录）修改时间超过 7 天的 .log 文件
大于 7 MB 的 .log 文件
最近 7 天内修改过的 .log 文件
/var/log 这一层（不含子目录）的 .log 文件
zh.explain: find 默认递归搜索子目录。-mtime +7 表示修改时间早于 7 天前（严格说是超过 7 个完整的 24 小时），-mtime -7 才是最近 7 天内。按大小筛选用 -size。
whys: 正确：递归查找，修改时间超过 7 天。
-mtime 看的是修改时间，大小要用 -size。
最近 7 天是 -mtime -7。
find 默认递归；只看一层要加 -maxdepth 1。

en.q: What does find /var/log -name "*.log" -mtime +7 find?
choices: .log files under /var/log, subdirectories included, last modified more than 7 days ago
.log files modified in the last 7 days
.log files directly in /var/log, not in subdirectories
en.explain: find searches subdirectories by default. -mtime +7 means modified more than 7 days ago (strictly, more than 7 full 24-hour periods); -mtime -7 would be within the last 7 days. Size is -size.
whys: Right: recursive, modified over 7 days ago.
-mtime is about modification time; size is -size.
The last 7 days would be -mtime -7.
find recurses by default; one level needs -maxdepth 1.

zh.q: /tmp 的权限是 drwxrwxrwt，最后的 t（粘滞位）起什么作用？
choices: 新建的文件自动继承目录的属组
人人可以在里面建文件，但只能删除或改名自己的文件
目录里的文件不能被任何人删除
目录里的文件会一直保存在内存里
zh.explain: 目录有写权限时，本来任何人都能删掉其中任何文件。粘滞位加上一条限制：只有文件所有者、目录所有者或 root 才能删除或改名这个文件，所以共享的 /tmp 不会被别人清掉自己的文件。
whys: 继承属组的是目录上的 setgid 位。
正确：防止删除别人的文件。
所有者自己仍然可以删除自己的文件。
粘滞位和是否放在内存里无关（/tmp 是否是 tmpfs 是另一回事）。

en.q: /tmp shows drwxrwxrwt. What does the trailing t (the sticky bit) do?
choices: New files inherit the directory's group
Anyone can create files there, but only delete or rename their own
Nobody can delete files in it
Files in it are kept in memory
