en.explain: Write permission on a directory normally lets anyone delete any file in it. The sticky bit adds a rule: only the file's owner, the directory's owner or root may delete or rename it, so on a shared /tmp nobody can remove your files.
whys: Inheriting the group is the setgid bit on a directory.
Right: it stops people deleting each other's files.
Owners can still delete their own files.
It has nothing to do with memory (whether /tmp is tmpfs is separate).

zh.q: grep -c error app.log 输出的数字表示什么？
choices: 不包含 error 的行数
第一处 error 所在的行号
zh.explain: -c 统计匹配的行数，一行里出现几次都只算一行。-v 是反向匹配（不含该词的行），-n 显示行号，数出现次数要用 grep -o error | wc -l。
whys: 一行多次匹配只算一行；数次数要 -o。
正确：-c 数的是行。
那是 grep -vc 的结果。
显示行号用 -n，而且会列出每一行。

en.q: What number does grep -c error app.log print?
choices: How many lines do not contain error
The line number of the first error
en.explain: -c counts matching lines; a line counts once however many matches it has. -v inverts the match, -n shows line numbers, and counting occurrences needs grep -o error | wc -l.
whys: Several matches on a line count once; occurrences need -o.
Right: -c counts lines.
That would be grep -vc.
Line numbers come from -n, which lists every match.

zh.q: 在 bash 里先执行 X=1，再执行 bash -c 'echo $X'，输出什么？
zh.explain: X=1 只设置了当前 shell 的变量，没有 export，不会放进传给子进程的环境变量里。子 bash 里 $X 为空，echo 输出空行。export X=1 之后才会打印 1。
whys: 单引号阻止的是外层 shell 展开，子 bash 仍会展开 $X。
默认没有开 set -u，未设置的变量展开为空，不报错。
要先 export X 才会传给子进程。
正确：没有 export，子进程看不到。

en.q: In bash, you run X=1 and then bash -c 'echo $X'. What is printed?
en.explain: X=1 sets a shell variable without exporting it, so it is not in the environment passed to child processes. In the child bash $X is empty and echo prints a blank line. After export X=1 it would print 1.
whys: Single quotes stop the outer shell from expanding it; the child bash still expands $X.
Without set -u an unset variable expands to nothing, with no error.
Only after export X does the child get it.
Right: not exported, so the child cannot see it.

zh.q: 一个类把构造函数设为私有，提供静态方法 getInstance()，每次都返回同一个对象。这是哪种模式？
zh.explain: 单例保证一个类只有一个实例，并提供全局访问点。私有构造函数阻止外部 new，静态方法负责创建并缓存唯一的实例。
whys: 正确：唯一实例加全局访问点。
享元按内部状态共享大量细粒度对象，不是限制成一个实例。
工厂方法把「创建哪种对象」交给子类，每次可以返回新对象。
原型模式通过克隆现有对象来创建新对象。

en.q: A class makes its constructor private and offers a static getInstance() that always returns the same object. Which pattern is this?
en.explain: Singleton guarantees one instance of a class and a global way to reach it. The private constructor stops outside code from calling new, and the static method creates and caches the one instance.
whys: Right: one instance and a global access point.
Flyweight shares many fine-grained objects by intrinsic state, not one instance.
Factory Method lets subclasses decide what to create, and may return new objects each time.
Prototype creates objects by cloning an existing one.

zh.q: 关于单例模式，下面哪项是常被批评的缺点？
choices: 它要求每个类都继承同一个基类
它不能用于多线程程序
它本质上是全局状态，隐藏了依赖，测试时难以替换和隔离
每次调用都会创建新对象，浪费内存
zh.explain: 代码里到处调用 X.getInstance()，依赖关系就看不出来，测试时也很难换成假的实现，状态还会在测试之间残留。常见的改进是依赖注入：由外部创建一个实例并传进来。
whys: 单例不要求继承任何基类。
多线程下需要注意初始化的线程安全，但完全可以使用。
正确：隐式的全局状态，不利于测试。
单例正好相反，只有一个对象。

en.q: Which is a common criticism of the Singleton pattern?
choices: It forces every class to inherit from one base class
It cannot be used in multithreaded programs
It is global state in disguise: it hides dependencies and is hard to swap out or isolate in tests
It creates a new object on every call, wasting memory
en.explain: With X.getInstance() called all over, the dependency is invisible, tests struggle to substitute a fake, and state leaks between tests. The usual fix is dependency injection: create one instance outside and pass it in.
whys: Singleton needs no common base class.
Initialization needs care under threads, but it works fine.
Right: hidden global state that hurts testing.
Singleton is the opposite: there is only one object.

zh.q: 要构造的 HttpRequest 有十几个可选参数，于是写成 HttpRequest.newBuilder().uri(u).header(k, v).timeout(t).build()。这是哪种模式？
zh.explain: 建造者把复杂对象的构造拆成一步步设置，最后 build() 一次性生成（通常是不可变的）对象，避免了参数很多的构造函数和一堆重载。
whys: 抽象工厂创建的是一组相关的对象，不是分步配置一个对象。
正确：分步设置再一次性构建。
装饰器在运行时给已有对象叠加功能。
外观给复杂子系统提供一个简化的入口。

en.q: An HttpRequest has a dozen optional parameters, so it is built as HttpRequest.newBuilder().uri(u).header(k, v).timeout(t).build(). Which pattern is this?
en.explain: Builder splits building a complex object into step-by-step setters and a final build() that produces it, often immutable, instead of a constructor with many parameters and overloads.
whys: Abstract Factory creates families of related objects, not one configured step by step.
Right: set things step by step, then build once.
Decorator adds behaviour to an existing object at run time.
Facade gives a complex subsystem one simple entry point.

zh.q: 系统里的支付代码都依赖自定义接口 PaymentGateway。要接入一个方法名、参数都不同的第三方 SDK，于是写一个实现 PaymentGateway、内部调用 SDK 的类。这是哪种模式？
zh.explain: 适配器把一个类的接口转换成调用方期望的接口，让本来不兼容的类能一起工作。它的重点是「接口不一样，要转换」。
whys: 代理和被代理对象的接口相同，用来控制访问。
策略是在多种可互换的算法之间选一个。
正确：转换接口以兼容。
桥接在设计之初就把抽象和实现分开，让两边独立变化。

en.q: The payment code depends on your own PaymentGateway interface. A third-party SDK has different method names and parameters, so you write a class that implements PaymentGateway and calls the SDK inside. Which pattern is this?
en.explain: Adapter converts one class's interface into the one callers expect, so classes that do not fit can work together. Its point is translating between different interfaces.
whys: A proxy has the same interface as its subject and controls access to it.
Strategy picks one of several interchangeable algorithms.
Right: it converts one interface into another.
Bridge separates abstraction from implementation up front so both can vary.

zh.q: Java 里写 new BufferedInputStream(new GZIPInputStream(new FileInputStream(f)))，每层都是 InputStream，并各自加了一点功能。这是哪种模式？
zh.explain: 装饰器和被包装的对象实现同一个接口，在转发调用的前后加上自己的行为，可以任意组合、层层叠加，而不用为每种组合写一个子类。
whys: 正确：同接口包装，叠加功能。
责任链是请求依次传递，直到某个处理者处理它。
组合模式处理树形的整体与部分关系。
适配器是转换成另一个接口，这里每层接口都相同。

en.q: In Java, new BufferedInputStream(new GZIPInputStream(new FileInputStream(f))) stacks InputStreams, each adding a little behaviour. Which pattern is this?
en.explain: A decorator implements the same interface as the object it wraps and adds its own behaviour around the forwarded calls, so wrappers can be stacked in any combination without a subclass for each.
whys: Right: same-interface wrappers that add behaviour.
Chain of Responsibility passes a request along until one handler takes it.
Composite handles part-whole trees.
Adapter converts to a different interface; here every layer has the same one.

zh.q: 一个 ImageProxy 和真实的 Image 实现同一个接口，只有第一次调用 display() 时才从磁盘加载图片。这是哪种模式？
zh.explain: 代理控制对另一个对象的访问：延迟创建（虚拟代理）、权限检查（保护代理）、远程调用（远程代理）、缓存等。和装饰器结构相似，但目的是控制访问，而不是增加功能。
whys: 外观是简化一组复杂接口。
结构相似，但装饰器的目的是增加功能，这里是控制何时创建真实对象。
正确：控制访问，这里是延迟加载。
备忘录保存对象状态以便恢复。

en.q: An ImageProxy implements the same interface as the real Image and loads the image from disk only on the first display(). Which pattern is this?
en.explain: A proxy controls access to another object: lazy creation (virtual proxy), permission checks (protection proxy), remote calls (remote proxy), caching. It looks like a decorator but exists to control access rather than to add features.
whys: Facade simplifies a set of complex interfaces.
Same shape, but a decorator adds features; this controls when the real object exists.
Right: access control, here lazy loading.
Memento saves an object's state so it can be restored.

zh.q: 下单要依次调用库存、支付、物流、通知四个子系统，于是写一个 OrderService.placeOrder() 把这些调用都包起来，调用方只需要调用它。这是哪种模式？
zh.explain: 外观给一组复杂的子系统提供一个简单的统一入口，调用方不需要了解内部细节；子系统本身仍然可以被直接使用。
whys: 正确：简化的统一入口。
中介者协调多个对象之间的相互通信，让它们不直接引用彼此。
模板方法在基类里定义算法骨架，由子类实现步骤。
代理和被代理对象接口相同，这里是把多个接口合成一个。

en.q: Placing an order needs calls to inventory, payment, shipping and notification subsystems, so OrderService.placeOrder() wraps them all and callers use only that. Which pattern is this?
en.explain: A facade gives a set of complex subsystems one simple entry point, so callers need not know the details; the subsystems themselves stay usable directly.
whys: Right: one simplified entry point.
Mediator coordinates objects that talk to each other so they need no direct references.
Template Method fixes an algorithm's skeleton in a base class and lets subclasses fill in steps.
A proxy shares its subject's interface; this merges several interfaces into one.

zh.q: 按钮的 addEventListener("click", handler)、消息系统的订阅与发布，体现的是哪种模式？
zh.explain: 观察者模式里，主题维护一组订阅者，状态变化时逐个通知它们。主题不需要知道订阅者具体是谁，订阅者可以随时加入或退出。
whys: 迭代器用于逐个访问集合元素。
正确：订阅并在事件发生时被通知。
状态模式让对象的行为随内部状态改变。
命令把一个请求封装成对象，用来排队、撤销。

en.q: A button's addEventListener("click", handler) and a publish/subscribe message system are examples of which pattern?
en.explain: In Observer, a subject keeps a list of subscribers and notifies each when something changes. It does not need to know who they are, and they can join or leave at any time.
whys: Iterator walks through a collection's elements.
Right: subscribe and get notified when something happens.
State changes an object's behaviour with its internal state.
Command wraps a request in an object, for queues and undo.

zh.q: 电商的运费计算有「按重量」「按件数」「包邮」三种算法，运行时根据活动配置切换，每种算法实现同一个 ShippingCost 接口。这是哪种模式？
zh.explain: 策略模式把一族可互换的算法各自封装起来，由调用方选择使用哪一个，取代一长串 if-else。Java 的 Comparator 也是典型例子。
whys: 工厂方法关心的是创建哪种对象，不是用哪种算法。
正确：可互换的算法，由外部选择。
状态模式里对象自己根据状态切换行为，而不是由外部挑选算法。
模板方法是继承：固定流程，子类重写其中几步。

en.q: Shipping cost can be computed by weight, by item count or as free shipping, switched at run time by campaign settings, each implementing one ShippingCost interface. Which pattern is this?
en.explain: Strategy wraps each of a family of interchangeable algorithms on its own and lets the caller pick one, replacing a long if-else chain. Java's Comparator is a classic example.
whys: Factory Method is about which object to create, not which algorithm to run.
Right: interchangeable algorithms chosen from outside.
In State the object switches behaviour itself as its state changes; nobody picks from outside.
Template Method uses inheritance: a fixed flow with a few steps overridden.

zh.q: 文本编辑器把每次操作封装成带 execute() 和 undo() 的对象，放进历史栈里以支持撤销和重做。这是哪种模式？
zh.explain: 命令模式把「一个请求」变成对象，这样就能保存、排队、记录、撤销它。备忘录也能支持撤销，但它保存的是对象状态的快照，而不是操作本身。
whys: 观察者是事件通知。
责任链是把请求沿一串处理者传递。
正确：把操作封装成对象。
备忘录保存的是状态快照，这里保存的是可执行、可撤销的操作。

en.q: A text editor wraps each edit in an object with execute() and undo() and keeps them on a history stack for undo and redo. Which pattern is this?
en.explain: Command turns a request into an object so it can be stored, queued, logged and undone. Memento can also support undo, but it saves snapshots of state rather than the operations.
whys: Observer is about event notification.
Chain of Responsibility passes a request along a line of handlers.
Right: operations wrapped as objects.
Memento stores state snapshots; here the stored things are executable, undoable operations.

zh.q: 抽象类 DataExporter 的 export() 依次调用 open()、writeHeader()、writeRows()、close()；CsvExporter 和 JsonExporter 只重写其中几个步骤。这是哪种模式？
zh.explain: 模板方法在基类里固定算法的骨架和顺序，把可变的步骤留给子类实现。它靠继承复用流程；策略模式则靠组合，整个替换算法。
whys: 桥接把抽象和实现分成两个可以独立变化的层次。
正确：父类定流程，子类填步骤。
建造者是分步构造对象，最后 build()。
策略是把整个算法作为对象替换，不是在固定流程里重写步骤。

en.q: The abstract DataExporter.export() calls open(), writeHeader(), writeRows() and close() in order; CsvExporter and JsonExporter override only some of these steps. Which pattern is this?
en.explain: Template Method fixes an algorithm's skeleton and order in a base class and leaves the varying steps to subclasses. It reuses the flow through inheritance, whereas Strategy swaps a whole algorithm through composition.
whys: Bridge splits abstraction and implementation into two layers that vary independently.
Right: the parent fixes the flow, subclasses fill in steps.
Builder constructs an object step by step and ends with build().
Strategy swaps a whole algorithm object rather than overriding steps of a fixed flow.

zh.q: 自动售货机有「待投币」「已投币」「出货中」「售罄」几种状态，同样按下按钮在不同状态下行为不同。把每种状态写成一个类，由它决定下一步，这是哪种模式？
zh.explain: 状态模式把和状态相关的行为放进各个状态类里，对象把请求委托给当前状态对象，状态之间自己切换，消除了到处都是的 switch(state)。结构和策略相似，区别在于状态会自己转换。
whys: 观察者用于通知订阅者。
策略通常由外部选定，不会在内部互相切换。
命令把请求封装成对象，与状态切换无关。
正确：行为随状态变化，状态自己转换。

en.q: A vending machine can be waiting for coins, paid, dispensing or sold out, and the same button does different things in each. Each state is written as a class that decides what comes next. Which pattern is this?
en.explain: State moves state-specific behaviour into one class per state; the object delegates to its current state, and the states switch among themselves, which removes switch(state) blocks everywhere. It looks like Strategy, except the states change on their own.
whys: Observer is for notifying subscribers.
A strategy is usually chosen from outside and does not switch itself.
Command wraps requests in objects and has nothing to do with state changes.
Right: behaviour follows the state, and the states switch themselves.

zh.q: 文件系统里，文件和文件夹都实现 getSize()，文件夹的 getSize() 把子项的大小加起来，调用方不用区分是文件还是文件夹。这是哪种模式？
zh.explain: 组合模式把对象组织成树形的「整体—部分」结构，叶子和容器实现同一接口，调用方可以一致地对待单个对象和对象组合。
whys: 装饰器只包一个对象来添加功能，不管理一组子节点。
享元是共享对象以节省内存。
正确：树形结构，叶子和容器一致对待。
迭代器只负责遍历，不定义树结构。

en.q: In a file system, files and folders both implement getSize(); a folder sums its children's sizes, and callers need not tell files from folders. Which pattern is this?
en.explain: Composite arranges objects in a part-whole tree where leaves and containers share an interface, so callers treat single objects and groups the same way.
whys: A decorator wraps one object to add behaviour; it does not manage children.
Flyweight shares objects to save memory.
Right: a tree where leaves and containers look alike.
Iterator only traverses; it does not define the tree.

zh.q: Python 里 for x in obj 能用于列表、字典、文件和自定义的类，只要它们提供 __iter__ 返回一个有 __next__ 的对象。这体现的是哪种模式？
zh.explain: 迭代器提供一种统一的方式顺序访问集合中的元素，而不暴露集合的内部结构（数组、哈希表还是链表）。
whys: 访问者是在不改类的前提下给一组类增加新操作。
组合描述的是树形结构，不是遍历协议。
这里不涉及转换接口。
正确：统一的遍历方式，隐藏内部结构。

en.q: Python's for x in obj works on lists, dicts, files and your own classes, as long as __iter__ returns an object with __next__. Which pattern is this?
en.explain: Iterator gives one uniform way to step through a collection's elements without exposing how it is stored (array, hash table or linked list).
whys: Visitor adds new operations to a set of classes without changing them.
Composite describes a tree, not a traversal protocol.
No interface is being converted here.
Right: one way to traverse that hides the internals.

zh.q: 根据配置里的字符串 "csv"、"json"、"xml"，由 ParserFactory.create(type) 返回对应的 Parser 实现，调用方只依赖 Parser 接口。这体现的是什么？
choices: 工厂（简单工厂）：把创建哪个具体类的决定集中到一处
单例模式：保证每种 Parser 只有一个实例
装饰器模式：给 Parser 增加功能
原型模式：复制一个已有的 Parser
zh.explain: 工厂把 new 具体类的代码集中起来，调用方只拿到接口，不需要知道具体类。新增一种格式时只改工厂，不用改所有调用方。工厂方法模式更进一步，把这个决定交给子类重写。
whys: 正确：集中决定创建哪个具体类。
题目没有要求实例唯一，每次可以创建新的。
这里是选择并创建对象，没有包装已有对象。
对象是新创建的，不是克隆来的。

en.q: ParserFactory.create(type) returns the right Parser for the config string "csv", "json" or "xml", and callers depend only on the Parser interface. What does this show?
choices: A factory (simple factory): one place decides which concrete class to create
Singleton: one instance of each Parser
Decorator: adding features to a Parser
en.explain: A factory gathers the new-ing of concrete classes in one place, and callers get only the interface. Adding a format changes the factory, not every caller. Factory Method goes further and lets subclasses override the decision.
whys: Right: one place picks the concrete class.
Nothing says instances must be unique; each call can create a new one.
This chooses and creates objects; nothing is wrapped.
The objects are created fresh, not cloned.

zh.q: 攻击者在论坛评论里写入一段 <script>，之后每个打开该帖子的用户浏览器都会执行它。这属于哪种攻击？
zh.explain: 恶意脚本被保存在服务器（数据库）里，再原样输出给其他用户，是存储型 XSS，影响面最大。反射型 XSS 的脚本来自当次请求（比如 URL 参数），需要诱导受害者点特定链接。
whys: SQL 注入攻击的是数据库查询。
CSRF 是借用户的登录态发请求，不是在页面里执行脚本。
正确：脚本被持久保存并发给其他用户。
反射型的脚本来自当次请求，不会被保存。

en.q: An attacker posts a forum comment containing a <script>, and it runs in the browser of everyone who opens the thread. What kind of attack is this?
en.explain: The script is saved on the server (in the database) and served back to other users unchanged: stored XSS, the widest-reaching kind. In reflected XSS the script comes from the request itself, such as a URL parameter, and the victim has to be lured to a crafted link.
whys: SQL injection targets database queries.
CSRF sends requests with the user's session; it does not run script in the page.
Right: the script is stored and served to others.
Reflected XSS comes from the current request and is not stored.

zh.q: 防御 XSS 最根本的做法是？
choices: 把不可信数据输出到页面时，按所处上下文（HTML、属性、JS、URL）做编码或转义
zh.explain: XSS 的本质是数据被浏览器当成了代码。输出时按上下文编码（如把 < 变成 <）能让数据始终是数据；现代框架默认会做 HTML 转义。CSP、HttpOnly Cookie 是重要的补充防线，但不能替代输出编码。
whys: CSRF token 防的是跨站请求伪造。
密码哈希保护的是数据库泄露，和 XSS 无关。
正确：按上下文编码输出。
HTTPS 保护传输过程，挡不住页面里注入的脚本。

en.q: What is the most fundamental defence against XSS?
choices: Encode or escape untrusted data for the context it lands in (HTML, attribute, JS, URL) when you output it
Serve the whole site over HTTPS
en.explain: XSS happens when data is treated as code by the browser. Encoding for the output context (turning < into <, for example) keeps data as data, and modern frameworks escape HTML by default. CSP and HttpOnly cookies are valuable extra layers but no substitute for output encoding.
whys: CSRF tokens defend against cross-site request forgery.
Password hashing protects against a leaked database, not XSS.
Right: context-aware output encoding.
HTTPS protects data in transit; it does not stop injected script.

zh.q: 给会话 Cookie 加上 HttpOnly 属性，能起到什么作用？
choices: 页面里的 JavaScript 无法通过 document.cookie 读到它，即使有 XSS 也偷不走
阻止所有 XSS 攻击
这个 Cookie 只会通过 HTTPS 发送
其他网站发起的请求不会带上它
zh.explain: HttpOnly 让 Cookie 只在 HTTP 请求里自动携带，脚本读不到，降低 XSS 偷会话的危害。但注入的脚本仍然能以用户身份在当前页面发请求，所以它是减轻，不是根治。只走 HTTPS 是 Secure 属性，限制跨站携带是 SameSite。
whys: 正确：脚本读不到 Cookie。
它只防住偷 Cookie，注入的脚本仍能执行。
只走 HTTPS 是 Secure 属性。
限制跨站请求携带 Cookie 的是 SameSite。

en.q: What does adding HttpOnly to a session cookie do?
choices: Page JavaScript cannot read it through document.cookie, so XSS cannot steal it
It is only ever sent over HTTPS
Requests started by other sites do not carry it
en.explain: HttpOnly keeps the cookie in HTTP requests only, out of reach of scripts, which limits what XSS can steal. Injected script can still send requests as the user from that page, so it reduces harm rather than curing XSS. HTTPS-only is the Secure attribute; cross-site limits are SameSite.
whys: Right: scripts cannot read the cookie.
It stops cookie theft only; injected script still runs.
HTTPS-only is the Secure attribute.
Keeping it off cross-site requests is SameSite.

zh.q: 响应头里设置了 Content-Security-Policy: script-src 'self'，下面哪种脚本会被浏览器拦下？
choices: 同源的 Web Worker 脚本 /worker.js
同源路径下动态插入的 <script src="/js/chart.js">
zh.explain: script-src 'self' 只允许从本站加载的脚本文件。内联脚本和内联事件处理器（onclick="…"）默认都会被拦下，除非额外允许 'unsafe-inline'、nonce 或 hash。这正是 CSP 能缓解 XSS 的原因：注入的内联脚本跑不起来。
whys: worker 脚本没有单独设置 worker-src 时回退到 script-src，同源允许。
正确：内联脚本不在允许范围内。
同源脚本文件符合 'self'。
只要来源是同源 URL，动态插入也允许。

en.q: The response has Content-Security-Policy: script-src 'self'. Which script will the browser block?
choices: A dynamically added <script src="/js/chart.js"> from the same origin
en.explain: script-src 'self' allows only script files loaded from your own origin. Inline scripts and inline handlers (onclick="…") are blocked unless 'unsafe-inline', a nonce or a hash allows them. That is why CSP blunts XSS: injected inline script cannot run.
whys: Without worker-src, workers fall back to script-src, which allows same-origin.
Right: inline script is not allowed.
A same-origin script file matches 'self'.
A same-origin URL is allowed even when inserted dynamically.

zh.q: 关于 CSRF（跨站请求伪造），下面哪项描述正确？
choices: 攻击者窃取了用户的密码
恶意网站让受害者的浏览器向目标站点发请求，浏览器自动带上受害者的 Cookie
攻击者截获并修改了网络传输的数据
攻击者在目标页面注入脚本并执行
zh.explain: CSRF 利用的是「浏览器会自动带上目标站的 Cookie」：用户登录了银行网站，又打开了恶意页面，恶意页面里一个自动提交的表单就能以用户身份转账。攻击者看不到响应，但请求本身已经生效。
whys: CSRF 不需要知道密码。
正确：借用户的登录态伪造请求。
那是中间人攻击。
那是 XSS。

en.q: Which describes CSRF (cross-site request forgery)?
choices: The attacker steals the user's password
A malicious site makes the victim's browser send a request to the target site, with the victim's cookies attached automatically
The attacker intercepts and alters traffic on the network
The attacker injects and runs script in the target page
en.explain: CSRF abuses the fact that browsers attach the target site's cookies automatically: you are logged in to your bank, open a malicious page, and an auto-submitting form there makes a transfer as you. The attacker never sees the response, but the request has done its work.
whys: CSRF never needs the password.
Right: a forged request riding on the user's session.
That is a man-in-the-middle attack.
That is XSS.

zh.q: 下面哪项不能有效防御 CSRF？
choices: 把修改数据的接口从 GET 改成 POST，别的不做
在表单和请求里校验不可预测的 CSRF token
校验请求的 Origin 头是否是本站
给会话 Cookie 设置 SameSite=Lax 或 Strict
zh.explain: 改用 POST 只能挡住图片、链接这种 GET 请求，恶意页面照样可以用自动提交的表单发 POST。SameSite、CSRF token、校验 Origin 都能让服务器分辨请求是否真的来自本站。
whys: 正确：跨站表单也能发 POST。
攻击者拿不到 token，伪造的请求会被拒绝。
跨站请求的 Origin 是攻击者的站点，可以拒绝。
SameSite 让跨站请求不带 Cookie，是有效防御。

en.q: Which of these does not defend against CSRF?
choices: Switching state-changing endpoints from GET to POST and nothing else
Checking an unguessable CSRF token on forms and requests
Checking that the Origin header is your own site
Setting SameSite=Lax or Strict on the session cookie
en.explain: POST only stops GET-based tricks such as image tags and links; a malicious page can still send a POST with an auto-submitting form. SameSite, CSRF tokens and Origin checks all let the server tell whether a request really came from its own pages.
whys: Right: cross-site forms can POST too.
The attacker cannot get the token, so forged requests fail.
A cross-site request carries the attacker's Origin and can be refused.
SameSite keeps cookies off cross-site requests, which works.

zh.q: 会话 Cookie 设置了 SameSite=Lax。用户在其他网站上，下面哪种请求会带上这个 Cookie？
choices: 其他网站用 fetch 发起的跨站请求
其他网站上自动提交的 POST 表单
其他网站页面里的
点击链接，以 GET 方式顶层跳转到本站
zh.explain: Lax 只在「顶层导航 + 安全方法（如 GET）」时跨站携带 Cookie，所以从别处点链接进来仍保持登录。跨站的 POST、图片等子资源请求、fetch 都不带。Strict 连顶层导航也不带。主流浏览器对没写 SameSite 的 Cookie 默认按 Lax 处理。
whys: 跨站 fetch 不带 Lax Cookie。
跨站 POST 不带 Lax Cookie，这正是它防 CSRF 的地方。
图片属于子资源请求，不带。
正确：顶层 GET 导航会带上 Cookie。

en.q: The session cookie has SameSite=Lax. From another website, which request carries it?
choices: A cross-site fetch from the other site
An auto-submitting POST form on the other site
An on the other site
Clicking a link that navigates the top-level page to your site with GET
en.explain: Lax sends the cookie cross-site only on top-level navigations with safe methods such as GET, so following a link in keeps you logged in. Cross-site POSTs, subresources like images, and fetch calls go without it. Strict withholds it even on top-level navigation. Major browsers treat cookies without SameSite as Lax.
whys: A cross-site fetch does not carry a Lax cookie.
Cross-site POSTs do not carry Lax cookies, which is how it stops CSRF.
Images are subresource requests and go without it.
Right: a top-level GET navigation carries it.

zh.q: 后端代码是 "SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = '" + name + "'"，用户输入的 name 是 ' OR '1'='1，会发生什么？
choices: 条件变成永远为真，查询返回所有用户
查询找不到名字叫这个的用户，返回空
数据库报语法错误，什么也不返回
数据库自动把输入当成普通字符串处理
zh.explain: 拼接后的 SQL 是 WHERE name = '' OR '1'='1'，输入里的引号闭合了原来的字符串，后面的 OR 变成了 SQL 的一部分。这就是 SQL 注入：数据被当成了代码执行。
whys: 正确：注入的 OR 让条件恒真。
输入里的引号改变了 SQL 结构，不再是按名字查找。
拼接出的语句引号是配平的，语法合法。
拼接字符串时数据库无法区分哪部分是用户输入。

en.q: The backend builds "SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = '" + name + "'" and the user enters ' OR '1'='1 as name. What happens?
choices: The condition becomes always true and every user comes back
No user has that name, so nothing comes back
The database raises a syntax error and returns nothing
The database treats the input as a plain string on its own
en.explain: The query becomes WHERE name = '' OR '1'='1': the quote in the input closes the string, and the OR becomes part of the SQL. That is SQL injection: data executed as code.
whys: Right: the injected OR makes the condition always true.
The quote changes the SQL's structure; it no longer searches by name.
The resulting quotes balance, so the syntax is valid.
Once strings are concatenated the database cannot tell which part was input.

zh.q: 防止 SQL 注入最可靠的做法是？
choices: 使用参数化查询（预编译语句），让输入只作为值传给数据库
出错时不把数据库报错信息显示给用户
在前端用 JavaScript 检查输入
手动把输入里的单引号替换成两个单引号
zh.explain: 参数化查询把 SQL 结构和数据分开传给数据库，输入无论包含什么都只会被当成值。前端校验能被绕过（直接发请求即可）；手动转义容易漏掉编码、数字字段等情况；隐藏报错只是让攻击者更难调试，漏洞还在。
whys: 正确：结构和数据分离。
隐藏报错不能修复漏洞，盲注照样可行。
攻击者可以绕过前端直接请求接口。
手工转义容易遗漏，比如数字类型的字段不需要引号就能注入。

en.q: What is the most reliable way to prevent SQL injection?
choices: Use parameterized queries (prepared statements) so input is only ever passed as a value
Hide database error messages from users
Check the input with JavaScript in the browser
Replace each single quote in the input with two by hand
en.explain: A parameterized query sends the SQL structure and the data separately, so whatever the input contains it is only ever a value. Browser checks are bypassed by sending the request directly; hand escaping misses encodings, numeric fields and more; hiding errors only slows an attacker down while the hole stays open.
whys: Right: structure and data travel separately.
Hiding errors does not fix anything; blind injection still works.
Attackers can skip the browser and call the endpoint directly.
Hand escaping misses cases, such as numeric fields injected without quotes.

zh.q: 关于 CORS（跨域资源共享），哪项说法正确？
choices: 开启 CORS 后，所有请求都会自动带上用户的 Cookie
它是服务器端的防火墙，会拦截跨域请求
它能阻止任何人从其他网站调用你的 API
它是浏览器执行的规则，决定跨域页面能否读取响应；curl 等非浏览器客户端不受约束
zh.explain: CORS 放宽的是浏览器的同源策略：服务器通过响应头告诉浏览器「允许某个来源读取这个响应」。简单请求照样会到达服务器，只是页面读不到结果；curl 和脚本完全不看这些头。所以接口的权限必须靠认证和授权来保证。
whys: 携带 Cookie 需要 credentials: include，并且服务器明确允许。
服务器只是返回响应头，拦截是浏览器做的。
CORS 不能阻止非浏览器客户端，也挡不住简单请求到达服务器。
正确：CORS 是浏览器的读取限制。

en.q: Which statement about CORS (cross-origin resource sharing) is true?
choices: With CORS enabled every request carries the user's cookies automatically
It is a server-side firewall that blocks cross-origin requests
It stops anyone from calling your API from another site
Browsers enforce it to decide whether a cross-origin page may read a response; non-browser clients such as curl ignore it
en.explain: CORS relaxes the browser's same-origin policy: the server's response headers tell the browser which origins may read the response. Simple requests still reach the server even when the page cannot read the result, and curl or scripts ignore the headers entirely. API access must still be secured by authentication and authorization.
whys: Cookies need credentials: include and explicit permission from the server.
The server only sends headers; the browser does the blocking.
It cannot stop non-browser clients, and simple requests still reach the server.
Right: CORS is a browser-side read rule.

zh.q: 前端用 fetch 向另一个域名的 API 发送 POST，请求头 Content-Type: application/json。浏览器会先做什么？
choices: 直接发送 POST，再检查响应头
拒绝发送，跨域不能用 POST
先发一个 OPTIONS 预检请求，确认服务器允许这个方法和请求头
zh.explain: 只有方法是 GET、HEAD、POST，且 Content-Type 是 application/x-www-form-urlencoded、multipart/form-data 或 text/plain 等少数情况才算「简单请求」，可以直接发送。application/json 不在其中，浏览器会先用 OPTIONS 预检，服务器回应允许后才发真正的请求。
whys: 直接发送只适用于简单请求，application/json 不是。
跨域 POST 是允许的，前提是服务器的 CORS 头同意。
正确：非简单请求要先预检。
fetch 不会自动转成 JSONP。

en.q: A page fetches a POST to an API on another origin with Content-Type: application/json. What does the browser do first?
choices: Send the POST straight away and check the response headers after
Refuse to send it, since cross-origin POSTs are not allowed
Send an OPTIONS preflight to check the server allows this method and these headers
en.explain: Only a few requests count as simple and go straight out: GET, HEAD or POST with a Content-Type of application/x-www-form-urlencoded, multipart/form-data or text/plain, among other limits. application/json is not one of them, so the browser sends an OPTIONS preflight and only sends the real request if the server allows it.
whys: Sending straight away is only for simple requests, and application/json is not one.
Cross-origin POSTs are allowed when the server's CORS headers agree.
Right: a non-simple request is preflighted.
fetch never turns into JSONP.

zh.q: 跨域请求带上了 Cookie（credentials: 'include'），服务器返回 Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *。结果是？
choices: 一切正常，* 表示允许所有来源
浏览器会自动去掉 Cookie 再重发
服务器不会收到这个请求
浏览器拒绝让页面读取响应：带凭据的请求必须返回具体的来源，不能是 *
zh.explain: 为了防止任意网站带着用户 Cookie 读取数据，规范规定带凭据的跨域请求，Access-Control-Allow-Origin 必须是具体的来源（如 https://app.example.com），还要返回 Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true。服务器应该按白名单回显来源，而不是写 *。
whys: * 只对不带凭据的请求有效。
浏览器不会自动重发请求。
服务器已经返回了响应头，说明请求到达了服务器；拦截发生在浏览器把响应交给页面时。
正确：带凭据时不能用通配符。

en.q: A cross-origin request is sent with cookies (credentials: 'include') and the server answers Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *. What happens?
choices: It works, because * allows every origin
The browser strips the cookies and retries
The request never reaches the server
The browser does not let the page read the response: credentialed requests need a specific origin, not *
en.explain: So that arbitrary sites cannot read data with the user's cookies, the spec requires credentialed cross-origin responses to name a specific origin (such as https://app.example.com) in Access-Control-Allow-Origin, plus Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true. Servers should echo allow-listed origins rather than send *.
whys: * only works for requests without credentials.
The browser does not retry by itself.
The server answered, so the request reached it; the block happens when the browser hands the response to the page.
Right: no wildcard with credentials.

zh.q: 下面哪个 URL 和 https://app.example.com/page 是同源的？
zh.explain: 同源要求协议、主机名、端口三者完全相同，路径和查询参数不影响。http 和 https 协议不同；api 和 app 是不同的主机；8443 和默认的 443 端口不同。
whys: 子域名不同就是不同的主机。
正确：协议、主机、端口都相同。
协议不同（http 与 https）。

en.q: Which URL is same-origin with https://app.example.com/page?
en.explain: Same origin means the same scheme, host and port; path and query do not matter. http differs in scheme, api.example.com is a different host, and 8443 differs from the default port 443.
whys: A different subdomain is a different host.
Right: same scheme, host and port.
The scheme differs (http vs https).
The port differs (8443 vs 443).

zh.q: 哈希和加密的主要区别是？
choices: 哈希比加密更安全，所以可以替代加密
哈希需要密钥，加密不需要
哈希是单向的，无法还原原文；加密可以用密钥解密还原
加密的输出长度固定，哈希的输出长度随输入变化
zh.explain: 哈希把任意输入映射成固定长度的摘要，设计上无法反推原文，适合校验完整性、存密码。加密是为了之后还能解密读取，适合保护需要还原的数据。两者用途不同，不能互相替代。
whys: 两者用途不同：需要还原数据时只能用加密。
普通哈希不需要密钥（带密钥的是 HMAC），加密需要密钥。
正确：单向与可逆。
说反了：哈希输出长度固定。

en.q: What is the main difference between hashing and encryption?
choices: Hashing is more secure than encryption and can replace it
Hashing needs a key and encryption does not
Hashing is one-way and cannot be reversed; encryption can be decrypted with a key
Encryption output has a fixed length, while hash output varies with the input
en.explain: A hash maps any input to a fixed-length digest that by design cannot be turned back into the input, which suits integrity checks and password storage. Encryption exists so the data can be decrypted and read later, which suits data you need back. They do different jobs.
whys: They do different jobs; when you need the data back only encryption works.
Plain hashes need no key (HMAC adds one); encryption does need a key.
Right: one-way versus reversible.
Reversed: hash output has a fixed length.

zh.q: 存储用户密码，下面哪种做法最合适？
choices: 用 AES 加密后存储，需要时解密比对
用 bcrypt、scrypt 或 Argon2 这类加盐的慢哈希
zh.explain: 密码哈希要故意算得慢（可调的工作因子），让泄露后的暴力破解代价很高，并且每个密码用不同的盐。SHA-256、MD5 是为速度设计的通用哈希，显卡每秒能算数十亿次；可逆加密意味着拿到密钥就能还原所有密码。
whys: 通用哈希太快，也没有盐，容易被彩虹表和暴力破解。
可逆加密一旦密钥泄露，所有密码都会暴露。
正确：加盐、可调成本的慢哈希。
MD5 很快且已不安全，加盐也挡不住大规模暴力破解。

en.q: Which is the right way to store user passwords?
choices: AES-encrypt them and decrypt to compare
A salted slow hash such as bcrypt, scrypt or Argon2
en.explain: Password hashing should be deliberately slow (with a tunable work factor), making brute force after a leak expensive, and use a unique salt per password. SHA-256 and MD5 are general hashes built for speed, and GPUs compute billions per second; reversible encryption means whoever gets the key gets every password.
whys: A general hash is fast and unsalted, open to rainbow tables and brute force.
Reversible encryption exposes every password once the key leaks.
Right: a salted hash with a tunable cost.
MD5 is fast and broken; a salt does not stop large-scale brute force.

zh.q: 密码哈希里的「盐」（salt）有什么作用？
choices: 让相同的密码得到不同的哈希，使预先算好的彩虹表失效
让哈希可以被解密还原
盐是密钥，必须保密，泄露就能解出密码
zh.explain: 每个用户一个随机盐，和密码一起哈希。这样两个用户用相同的密码，哈希值也不同；攻击者也无法用一张预先算好的表对所有用户通用。盐和哈希值存在一起，不需要保密。
whys: 正确：防止相同密码同哈希、防彩虹表。
加了盐的哈希仍然是单向的。
盐不改变计算速度；控制速度的是工作因子。
盐不需要保密，通常和哈希值存在一起。

en.q: What does a salt do in password hashing?
choices: It makes equal passwords hash differently, so precomputed rainbow tables stop working
It is a secret key; if it leaks the passwords can be recovered
en.explain: Each user gets a random salt that is hashed together with the password. Two users with the same password then get different hashes, and an attacker cannot use one precomputed table against everyone. The salt is stored next to the hash and need not be secret.
whys: Right: equal passwords differ, and rainbow tables fail.
A salted hash is still one-way.
A salt does not change speed; the work factor does.
A salt is not secret and is usually stored with the hash.

zh.q: 关于常见的签名型 JWT（JWS，比如 HS256），下面哪项正确？
choices: payload 是加密的，只有服务器能看到
签名能防止别人读取 token 的内容
payload 只是 Base64URL 编码，任何拿到 token 的人都能解码看到内容
把 token 存在 localStorage 里比 Cookie 更能防 XSS
zh.explain: 签名保证的是完整性：别人改了内容，签名就对不上。但它不保密，payload 解码就能看到，不要在里面放密码、身份证号这类敏感信息。需要保密要用加密的 JWE。localStorage 里的 token 能被 XSS 脚本直接读走。
whys: 普通 JWS 不加密，需要保密要用 JWE。
签名防篡改，不防读取。
正确：签名不等于加密。
XSS 脚本可以直接读取 localStorage。

en.q: Which is true of a typical signed JWT (a JWS, say HS256)?
choices: The payload is encrypted, so only the server can read it
The signature stops others from reading the token
The payload is only Base64URL-encoded; anyone holding the token can decode and read it
Keeping the token in localStorage protects it from XSS better than a cookie
en.explain: The signature guarantees integrity: change the contents and the signature no longer matches. It does not hide anything; decoding shows the payload, so never put passwords or ID numbers in it. Secrecy needs an encrypted JWE. A token in localStorage can be read straight off by XSS.
whys: A plain JWS is not encrypted; secrecy needs JWE.
The signature stops tampering, not reading.
Right: signed is not encrypted.
XSS can read localStorage directly.

zh.q: 服务端校验收到的 JWT 时，最重要的是？
choices: 只要 token 格式正确（三段用点分隔）就接受
用自己固定的算法和密钥验证签名，并检查 exp 等声明
按 token 头里 alg 字段指定的算法验证，包括 none
解码 payload，直接信任里面的用户 ID
zh.explain: token 是客户端交来的，内容全都可以伪造，只有验证签名之后才可信。算法要由服务器指定，不能听 token 头里的 alg（经典漏洞：alg 改成 none 跳过签名，或者把 RS256 改成 HS256 用公钥当密钥）。还要检查过期时间 exp、签发方 iss、受众 aud。
whys: 格式正确的 token 任何人都能构造。
正确：服务器决定算法，先验签再看声明。
让 token 自己指定算法会被 alg=none 等方式绕过。
不验签就信任 payload，等于谁都能伪造身份。

en.q: When the server checks an incoming JWT, what matters most?
choices: Accept any token with the right shape (three dot-separated parts)
Verify the signature with your own fixed algorithm and key, and check claims such as exp
Verify with whatever alg the token header names, none included
Decode the payload and trust the user ID in it
en.explain: The token comes from the client and every part can be forged; only a verified signature makes it trustworthy. The server must pick the algorithm rather than obey the header's alg (classic bugs: alg set to none to skip the signature, or RS256 swapped for HS256 with the public key as the secret). Then check exp, iss and aud.
whys: Anyone can build a correctly shaped token.
Right: the server picks the algorithm, verifies, then checks claims.
Letting the token choose its algorithm opens tricks such as alg=none.
Trusting an unverified payload lets anyone forge an identity.

zh.q: 用无状态 JWT 做登录，用户点了「退出登录」或者账号被封，已经签发的 token 会怎样？
choices: 服务器会立刻让它失效
浏览器会自动删除它，之后无法再使用
在过期前仍然有效，除非服务器额外维护黑名单或缩短有效期配合刷新令牌
zh.explain: 无状态 JWT 的好处是服务器不用查库就能验证，代价是服务器不记得发过哪些 token，签名在过期前一直有效。常见做法：访问令牌只活几分钟，配合可撤销的刷新令牌；或者维护一个吊销列表，但这又引入了状态。
whys: 服务器没有记录签发过的 token，无法让某一个单独失效。
签名只和内容、密钥有关，不会自己失效。
客户端删掉的只是自己那份，被盗的副本仍然有效。
正确：无状态意味着无法单方面撤销。

en.q: With stateless JWTs for login, what happens to an issued token when the user logs out or the account is banned?
choices: The server invalidates it at once
Its signature stops being valid on its own
The browser deletes it automatically, so it can no longer be used
It stays valid until it expires, unless the server keeps a denylist or uses short expiry with refresh tokens
en.explain: Stateless JWTs can be checked without a database lookup, at the cost that the server does not remember what it issued: a signature stays valid until expiry. The usual answer is short-lived access tokens with revocable refresh tokens, or a revocation list, which brings state back.
whys: The server keeps no record of tokens, so it cannot kill one on its own.
A signature depends only on content and key; it does not expire by itself.
The client deletes its own copy; a stolen copy still works.
Right: stateless means no one-sided revocation.

zh.q: HTTPS（TLS）建立连接后传输大量数据，用的是哪种加密方式？
choices: 对称加密，密钥在握手时借助非对称密码协商出来
全程用服务器的 RSA 公钥加密
用客户端证书的私钥加密
zh.explain: 非对称密码（如 ECDHE 密钥交换和证书签名）用来在不安全的网络上协商出共享密钥、确认服务器身份；之后的数据用对称加密（如 AES-GCM、ChaCha20-Poly1305），因为对称加密快得多。
whys: 正确：非对称协商密钥，对称加密数据。
非对称加密太慢，不用来加密整个数据流。
大多数 HTTPS 连接根本没有客户端证书。
TLS 对数据加密，并带完整性校验。

en.q: Once an HTTPS (TLS) connection is up, which kind of encryption carries the bulk of the data?
choices: Symmetric encryption, with keys agreed during the handshake using asymmetric cryptography
Everything is encrypted with the server's RSA public key
en.explain: Asymmetric cryptography (ECDHE key exchange, certificate signatures) agrees a shared secret over an untrusted network and proves the server's identity; the data itself then goes under symmetric encryption (AES-GCM, ChaCha20-Poly1305), which is far faster.
whys: Right: asymmetric to agree keys, symmetric for the data.
Asymmetric encryption is too slow for the whole stream.
Most HTTPS connections have no client certificate at all.
TLS encrypts the data and protects its integrity.

COUNT(*) ignores values; all 4 rows count.

两处都错：<> 不选 NULL 行，IS NULL 能选到。

Both wrong: <> skips NULL rows, IS NULL finds them.

正确：列表里有 NULL，NOT IN 永远不为真。
如果 b 里没有 NULL，结果才会是 2（1 和 3）。

whys: NOT IN does not just skip the NULL entry.
Right: with a NULL in the list, NOT IN is never true.
Without the NULL in b the answer would be 2 (1 and 3).
x = 2 should be excluded anyway, and the NULL removes the rest.

正确：ON 里的条件不删左表行。
这是把条件写在 WHERE 里的结果。

whys: bo's order of 20 fails amount > 25.
Right: a condition in ON never removes left-table rows.
That is what putting the condition in WHERE gives.
LEFT JOIN keeps cy even though he has no orders.

zh.q: 在 SQLite 里依次执行下面的语句，最后一条查询返回什么？（每行一条记录，列之间用 | 分隔）

bo 的订单是 20，在 WHERE 里被删掉了。
cy 那行 amount 是 NULL，NULL > 25 不为真。

whys: Right: WHERE also removes the rows that did not match.
bo's order is 20 and WHERE drops it.
cy's row has amount NULL, and NULL > 25 is not true.
That is what the condition in ON gives.

只有键相同的行才配对；id 2 在 q 里没有匹配，不产生行。
正确：重复的键会相乘。
id 2 和 id 3 都找不到匹配，不会贡献行。

Only rows with equal keys pair up; id 2 has no match in q and adds nothing.
Right: duplicate keys multiply.
ids 2 and 3 have no match, so they add nothing.

The condition is on the row count, not the amount.
west has two rows and stays; north has one.
HAVING removes north, which has one row.

zh.q: 在 SQLite 里依次执行下面的语句，最后一条查询返回什么？（每行一条记录，列之间用 | 分隔）

west 的行都小于等于 8，已被 WHERE 去掉。
没有行的组不会出现，不会显示为 0。
east 的 10 也大于 8，被保留。

Both west rows are 8 or less and are removed by WHERE.
A group with no rows does not appear at all, not as 0.
east's 10 is also above 8 and stays.

UNION ALL keeps everything: 3 rows from a plus 2 from b.
UNION does remove duplicates.
UNION also removes the duplicate 2 inside a.

zh.q: 在 SQLite 里依次执行下面的语句，最后一条查询返回什么？（每行一条记录，列之间用 | 分隔）

100 is the third highest.
Without DISTINCT the second row would be 300.

The window function sums the frame, not just the current row.

id 1 的 v 小于 2，不会被更新。
NULL 不会被当成 1。

en.q: Run these statements in SQLite. What does the last query return? (One row per line, columns separated by |)
en.explain: WHERE picks ids 2 and 3. id 2 becomes 20; for id 3, NULL * 10 is still NULL. id 1 has v = 1, fails the condition and is unchanged.
whys: Right: NULL times anything is still NULL.
NULL times a number stays NULL; it does not become 0.
id 1 has v below 2 and is not updated.
NULL is not treated as 1.

zh.q: 响应头 Cache-Control: no-cache 的含义是？
choices: 缓存一小时后再向服务器验证
可以缓存，但每次使用前都要先向服务器验证是否过期
只允许浏览器缓存，CDN 不能缓存
zh.explain: no-cache 名字容易误解：它允许存储，但每次使用前必须用 If-None-Match / If-Modified-Since 向服务器确认，没变就收到 304 继续用缓存。完全不存储要用 no-store；只让浏览器缓存是 private。
whys: 缓存一段时间不验证是 max-age 的作用。
完全不缓存是 no-store。
正确：可存，但用前必须验证。
只允许浏览器缓存是 private。

en.q: What does the response header Cache-Control: no-cache mean?
choices: Cache it for an hour, then revalidate
It must not be cached at all
It may be cached, but must be revalidated with the server before every use
Only the browser may cache it, not a CDN
en.explain: no-cache is easy to misread: storing is allowed, but every use must first be confirmed with the server via If-None-Match or If-Modified-Since, and a 304 means the cached copy is still good. Not storing at all is no-store; browser-only caching is private.
whys: Caching for a while without checking is max-age.
Not caching at all is no-store.
Right: storable, but revalidated before each use.
Browser-only caching is private.

zh.q: 资源响应头是 Cache-Control: max-age=3600。半小时后再次请求，浏览器会怎么做？
choices: 向服务器发条件请求，等 304
直接使用本地缓存，不联系服务器
zh.explain: max-age 表示资源在多少秒内是新鲜的。新鲜期内浏览器直接用缓存（开发者工具里显示 from disk/memory cache），不发任何请求；过期后才发条件请求验证。
whys: 条件请求是过期之后（或 no-cache 时）才发的。
请求不会被推迟，只是直接用缓存。
正确：新鲜期内直接命中缓存。
缓存仍然新鲜，不需要重新下载。

en.q: A resource came with Cache-Control: max-age=3600. Requested again half an hour later, what does the browser do?
choices: Send a conditional request and wait for a 304
Wait until the hour is up before requesting
Use the cached copy without contacting the server
en.explain: max-age says how many seconds the resource stays fresh. While fresh, the browser uses the cache without any request (devtools shows from disk or memory cache); only once stale does it send a conditional request.
whys: A conditional request comes only once it is stale (or with no-cache).
Nothing is delayed; the cache simply answers.
Right: a fresh resource is served from cache.
The cached copy is still fresh, so nothing is re-downloaded.

zh.q: 浏览器带着 If-None-Match: "abc123" 请求资源，服务器上该资源的 ETag 仍是 "abc123"。服务器应该返回什么？
zh.explain: ETag 是资源版本的标识。条件请求里的 ETag 和服务器当前的一致，说明缓存没过时，服务器回 304 且不带内容，浏览器继续用本地副本，省掉了传输。
whys: 204 表示请求成功但本来就没有内容，不用于缓存验证。
正确：资源未变，返回 304。
资源没变，没必要再传一遍内容。
412 用于 If-Match 这类前提条件不满足（比如并发写冲突）。

en.q: The browser requests a resource with If-None-Match: "abc123", and the resource's ETag on the server is still "abc123". What should the server return?
en.explain: An ETag identifies a version of the resource. When the conditional request's ETag matches the current one, the cache is still good: the server returns 304 with no body and the browser keeps its copy, saving the transfer.
whys: 204 means success with no content at all, not a cache check.
Right: unchanged, so 304.
Nothing changed, so there is no need to send it again.
412 is for failed preconditions such as If-Match on a conflicting write.

zh.q: 构建后的文件名带内容哈希（如 app.3f9a1c.js），HTML 引用新文件名。这些 JS 文件最合适的缓存头是？
zh.explain: 文件内容一变，文件名就变，同一个 URL 的内容永远不会变，所以可以缓存一年并标 immutable。需要短缓存或每次验证的是引用它们的 HTML，这样发版后用户能拿到新的文件名。
whys: 缓存太短，带哈希的文件本来可以缓存很久。
正确：URL 内容不变，可以长期缓存。
每次都要验证，多了一次往返，没必要。
每次都重新下载，浪费带宽，失去了哈希文件名的意义。

en.q: Built files carry a content hash in their name (app.3f9a1c.js) and the HTML references the new name. Which caching header suits these JS files best?
en.explain: Any change to the content changes the name, so a given URL never changes and can be cached for a year and marked immutable. It is the HTML that references them that needs a short cache or revalidation, so users pick up the new names after a release.
whys: Far too short for files whose URL never changes.
Right: the URL never changes content, so cache it long.
Revalidating each time adds a round trip for nothing.
Downloading every time wastes bandwidth and defeats the hashed names.

zh.q: 返回用户个人资料的接口，响应头写 Cache-Control: private, max-age=60 表示什么？
choices: 内容是加密的，只有用户能看
只有用户自己的浏览器可以缓存 60 秒，CDN 等共享缓存不能存
CDN 可以缓存 60 秒，浏览器不能缓存
zh.explain: private 表示响应是给某个用户的，只能存在私有缓存（浏览器）里，共享缓存（CDN、代理）不能存，否则可能把 A 的资料发给 B。public 则允许共享缓存存储。
whys: Cache-Control 只管缓存，与加密无关。
正确：只允许私有缓存。
说反了：private 正是禁止共享缓存。
max-age 是新鲜期，不是限流。

en.q: An endpoint returning a user's profile sends Cache-Control: private, max-age=60. What does that mean?
choices: The content is encrypted so only the user can read it
Only the user's own browser may cache it, for 60 seconds; shared caches such as CDNs must not
A CDN may cache it for 60 seconds, the browser may not
The endpoint is off limits for 60 seconds
en.explain: private marks a response as meant for one user: only a private cache (the browser) may store it, never a shared cache such as a CDN or proxy, which could otherwise serve A's profile to B. public allows shared caches.
whys: Cache-Control is about caching, not encryption.
Right: private caches only.
Reversed: private is what keeps shared caches out.
max-age is a freshness lifetime, not rate limiting.

zh.q: 关于 localStorage 和 sessionStorage，哪项正确？
choices: localStorage 默认 24 小时后过期
localStorage 关掉浏览器后仍在；sessionStorage 属于单个标签页，标签页关闭就清除
sessionStorage 在同源的所有标签页之间共享
两者都会随每次请求自动发给服务器
zh.explain: 两者都按源隔离、只存字符串、不会自动发给服务器。localStorage 持久保存，直到被代码或用户清除；sessionStorage 绑定在一个标签页（浏览上下文）上，同源的另一个标签页看不到，关闭标签页就没了。
whys: localStorage 没有过期时间。
正确：持久与单标签页会话的区别。
每个标签页有自己的 sessionStorage。
会随请求自动发送的是 Cookie。

en.q: Which is true of localStorage and sessionStorage?
choices: localStorage expires after 24 hours by default
localStorage survives closing the browser; sessionStorage belongs to one tab and is cleared when that tab closes
sessionStorage is shared by every tab of the origin
Both are sent to the server with every request
en.explain: Both are per-origin, store only strings and are never sent to the server on their own. localStorage persists until code or the user clears it; sessionStorage belongs to one tab (browsing context), is invisible to other tabs of the origin, and goes when the tab closes.
whys: localStorage has no expiry.
Right: persistent versus one-tab session.
Each tab has its own sessionStorage.
Cookies are what ride along with requests.

zh.q: 执行 localStorage.setItem("user", { id: 1 }) 之后，localStorage.getItem("user") 返回什么？
zh.explain: Web Storage 只能存字符串，setItem 会把值用 String() 转换，普通对象转成 "[object Object]"，原来的数据就丢了。存对象要先 JSON.stringify，取出后再 JSON.parse。
whys: 正确：对象被转成了字符串 "[object Object]"。
键已经写入，读取会得到转换后的字符串。
Web Storage 不能保存对象，只能存字符串。
只有手动 JSON.stringify 才会得到 JSON 字符串。

en.q: After localStorage.setItem("user", { id: 1 }), what does localStorage.getItem("user") return?
en.explain: Web Storage holds only strings, and setItem converts the value with String(), so a plain object becomes "[object Object]" and the data is lost. Store objects with JSON.stringify and read them back with JSON.parse.
whys: Right: the object became the string "[object Object]".
The key was written, so reading returns the converted string.
Web Storage cannot hold objects, only strings.
You get JSON only if you call JSON.stringify yourself.

zh.q: Cookie 设置了 Secure 和 HttpOnly 两个属性，分别起什么作用？
choices: Secure：只通过 HTTPS 发送；HttpOnly：页面脚本无法读取
Secure：内容被加密；HttpOnly：只在 HTTP（非 HTTPS）下发送
Secure：不能跨站发送；HttpOnly：只能由服务器删除
Secure：只能在本域名使用；HttpOnly：浏览器关闭即失效
zh.explain: Secure 防止 Cookie 在明文 HTTP 连接上被窃听；HttpOnly 防止 document.cookie 读取，减轻 XSS 窃取会话。限制跨站携带的是 SameSite，浏览器关闭即失效是不设 Expires / Max-Age 的会话 Cookie。
whys: 正确：Secure 管传输，HttpOnly 管脚本访问。
Secure 不加密内容；HttpOnly 的意思不是「只走 HTTP 协议」。
跨站限制是 SameSite；HttpOnly 与删除权限无关。
域名范围由 Domain 决定，失效时间由 Expires / Max-Age 决定。

en.q: A cookie is set with Secure and HttpOnly. What does each do?
choices: Secure: sent only over HTTPS; HttpOnly: page scripts cannot read it
Secure: the value is encrypted; HttpOnly: sent only over plain HTTP
Secure: never sent cross-site; HttpOnly: only the server can delete it
Secure: usable only on this domain; HttpOnly: gone when the browser closes
en.explain: Secure keeps the cookie off plain-HTTP connections where it could be sniffed; HttpOnly keeps it from document.cookie, blunting session theft by XSS. Cross-site limits are SameSite, and expiring with the browser is what a session cookie without Expires or Max-Age does.
whys: Right: Secure is about transport, HttpOnly about script access.
Secure does not encrypt the value, and HttpOnly does not mean plain HTTP only.
Cross-site limits are SameSite; HttpOnly is unrelated to deletion.
Scope comes from Domain and lifetime from Expires or Max-Age.

zh.q: 在 www.example.com 上设置 Cookie 时没有写 Domain 属性。它会被发给 api.example.com 吗？
choices: 不会：没写 Domain 时是仅限当前主机（host-only）的 Cookie
会，但只有 GET 请求才带
会：Cookie 默认发给所有子域名
zh.explain: 不写 Domain，Cookie 只发回设置它的那个主机（www.example.com）。写了 Domain=example.com，才会发给 example.com 及其所有子域名（包括 api.example.com）。Path 限制的是路径，与主机无关。
whys: Path 只限制路径，不能让 Cookie 跨主机。
正确：默认只发给设置它的主机。
是否携带和请求方法无关（SameSite 另说）。
只有显式设置 Domain=example.com 才会发给子域名。

en.q: A cookie is set on www.example.com without a Domain attribute. Is it sent to api.example.com?
choices: It depends on the Path attribute
No: without Domain it is a host-only cookie
Yes, but only on GET requests
Yes: cookies go to every subdomain by default
en.explain: Without Domain, the cookie goes back only to the host that set it, www.example.com. Domain=example.com would send it to example.com and every subdomain, api.example.com included. Path limits paths, not hosts.
whys: Path limits paths; it cannot make a cookie cross hosts.
Right: by default it goes only to the host that set it.
The method does not decide this (SameSite aside).
Only an explicit Domain=example.com reaches subdomains.

zh.q: <body> 里有 <div>，<div> 里有 <button>，三者都用 addEventListener("click", …) 注册了处理函数（默认参数）。点击按钮时，处理函数的执行顺序是？
choices: 只有 button 的处理函数会执行
zh.explain: 事件先从 window 向下传到目标（捕获阶段），再从目标向上冒泡。addEventListener 默认在冒泡阶段触发，所以从按钮开始逐层向上：button、div、body。
whys: 正确：默认在冒泡阶段，从里到外。
冒泡从目标本身开始。
从外到内是捕获阶段，需要传 { capture: true }（或第三个参数 true）。
click 事件会冒泡，祖先的处理函数也会执行。

en.q: <body> contains a <div> that contains a <button>, and each registers a click handler with addEventListener("click", …) and default options. Clicking the button runs the handlers in which order?
en.explain: An event travels down from window to the target (capture), then bubbles back up. addEventListener fires in the bubble phase by default, so the order runs upward from the button: button, div, body.
whys: Right: the bubble phase, inside out.
Bubbling starts at the target itself.
Outside in is the capture phase, which needs { capture: true } (or true as the third argument).
click bubbles, so the ancestors' handlers run too.

zh.q: 在 <ul> 上做事件委托：ul.addEventListener("click", e => …)。用户点击了某个 <li> 里的 <span>，事件处理函数中 e.target 和 e.currentTarget 分别是？
choices: e.target 是 ul，e.currentTarget 是 span
e.target 是 li，e.currentTarget 是 ul
e.target 是 span，e.currentTarget 是 ul
zh.explain: target 是事件实际发生的最内层元素；currentTarget 是当前正在执行的处理函数所绑定的元素。委托时常用 e.target.closest("li") 从 target 往上找到要处理的那一项。
whys: 说反了。
被点击的是 span，不是 li；要拿到 li 得用 closest。
正确：target 是被点的元素，currentTarget 是绑定处理函数的元素。
currentTarget 是绑定监听器的 ul。

en.q: Delegation on a <ul>: ul.addEventListener("click", e => …). The user clicks a <span> inside an <li>. In the handler, what are e.target and e.currentTarget?
choices: e.target is the ul, e.currentTarget is the span
e.target is the li, e.currentTarget is the ul
e.target is the span, e.currentTarget is the ul
en.explain: target is the innermost element where the event happened; currentTarget is the element whose handler is running. With delegation you usually call e.target.closest("li") to walk up from the target to the item you care about.
whys: Reversed.
The span was clicked, not the li; closest gets you the li.
Right: target is what was clicked; currentTarget is where the handler is bound.
currentTarget is the ul the listener is on.

zh.q: 一个列表有上千项，而且会动态增减。用事件委托（在父元素上注册一个监听器）相比给每一项单独注册，主要好处是？
choices: 可以阻止事件冒泡到 document
子元素的默认行为会被自动取消
只需一个监听器，新增的项不用再绑定也能响应
zh.explain: 事件委托利用冒泡，在共同的父元素上处理子元素的事件：只占一个监听器的内存，后来插入的元素也自动生效，删除元素时不用解绑。
whys: 委托本身不会阻止冒泡。
委托依赖冒泡，父元素上的处理反而在目标之后。
取消默认行为需要显式调用 preventDefault()。
正确：省监听器，动态元素自动生效。

en.q: A list has thousands of items that come and go. What is the main gain from event delegation (one listener on the parent) over one listener per item?
choices: It stops events bubbling to document
Child elements' default actions are cancelled automatically
One listener in total, and new items respond without extra binding
en.explain: Delegation relies on bubbling to handle children's events at a shared parent: one listener's worth of memory, elements added later work at once, and removing elements needs no unbinding.
whys: Delegation does not stop bubbling by itself.
Delegation relies on bubbling, so the parent handles it after the target, not sooner.
Default actions are only cancelled by calling preventDefault().
Right: fewer listeners, and dynamic items just work.

zh.q: 在链接 <a href="/next"> 的点击处理函数里只调用了 e.stopPropagation()，会发生什么？
choices: 链接不跳转，事件也不再冒泡
链接不跳转，但事件仍会冒泡
事件不再冒泡到父元素，但链接仍会跳转
zh.explain: stopPropagation 只阻止事件继续传播给其他元素；preventDefault 才会取消浏览器的默认行为（链接跳转、表单提交、复选框勾选等）。两者是独立的。
whys: 父元素上的处理函数不会再收到这个事件。
要阻止跳转得调用 preventDefault()。
说反了：stopPropagation 阻止的是冒泡。
正确：阻止传播不等于取消默认行为。

en.q: A click handler on <a href="/next"> calls only e.stopPropagation(). What happens?
choices: The link does not navigate and the event stops bubbling
The link does not navigate, but the event still bubbles
The event stops bubbling to the parents, but the link still navigates
en.explain: stopPropagation only stops the event reaching other elements; preventDefault is what cancels the browser's default action (following a link, submitting a form, ticking a checkbox). The two are independent.
whys: Parent handlers no longer receive the event.
Stopping navigation needs preventDefault().
Reversed: stopPropagation is what stops the bubbling.
Right: stopping propagation is not cancelling the default.

zh.q: 父元素用 addEventListener("click", f, true) 注册，子元素用默认方式注册。点击子元素时谁先执行？
choices: 父元素的 f 先执行（捕获阶段）
zh.explain: 第三个参数 true 表示在捕获阶段触发。事件先从外向内经过父元素（触发 f），到达目标后再执行子元素的处理函数，之后才冒泡。
whys: JavaScript 事件处理是单线程依次执行的。
正确：捕获阶段在目标阶段之前。
父元素在捕获阶段的处理函数同样会执行。
如果父元素也用默认方式（冒泡），子元素才会先执行。

en.q: A parent registers with addEventListener("click", f, true) and a child with the default options. Clicking the child, which handler runs first?
choices: The parent's f, during the capture phase
en.explain: true as the third argument means the capture phase. The event passes the parent on its way in (running f), reaches the target and runs the child's handler, then bubbles.
whys: Event handlers run one at a time on a single thread.
Right: the capture phase comes before the target.
The parent's capture-phase handler runs as well.
The child would go first only if the parent also used the default (bubble) phase.

zh.q: 一个 div 的样式是 width: 200px; padding: 20px; border: 5px solid; box-sizing: content-box。它在页面上占的总宽度（不含 margin）是？
zh.explain: content-box（默认值）下 width 只是内容宽度，内边距和边框另外加：200 + 20 × 2 + 5 × 2 = 250px。改成 box-sizing: border-box 后，width 包括内边距和边框，总宽就是 200px。
whys: 这是 border-box 的结果。
漏掉了左右边框各 5px。
正确：内容加两侧内边距和边框。
内边距和边框都要算两侧。

en.q: A div has width: 200px; padding: 20px; border: 5px solid; box-sizing: content-box. How wide is it on the page, margin excluded?
en.explain: Under content-box, the default, width is just the content; padding and border are added on: 200 + 20 × 2 + 5 × 2 = 250px. With box-sizing: border-box the width includes them and the total is 200px.
whys: That is the border-box result.
This leaves out the 5px border on each side.
Right: content plus padding and border on both sides.
Padding and border count on both sides.

zh.q: 上下相邻的两个块级元素，上面的 margin-bottom: 20px，下面的 margin-top: 30px。它们之间的垂直间距是？
zh.explain: 普通文档流中，相邻块级元素的垂直外边距会合并（margin collapsing），取两者中较大的那个，而不是相加。水平外边距不会合并；flex 和 grid 的子项之间也不会合并。
whys: 合并不取平均值。
正确：外边距合并，取较大值。
合并时取较大的，不是较小的。
垂直外边距会合并，不会相加。

en.q: Two stacked block elements: the upper has margin-bottom: 20px, the lower margin-top: 30px. How much vertical space is between them?
en.explain: In normal flow, adjacent vertical margins of block elements collapse to the larger of the two instead of adding up. Horizontal margins never collapse, and neither do margins between flex or grid items.
whys: Collapsing does not average.
Right: the margins collapse to the larger one.
Collapsing keeps the larger one, not the smaller.
Vertical margins collapse rather than add.

zh.q: 鼠标正悬停在一个链接上，它同时匹配三条规则（都没有 !important）：#nav a { color: red }；.menu .item a { color: blue }；a:hover { color: green }。最终显示什么颜色？
choices: 取决于规则在文件里的先后顺序
zh.explain: 优先级按（ID 数, 类/属性/伪类数, 元素数）比较：#nav a 是 (1,0,1)，.menu .item a 是 (0,2,1)，a:hover 是 (0,1,1)。ID 选择器那一位最高，所以红色胜出。只有优先级完全相同时，才比较先后顺序。
whys: 优先级不同时，先后顺序不起作用。
正确：带 ID 的选择器优先级最高。
:hover 只算一个伪类，优先级最低。
两个类选择器也比不过一个 ID 选择器。

en.q: A hovered link matches three rules, none with !important: #nav a { color: red }; .menu .item a { color: blue }; a:hover { color: green }. Which colour shows?
choices: It depends on which rule comes last in the file
en.explain: Specificity compares (IDs, classes/attributes/pseudo-classes, elements): #nav a is (1,0,1), .menu .item a is (0,2,1), a:hover is (0,1,1). The ID column wins, so red. Source order only matters when specificity ties exactly.
whys: Order only breaks exact ties.
Right: the selector with an ID wins.
:hover counts as a single pseudo-class, the lowest here.
Two classes still lose to one ID.

zh.q: 元素的行内样式是 style="color: red"，样式表里有 p { color: blue !important; }。最终颜色是？
zh.explain: !important 声明会胜过所有普通声明，包括行内样式。行内样式只是比普通的选择器优先级高。要盖过 !important，只能用优先级更高的 !important（或行内的 !important）。
whys: 这里由 !important 决定，与加载顺序无关。
正确：!important 胜过普通的行内样式。
行内样式没有 !important，比不过带 !important 的规则。
两条规则都匹配，不会回退到默认值。

en.q: An element has the inline style style="color: red" and the stylesheet has p { color: blue !important; }. Which colour wins?
en.explain: An !important declaration beats every normal declaration, inline styles included; inline styles only outrank normal selectors. Overriding !important takes a more specific !important (or an inline !important).
whys: !important decides here, not load order.
Right: !important beats a normal inline style.
The inline style has no !important, so it loses.
Both rules apply, so nothing falls back to the default.

zh.q: 容器是 display: flex; flex-direction: column;，想让子元素在垂直方向上居中，应该用哪个属性？
zh.explain: justify-content 沿主轴对齐，align-items 沿交叉轴对齐。flex-direction: column 时主轴是竖直方向，所以垂直居中用 justify-content；默认的 row 方向下则正好相反。
whys: 正确：column 时主轴是竖直的。
column 方向下 align-items 控制的是水平方向。
vertical-align 用于行内和表格单元格，对 flex 布局无效。
text-align 只影响行内内容的水平对齐。

en.q: A container has display: flex; flex-direction: column. Which property centres the children vertically?
en.explain: justify-content aligns along the main axis and align-items along the cross axis. With flex-direction: column the main axis is vertical, so vertical centring is justify-content; in the default row direction it is the other way round.
whys: Right: in a column the main axis is vertical.
In a column, align-items works horizontally.
vertical-align is for inline content and table cells, not flex layout.
text-align only aligns inline content horizontally.

zh.q: flex 容器里三个子元素都写了 flex: 1，没有设置宽度。它们怎样分配宽度？
choices: 按各自内容的宽度比例分配
第一个占满，剩下两个宽度为 0
每个都是容器宽度的 100%，换成三行
平分容器宽度，因为 flex: 1 等于 flex-grow: 1、flex-shrink: 1、flex-basis: 0%
zh.explain: flex-basis 为 0 时，所有空间都算作剩余空间，再按 flex-grow 的比例（1:1:1）分配，所以三者等宽（内容的最小宽度允许的前提下）。flex: auto 的 basis 是 auto，才会先按内容宽度占位再分剩余空间。
whys: 按内容宽度分配的是 flex: auto。
三个的 flex-grow 相同，会平分。
flex 容器默认不换行（nowrap），并且 basis 是 0。
正确：basis 为 0，按 1:1:1 分配。

en.q: Three children of a flex container each have flex: 1 and no width. How do they share the width?
choices: In proportion to their content widths
The first takes everything and the other two get 0
Each takes 100% and they wrap onto three lines
Equally, since flex: 1 means flex-grow: 1, flex-shrink: 1, flex-basis: 0%
en.explain: With flex-basis 0, all the space counts as free space and is split by flex-grow, 1:1:1, so they come out equal (as long as their minimum content widths allow). flex: auto has basis auto, which first sizes by content and then shares what is left.
whys: Sizing by content first is flex: auto.
All three have the same flex-grow, so they share equally.
Flex containers do not wrap by default (nowrap), and the basis is 0.
Right: basis 0, split 1:1:1.

zh.q: 宽 300px 的容器设置 display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 2fr;（没有 gap）。两列各宽多少？
zh.explain: fr 表示剩余空间的份数。总共 3 份，每份 100px，所以是 100px 和 200px。有 gap 时先减去 gap 再分配。
whys: fr 分配的是容器内的剩余空间，不会超出容器。
fr 不是像素单位。
正确：按 1:2 分配 300px。
fr 按比例分配，1fr 和 2fr 不等宽。

en.q: A 300px-wide container has display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 2fr; and no gap. How wide is each column?
en.explain: fr is a share of the free space. Three shares in total make 100px each, so 100px and 200px. With a gap, the gap is taken out first.
whys: fr shares the container's free space and never exceeds it.
fr is not a pixel unit.
Right: 300px split 1:2.
fr splits by ratio, so 1fr and 2fr differ.

zh.q: 容器 grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);，没有定义行，里面放了 7 个子元素。会形成几行？
choices: 2 行，第 7 个元素被隐藏
3 行，最后一行只有 1 个元素
zh.explain: 显式定义的只有 3 列，子元素按行依次填入，放不下时自动创建隐式行（高度由 grid-auto-rows 决定，默认 auto）。7 个元素需要 ⌈7 / 3⌉ = 3 行。
whys: 元素不会被隐藏，会放进新的隐式行。
正确：自动创建隐式行。
每行有 3 列，会先填满一行。
grid 会自动增加行，不会让元素溢出。

en.q: A container has grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr), no rows defined, and 7 children. How many rows form?
choices: 3 rows, with 1 item in the last
en.explain: Only the 3 columns are explicit; items fill row by row and implicit rows are created as needed (sized by grid-auto-rows, auto by default). 7 items need ⌈7 / 3⌉ = 3 rows.
whys: Nothing is hidden; extra items go into new implicit rows.
Right: implicit rows are added.
Each row has 3 columns and fills up first.
Grid adds rows rather than letting items overflow.

zh.q: 下面哪个样式修改会触发重排（reflow / layout），而不仅仅是重绘？
zh.explain: 影响几何尺寸和位置的属性（width、height、margin、padding、font-size、top 等）会让浏览器重新计算布局，再重绘。只改外观（颜色、背景、visibility）不改变布局，只需重绘。
whys: 背景色只影响绘制。
颜色只影响绘制。
正确：尺寸变化需要重新布局。
visibility: hidden 仍保留占位，不改变布局，只需重绘。

en.q: Which style change triggers reflow (layout) rather than just a repaint?
en.explain: Properties that affect size or position (width, height, margin, padding, font-size, top and the like) make the browser recompute layout and then repaint. Purely visual ones (colours, backgrounds, visibility) leave layout alone and need only a repaint.
whys: Background colour only affects painting.
Colour only affects painting.
Right: a size change needs a new layout.
visibility: hidden keeps the element's space, so layout is unchanged and only a repaint is needed.

zh.q: 在循环里对每个元素先写 el.style.width = …，紧接着读 el.offsetHeight，页面变得很卡。原因和改法是？
choices: 每次读取都强制浏览器同步重新布局（布局抖动）；先集中读取，再集中写入
循环本身太慢；改用 forEach
style.width 只能在 CSS 文件里修改
offsetHeight 会触发网络请求；改用缓存
zh.explain: 浏览器通常会把样式修改攒起来，到下一帧再统一布局。但读取 offsetHeight、getBoundingClientRect 这类几何属性时，必须先把之前的修改布局完才能给出准确的值，于是读写交替的循环每一次都触发一次完整布局。把读和写分开批量做（或用 requestAnimationFrame 安排写入）就能避免。
whys: 正确：读写交替导致强制同步布局。
问题在于强制布局，换一种循环写法没有帮助。
JavaScript 可以直接修改行内样式。
读取几何属性不涉及网络。

en.q: A loop sets el.style.width = … on each element and immediately reads el.offsetHeight, and the page crawls. Why, and what fixes it?
choices: Each read forces a synchronous layout (layout thrashing); do all the reads first, then all the writes
The loop itself is slow; use forEach
style.width can only be changed in CSS files
offsetHeight triggers a network request; cache it
en.explain: Browsers usually batch style changes and lay out once per frame. Reading geometry such as offsetHeight or getBoundingClientRect forces any pending changes to be laid out first so the value is accurate, so a loop that alternates writes and reads triggers a full layout every time. Batch the reads, then the writes (or schedule writes with requestAnimationFrame).
whys: Right: interleaved reads and writes force synchronous layouts.
The cost is the forced layout; a different loop style changes nothing.
JavaScript can set inline styles directly.
Reading geometry involves no network.

zh.q: 做动画时，为什么推荐改 transform 和 opacity，而不是 left、top？
choices: transform 动画由服务器渲染
transform 和 opacity 通常可以只在合成阶段完成，不触发布局和重绘
opacity 会降低页面的内存占用
left 和 top 在现代浏览器里已经不支持动画
zh.explain: 渲染大致分为样式、布局、绘制、合成几个阶段。改 left、top 会触发布局，每帧都要重新计算；transform 和 opacity 可以把元素提升为单独的图层，由合成器（常在 GPU 上）直接变换，主线程忙的时候也能保持流畅。
whys: 渲染都在浏览器里完成。
正确：跳过布局和绘制，只做合成。
opacity 和内存占用无关，提升图层反而会多占一些内存。
left、top 可以做动画，只是代价更高。

en.q: Why animate transform and opacity rather than left and top?
choices: transform animations are rendered on the server
transform and opacity can usually be handled in compositing alone, with no layout or paint
opacity lowers the page's memory use
Modern browsers no longer animate left and top
en.explain: Rendering roughly runs style, layout, paint and composite. Changing left or top triggers layout every frame; transform and opacity can put the element on its own layer that the compositor (often on the GPU) moves directly, staying smooth even when the main thread is busy.
whys: All rendering happens in the browser.
Right: layout and paint are skipped; only compositing runs.
opacity does not save memory; extra layers cost a little more.
left and top still animate, just at a higher cost.

zh.q: 关于关键渲染路径，下面哪项正确？
choices: CSS 文件是异步加载的，不影响首次渲染
图片下载完之前页面不会显示任何内容
<head> 里的外部 CSS 会阻塞渲染：样式表加载完之前，浏览器不会绘制页面内容
<script> 标签放在哪里对首屏没有影响
zh.explain: 浏览器需要 DOM 和 CSSOM 才能生成渲染树，所以 CSS 是阻塞渲染的资源，要尽快送达（精简、内联关键 CSS）。普通 <script> 会阻塞 HTML 解析，应放到页面底部或加 defer。图片不会阻塞首次渲染。
whys: CSS 会阻塞渲染，避免出现无样式内容的闪烁。
图片不阻塞渲染，下载完再显示。
正确：CSS 是阻塞渲染的资源。
普通脚本会阻塞解析，位置和 defer / async 都会影响首屏。

en.q: Which is true of the critical rendering path?
choices: CSS files load asynchronously and do not affect the first render
Nothing shows until the images finish downloading
External CSS in <head> blocks rendering: nothing is painted until the stylesheet arrives
Where a <script> tag sits makes no difference to the first paint
en.explain: The browser needs both the DOM and the CSSOM to build the render tree, so CSS blocks rendering and should arrive fast (keep it small, inline critical CSS). A plain <script> blocks HTML parsing and belongs at the end or with defer. Images do not block the first render.
whys: CSS blocks rendering, which avoids a flash of unstyled content.
Images do not block rendering; they appear when ready.
Right: CSS is render-blocking.
A plain script blocks parsing, so its position and defer or async matter.

zh.q: <script defer src="a.js"> 和 <script async src="b.js"> 的区别是？
choices: defer 会阻塞 HTML 解析，async 不会
async 脚本会在 DOMContentLoaded 之后按顺序执行
defer 在 HTML 解析完后按出现顺序执行；async 下载完立即执行，多个脚本之间顺序不确定
两者都在下载完后立即执行
zh.explain: 两者都并行下载、不阻塞解析。defer 脚本等 HTML 解析完，按在文档中的顺序、在 DOMContentLoaded 之前执行，适合依赖 DOM 或彼此有依赖的脚本。async 下载完就执行，可能打断解析，适合统计等独立脚本。
whys: defer 和 async 都不阻塞解析。
async 不保证顺序，也不等 DOMContentLoaded。
正确：defer 保序且在解析后执行，async 谁先下完谁先执行。
defer 要等解析完成，不会下载完就执行。

en.q: How do <script defer src="a.js"> and <script async src="b.js"> differ?
choices: defer blocks parsing and async does not
async scripts run in order after DOMContentLoaded
defer runs after parsing, in document order; async runs as soon as it downloads, in no guaranteed order
Both run as soon as they download
en.explain: Both download in parallel without blocking parsing. defer scripts wait for parsing to finish and run in document order before DOMContentLoaded, which suits code that needs the DOM or each other. async scripts run the moment they arrive and may interrupt parsing, which suits independent things such as analytics.
whys: Neither defer nor async blocks parsing.
async neither keeps order nor waits for DOMContentLoaded.
Right: defer is ordered and after parsing; async runs whenever it lands.
defer waits for parsing to finish.

zh.q: 要一个可点击的按钮，下面哪种写法最好？
zh.explain: ARIA 的第一条规则：能用原生元素就别用 ARIA。<button> 自带键盘焦点、回车和空格触发、按钮角色和禁用状态。给 div 加 role="button" 只改变了读屏器听到的角色，键盘操作还得自己实现（tabindex、键盘事件）。
whys: 正确：原生按钮自带可访问性。
span 和 div 一样缺少按钮的行为。
role 只改了语义，键盘支持仍需手动补上。
div 不能用键盘聚焦，读屏器也不知道它是按钮。

en.q: You need a clickable button. Which markup is best?
en.explain: The first rule of ARIA: use a native element when one exists. <button> comes with keyboard focus, Enter and Space activation, the button role and a disabled state. role="button" on a div only changes what a screen reader announces; focus and keyboard handling (tabindex, key events) are still up to you.
whys: Right: a native button is accessible out of the box.
A span lacks button behaviour just like a div.
role changes only the semantics; keyboard support is still missing.
A div cannot be focused by keyboard and does not read as a button.

zh.q: 一个只有关闭图标（×，用 SVG 画的）、没有文字的按钮，怎样让读屏器用户知道它是做什么的？
choices: 给按钮加 title 属性就足够了，其他什么都不用做
zh.explain: 按钮需要一个可访问名称。没有可见文字时，用 aria-label（或视觉隐藏的文字）提供，读屏器会读出「关闭，按钮」。aria-hidden="true" 会把按钮从无障碍树里整个去掉；title 在许多读屏器和触屏设备上不可靠。
whys: aria-hidden 会让读屏器完全忽略这个按钮。
title 的支持不一致，不能作为唯一的名称来源。
角色已经由 <button> 提供，缺的是名称。
正确：用 aria-label 提供可访问名称。

en.q: A button shows only a close icon (an SVG ×) with no text. How do screen-reader users learn what it does?
choices: A title attribute on the button is enough on its own
en.explain: A button needs an accessible name. With no visible text, give it one through aria-label (or visually hidden text), and a screen reader announces "Close, button". aria-hidden="true" removes the button from the accessibility tree entirely, and title is unreliable across screen readers and touch devices.
whys: aria-hidden makes screen readers ignore the button completely.
title support is patchy, so it should not be the only name.
<button> already provides the role; what is missing is a name.
Right: aria-label gives it an accessible name.

zh.q: 表单保存成功后，页面上出现「已保存」的提示。想让读屏器自动读出它，又不打断用户正在听的内容，应该怎么做？
choices: 把提示放进 aria-live="assertive" 的容器里
把提示放进带 aria-live="polite"（或 role="status"）的容器里
zh.explain: live region 让读屏器在内容变化时自动播报。polite 会等当前播报结束再读，适合「已保存」这类状态；assertive（role="alert" 也是）会立即打断，只该用于紧急错误。容器要先存在于页面上，再往里写内容，变化才会被播报。
whys: aria-hidden 会让读屏器完全忽略它。
alert() 会弹出模态框打断所有操作。
assertive 会立即打断当前播报，不适合普通状态。
正确：polite 的 live region 适合状态提示。

en.q: After a form saves, a "Saved" message appears. How do you get screen readers to announce it without cutting off what the user is hearing?
choices: Put the message in an aria-live="assertive" container
Put the message in a container with aria-live="polite" (or role="status")
en.explain: A live region makes screen readers announce changes to its content. polite waits until the current speech ends, which suits a status like "Saved"; assertive (as role="alert") interrupts at once and is for urgent errors. The container must already be on the page before its content changes for the change to be announced.
whys: aria-hidden makes screen readers skip it entirely.
alert() opens a modal that interrupts everything.
assertive cuts off current speech, which is too much for a routine status.
Right: a polite live region suits status messages.
